units.zh: 第二单元 同理心和正义

units.en: Part I: Learning the Skills
units.zh: 第一部分：学习技能

units.en: • What are characters?
units.zh: • 什么是字符？

units.en: Characters are central to narrative writing.
units.zh: 人物是叙事写作的核心。

units.en: We want to create real characters:
units.zh: 我们想创造真实的角色：

units.en: characters that live and breathe and act in believable ways, and most importantly, characters whom our readers will find worth caring about.
units.zh: 以可信的方式生活、呼吸和行动的角色，最重要的是，我们的读者会觉得值得关注的角色。

units.en: Just like real creatures, characters have strengths and weaknesses, and they have specific personalities.
units.zh: 就像真正的生物一样，角色也有优点和缺点，而且他们有特定的个性。

units.en: The main character in a narrative is known as the protagonist.
units.zh: 叙事中的主角被称为主角。

units.en: There may be one
units.zh: 可能有一种

units.en: or more main characters.
units.zh: 或更多主要角色。

units.en: The other characters are called secondary characters.
units.zh: 其他字符称为次要字符。

units.en: They may help the protagonist or get in his or her way.
units.zh: 他们可能会帮助主角或妨碍他或她。

units.en: In a fictional narrative, the characters are made up but can be based on real people.
units.zh: 在虚构的叙述中，角色是虚构的，但可以基于真实的人。

units.en: Some narratives, such as science fiction and fantasy, use animals or imaginary creatures as characters.
units.zh: 一些叙述，例如科幻小说和幻想，使用动物或虚构的生物作为角色。

units.en: In contrast, the characters in non-fictional narratives are real.
units.zh: 相比之下，非虚构叙事中的人物是真实的。

units.en: They may be alive or dead, but at one time they did exist.
units.zh: 他们可能是活着的，也可能是死去的，但它们曾经存在过。

units.en: Think about your favorite characters in those narratives you have enjoyed.
units.zh: 在你喜欢的叙述中想想你最喜欢的角色。

units.en: What
units.zh: 什么

units.en: do they look like?
units.zh: 它们看起来像吗？

units.en: What are their personalities?
units.zh: 他们的性格是什么？

units.en: What are their likes and dislikes?
units.zh: 他们的好恶是什么？

units.en: The way to create memorable characters is to get to know them and to write about them as if they were real.
units.zh: 创造令人难忘的角色的方法是了解他们并写下他们，就好像他们是真实的一样。

units.en: • How to develop characters?
units.zh: • 如何发展角色？

units.en: Before learning how to develop characters, we first need to know the differences
units.zh: 在学习如何发展角色之前，我们首先需要知道差异

units.en: between flat and round characters.
units.zh: 在平面和圆形字符之间。

units.en: Flat characters are also called stereotypes, and the hallmark of flat characters is that they are incapable of surprising us; they act in a prescribed way, and are utterly consistent, without complexity.
units.zh: 扁平的人物也被称为刻板印象，扁平人物的标志是它们无法让我们感到惊讶； 它们以规定的方式行事，并且完全一致，没有复杂性。

units.en: For example, the loving mother, the evil stepfather, the cruel boss and the happy kid are all examples of flat characters that lack the complexity and emotional depth of the real people we know.
units.zh: 例如，慈爱的母亲、邪恶的继父、残忍的老板和快乐的孩子都是扁平角色的例子，这些角色缺乏我们认识的真实人的复杂性和情感深度。

units.en: A round character is the opposite: He or she is capable of surprising us—with unexpected fits of anger or an uplifting sense of humor or a snide remark about a presumed friend.
units.zh: 一个圆形的角色是相反的：他或她能够让我们大吃一惊——带着意想不到的愤怒或令人振奋的幽默感或对假定朋友的讽刺言论。

units.en: But "surprising" doesn't mean "unbelievable."
units.zh: 但“令人惊讶”并不意味着“令人难以置信”。

units.en: Although surprising, it is still possible for the character to do that.
units.zh: 虽然令人惊讶，但角色仍然有可能做到这一点。

units.en: As E. M. Forster, a British writer, says, if a character never surprises us, then he or she is flat; if they surprise but do not convince us, they are only flat pretending to be round.
units.zh: 正如英国作家 E. M. Forster 所说，如果一个角色从不让我们感到惊讶，那么他或她就是平淡无奇的； 如果他们感到惊讶但不说服我们，他们只是假装是圆的。

units.en: Characters are introduced and developed through a range of techniques and conventions.
units.zh: 角色是通过一系列技术和惯例引入和发展的。

units.en: Here are some common ways:
units.zh: 以下是一些常见的方法：

units.en: 1. What the character looks like
units.zh: 1.角色长什么样

units.en: This is one of the most basic ways of introducing and defining a character:
units.zh: 这是引入和定义字符的最基本方法之一：

units.en: through the description of his or her physical characteristics using straight narrative.
units.zh: 通过使用直接叙述对他或她的身体特征进行描述。

units.en: This method can also include descriptions of a character's environment and
units.zh: 此方法还可以包括对角色环境的描述和

units.en: Writing Critically 1 possessions.
units.zh: 批判性地写 1 个财产。

units.en: It is rare, although not unheard of, to create compelling characterization without some degree of narrative description of this type.
units.zh: 在没有这种类型的某种程度的叙述性描述的情况下，创造引人注目的特征是罕见的，尽管并非闻所未闻。

units.en: The doctor was a handsome, big-shouldered man with a tanned face.
units.zh: 医生是一个英俊的、大肩膀的男人，脸上晒黑了。

units.en: He wore a three-
units.zh: 他穿了一个三

units.en: piece blue suit, a striped tie and ivory cuff links.
units.zh: 一件蓝色西装，条纹领带和象牙袖扣。

units.en: His gray hair was combed along the sides of his head, and he looked as if he had just come from a concert.
units.zh: 他的白发梳在他的头两侧，看起来就像是刚从音乐会上来的。

units.en: —"A Small, Good Thing" by Raymond Carver
units.zh: ——雷蒙德·卡弗的《小事、好事》

units.en: This example has a direct telling description of a doctor: not only what he looks like and what he is wearing, but also the aura about him: "he looked as if he had just come from a concert."
units.zh: 这个例子对医生有一个直接的说明：不仅他长得像什么，穿什么，还有他身上的气息：“他看起来好像刚从音乐会上来。”

units.en: This is as revealing as the concrete details to render this person on the page.
units.zh: 这与在页面上呈现此人的具体细节一样具有启发性。

units.en: The girl was one of those pretty and charming young creatures who sometimes are born, as if by a slip of fate, into a family of clerks.
units.zh: 她是那种漂亮迷人的年轻姑娘，仿佛命运一时弄错了，有时竟让她们生在小职员之家。

units.en: She had no dowry, no expectations, no way of being known, understood, loved, married by any rich and distinguished man; so she let herself be married to a little clerk of the Ministry of Public Instruction.
units.zh: 她没有嫁妆，没有期望，没有任何有钱有贵的人结婚的方式； 所以她让自己嫁给了公共教育部的一位小文员。

units.en: -"The Necklace" by Guy de Maupassant
units.zh: ——《项链》 作者：Guy de Maupassant

units.en: This example also has a direct telling description of the character.
units.zh: 这个例子也有一个对字符的直接说明。

units.en: The author not only tells us that she was "pretty and charming," but also tells us about her family background (environment) and its impact on her marriage.
units.zh: 作者不仅告诉我们她“漂亮迷人”，还告诉我们她的家庭背景（环境）及其对她婚姻的影响。

units.en: 2. What the character says
units.zh: 2.角色说什么

units.en: The words that come out of a character's mouth are a very powerful means of characterization.
units.zh: 从角色嘴里说出来的词是一种非常有力的人物塑造方式。

units.en: Not only what a character says (the content), but also the manner in which he or she says it, is critical.
units.zh: 不仅角色所说的（内容），而且他或她所说的方式也是至关重要的。

units.en: This includes the vocabulary, syntax, use or misuse of words, general diction, as well as any gesture or emotionally charged way in which a character delivers a line of dialogue.
units.zh: 这包括词汇、句法、单词的使用或误用、一般措辞，以及角色提供对话的任何手势或情绪激动的方式。

units.en: The use of subtext-what isn't being said, or what is being avoided—is also a rich source for characterization.
units.zh: 使用潜台词——没有说什么，或者正在避免什么——也是表征的丰富来源。

units.en: She went up
units.zh: 她上去了

units.en: "Good-day, Jeanne."
units.zh: “晚安，珍妮。”

units.en: The other, astonished to be familiarly addressed by this plain good-wife, did not recognize her at all and stammered: "But-madame!--I do not know-You must have mistaken." "No. I am Mathilde Loisel."
units.zh: 另一个，惊讶地被这个普通的好妻子熟悉了，完全不认识她，结结巴巴地说：“但是——夫人！——我不知道——你一定是错了。” “不。我是玛蒂尔德·洛伊塞尔。”

units.en: Her friend uttered a cry.
units.zh: 她的朋友哭了。

units.en: "Oh, my poor Mathilde! How you are changed!" "Yes, I have had a pretty hard life, since last saw you, and great poverty-and that because of you!"
units.zh: “哦，我可怜的玛蒂尔德！你怎么变了！” “是的，自从上次见到你以来，我的生活一直很艰难，因为你太贫穷了——那是因为你！”

units.en: Unit 2 Empathy and Justice
units.zh: 第二单元 同理心和正义

units.en: "Of me! How so?"
units.zh: “我！怎么会？”

units.en: "Do you remember that diamond necklace you lent me to wear at the ministerial ball?" "Yes. Well?"
units.zh: “你还记得你借给我在部长级舞会上戴的那条钻石项链吗？” “是的。嗯？”

units.en: "Well, I lost it."
units.zh: “嗯，我丢了。”

units.en: "What do you mean? You brought it back." " brought you back another exactly like it. And it has taken us ten years to pay for it. You can understand that it was not easy for us, for us who had nothing. At last it is ended and I am very glad."
units.zh: “你是什么意思？你把它带回来了。” “又给你带回了一个和它完全一样的东西。我们花了十年的时间才付出代价。你可以理解这对我们来说并不容易，对我们一无所有的人来说。它终于结束了，我很高兴。”

units.en: Madame Forestier had stopped "You say that you bought a necklace of diamonds to replace mine?" "Yes. You never noticed it, then! They were very similar."
units.zh: Forestier 夫人已经停止了“你说你买了一条钻石项链来代替我的？” “是的。那你从来没有注意到它！他们非常相似。”

units.en: And she smiled with a joy that was at once proud and ingenuous.
units.zh: 她带着一种既自豪又天真的喜悦微笑。

units.en: Madame Forestier, deeply moved, took her hands.
units.zh: 弗里斯特夫人，深深感动，握住了她的手。

units.en: "Oh, my poor Mathilde! Why, my necklace was paste! It was worth at most only five hundred francs!"
units.zh: “哦，我可怜的玛蒂尔德！为什么，我的项链是糊状的！它最多只值五百法郎！”

units.en: -"The Necklace" by Guy de Maupassant
units.zh: ——《项链》 作者：Guy de Maupassant

units.en: We learn about the characters' emotions from not only what they say, but how they say it.
units.zh: 我们不仅从他们所说的内容中了解角色的情感，还从他们如何说的中了解这些人的情感。

units.en: For example, in the above example, Mathildes familiar form of address shocked her friend Jeanne because of her current plain appearance.
units.zh: 例如，在上面的例子中，Mathildes 熟悉的地址形式震惊了她的朋友珍妮，因为她目前的外表。

units.en: In this short dialogue, Mathilde proudly told her friend Jeanne that they eventually paid off all the debt for the necklace.
units.zh: 在这段简短的对话中，玛蒂尔德自豪地告诉她的朋友珍妮，他们最终还清了项链的所有债务。

units.en: Mathilde appeared to be content that her friend did not notice the replacement of the necklace with her words ("Yes. You never noticed it, then! They were very similar.") and her facial expression (... she smiled with a joy that was at once proud and ingenuous.
units.zh: 玛蒂尔德似乎很满足于她的朋友没有注意到用她的话代替项链（“是的。你从来没有注意到它！它们非常相似。”）和她的面部表情（......她带着一种既自豪又天真的喜悦微笑。

units.en: 3. What the character does
units.zh: 3.角色做什么

units.en: "Actions speak louder than words," goes the old adage, and this can be true in characterization as well as in real life.
units.zh: “行动胜于雄辩，”这句古老的格言说，这在人物塑造和现实生活中都是正确的。

units.en: How a character behaves, both alone and in response to actions from other characters, is a critical aspect of characterization.
units.zh: 角色的行为方式，无论是单独的还是对来自其他角色的动作的反应，都是人物塑造的关键方面。

units.en: Let's look at another example of how Mathilde and her husband acted when they found that Mathilde lost her friend's necklace.
units.zh: 让我们看另一个例子，说明 Mathilde 和她的丈夫在发现 Mathilde 丢失了她朋友的项链时的行为。

units.en: They looked, thunderstruck, at each other.
units.zh: 他们互相看着，震惊地看着对方。

units.en: At last Loisel put on his clothes "I shall go back on foot," said he, "over the whole route, to see whether I can find it."
units.zh: 最后洛伊塞尔穿上他的衣服“我要回去，”他说，“整个路线，看看我能不能找到它。”

units.en: He went out.
units.zh: 他出去了。

units.en: She sat waiting on a chair in her ball dress, without strength to go to bed, overwhelmed, without any fire, without a thought.
units.zh: 她穿着球衣坐在椅子上，没有力气上床睡觉，不知所措，没有任何火，没有任何想法。

units.en: Her husband returned about seven oclock.
units.zh: 她的丈夫大约七点钟回来了。

units.en: He had found nothing He went to police headquarters, to the newspaper offices to offer a reward; he went to the cab companies-everywhere, in fact, whither he was urged by the least spark of hope.
units.zh: 他没有找到他去警察总部和报社的报酬； 事实上，他去了出租车公司——事实上，他的希望是最少的火花。

units.en: She waited all day, in the same condition of mad fear before this terrible calamity.
units.zh: 她等了一整天，在这场可怕的灾难面前处于疯狂的恐惧状态。

units.en: Loisel returned at night with a hollow, pale face.
units.zh: 洛伊塞尔在晚上带着一副空洞的、苍白的脸回来了。

units.en: He had discovered nothing.
units.zh: 他什么也没发现。

units.en: 34 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 34 思辨写作 1

units.en: In this example, the author tells us how the couple reacted to the fact of losing the necklace.
units.zh: 在这个例子中，作者告诉我们这对夫妇对失去项链的事实有何反应。

units.en: Through the use of action verbs (in bold), especially the use of the common verbs "go" and "return" accompanied by related prepositional phrases, the author describes the concrete actions taken by Loisel and Mathilde, illustrating that they tried so hard to hold on to "the least spark of hope" but had to face the cruel reality of discovering nothing.
units.zh: 通过使用动作动词（粗体），特别是使用常用动词“go”和“return”以及相关的介词短语，作者描述了Loisel和Mathilde采取的具体行动，说明他们非常努力地坚持“希望最少的火花”，但有 面对一无所获的残酷现实。

units.en: Then in the following example, we will see how excited Helen Keller was about the finger spelling "game" through the author's use of action verbs (in bold).
units.zh: 然后在以下示例中，我们将通过作者使用动作动词（粗体）来看到 Helen Keller 对手指拼写“游戏”的兴奋程度。

units.en: When I had played with it a little while, Miss Sullivan slowly spelled into my hand the word "d-o-i-l" I was at once interested in this finger play and tried to imitate it.
units.zh: 当我玩了一会儿时，沙利文小姐慢慢地将“D-O-I-L”这个词拼在我手中，我对这个手指游戏很感兴趣，并试图模仿它。

units.en: When I finally succeeded in making the letters correctly I was flushed with childish pleasure and pride Running downstairs to my mother I held up my hand and made the letters for doll.
units.zh: 当我终于成功地写下这些信件时，我带着幼稚的快感和自豪地跑到妈妈身边，举起手来给娃娃写信。

units.en: 4. What the character thinks or feels
units.zh: 4. 角色的想法或感受

units.en: Depending on the point of view, you may be able to convey what your character thinks or feels directly on the page or indirectly through implication by what he or she says or does.
units.zh: 根据观点，您可以直接在页面上传达您的角色的想法或感受，或通过他或她所说或所做的间接暗示来传达您的角色的想法或感受。

units.en: In the following example, Helen Keller told us what she thought when she connected the word water with real water.
units.zh: 在下面的例子中，海伦·凯勒告诉我们，当她将水与真水连接起来时，她的想法。

units.en: As the cool stream gushed over one hand she spelled into the other the word water, first slowly, then rapidly.
units.zh: 当凉爽的溪流喷涌而出时，她将水一词拼写到另一只手中，首先是慢慢地，然后是快速。

units.en: I stood still, my whole attention fixed upon the motions of her fingers.
units.zh: 我站着不动，整个注意力都集中在她手指的动作上。

units.en: Suddenly I felt a misty consciousness as of something forgotten—a thrill of returning thought; and somehow the mystery of language was revealed to me. I knew then that "w-a-t-e-r" meant the wonderful cool something that was flowing over my hand.
units.zh: 突然，我感觉到一种被遗忘的东西——一种回归思想的快感； 不知何故，语言的奥秘向我揭示了。 那时我知道“W-A-T-E-R”意味着在我手上流淌的美妙的酷炫的东西。

units.en: That living word awakened my soul, gave it light, hope, joy, set it free!
units.zh: 那个活生生的话语唤醒了我的灵魂，给了它光、希望、喜悦，让它自由了！

units.en: There were barriers still, it is true, but barriers that could in time be swept away.
units.zh: 仍然有障碍，这是真的，但障碍可能会及时被扫除。

units.en: Here is another example.
units.zh: 这是另一个例子。

units.en: In the following lines, we can see that Mathilde's
units.zh: 在以下几行中，我们可以看到 Mathilde 的

units.en: success at the ball made her forget about her marriage to a clerk and her thoughts betrayed her inner desire for a life full of delicacies and luxuries.
units.zh: 舞会上的成功让她忘记了与文员的婚姻，她的思想背叛了她对充满美味和奢侈生活的内在渴望。

units.en: She danced with rapture, with passion, intoxicated by pleasure, forgetting all in the triumph of her beauty, in the glory of her success, in a sort of cloud of happiness comprised of all this homage, admiration, these awakened desires and of that sense of triumph which is so sweet to woman's heart.
units.zh: 她在狂喜、激情、醉心、沉浸在她美丽的胜利中、在她成功的荣耀中、由所有这些敬意、钦佩、这些觉醒的欲望和那种胜利的感觉中组成的幸福的云中，狂喜地跳舞。 甜蜜的女人心。

units.en: • How to craft effective dialogue?
units.zh: • 如何制定有效的对话？

units.en: Dialogue is the conversation between characters.
units.zh: 对话是人物之间的对话。

units.en: It should sound natural, as
units.zh: 它应该听起来很自然，就像

units.en: if the characters were really speaking.
units.zh: 如果角色真的在说话。

units.en: Learning to craft good dialogue is one of the
units.zh: 学习制作良好的对话是其中之一

units.en: Unit 2 Empathy and Justice
units.zh: 第二单元 同理心和正义

units.en: most critical aspects of learning to write good fictional and non-fictional narrative.
units.zh: 学习写出好的虚构和非虚构叙事的最关键方面。

units.en: Dialogue is not just the words the characters speak to each other.
units.zh: 对话不仅仅是人物互相交谈的词语。

units.en: Good dialogue
units.zh: 良好的对话

units.en: works on a number of different levels.
units.zh: 适用于多个不同的层次。

units.en: Here are the main aspects that should be accomplished with it:
units.zh: 以下是应该完成的主要方面：

units.en: • to add to the reader's knowledge of the situation.
units.zh: • 增加读者对情况的了解。

units.en: • to move forward the action of the plot.
units.zh: • 向前推进情节的动作。

units.en: • to reveal something about the speaker's personality, both directly and indirectly.
units.zh: • 直接和间接地揭示说话者的个性。

units.en: • to dramatize relationships between characters.
units.zh: • 将角色之间的关系戏剧化。

units.en: • to build suspense.
units.zh: • 建立悬念。

units.en: When you write dialogue, it is important to stay true to each character's
units.zh: 当你写对话时，重要的是要忠于每个角色的

units.en: personality and background.
units.zh: 个性和背景。

units.en: Dialogue should be extremely specific.
units.zh: 对话应该非常具体。

units.en: Every character should speak differently.
units.zh: 每个角色的说话方式都应该不同。

units.en: Each should have a distinct way of phrasing opinion and subject matter.
units.zh: 每个人都应该有不同的措辞方式来表达意见和主题。

units.en: You should consider:
units.zh: 你应该考虑：

units.en: The character's age.
units.zh: 角色的年龄。

units.en: How old the character is helps determine what words he or she will use.
units.zh: 角色的年龄有助于确定他或她将使用哪些单词。

units.en: Where he or she lives.
units.zh: 他或她住在哪里。

units.en: People from different areas have different ways of
units.zh: 来自不同地区的人有不同的方式

units.en: speaking.
units.zh: 说话。

units.en: Where he or she is speaking.
units.zh: 他或她说话的地方。

units.en: A character will speak differently in different
units.zh: 一个角色会以不同的方式说话

units.en: places.
units.zh: 地方。

units.en: Whom he or she is talking to.
units.zh: 他或她正在与谁交谈。

units.en: A character will use different words when he or
units.zh: 一个角色会在他或

units.en: she is talking to different people.
units.zh: 她正在与不同的人交谈。

units.en: Form of communication.
units.zh: 沟通形式。

units.en: A person may use different styles of language when
units.zh: 一个人可以使用不同风格的语言

units.en: speaking from those he or she uses in writing.
units.zh: 从他或她在写作中使用的人说。

units.en: The character's mood.
units.zh: 角色的心情。

units.en: How the character feels is often expressed through dialogue.
units.zh: 角色的感受通常是通过对话来表达的。

units.en: For example, when a person is angry, he or she might say things harsher than usual.
units.zh: 例如，当一个人生气时，他或她可能会说比平时更严厉的话。

units.en: Now compare the dialogue that Mathilde had with her husband Loisel
units.zh: 现在比较马蒂尔德与丈夫洛伊塞尔的对话

units.en: with the dialogue she had with her friend Madame Forestier in "The Necklace" and discuss the different ways Mathilde talked to each of them.
units.zh: 通过与她的朋友 Forestier 夫人在“项链”中进行的对话，并讨论了 Mathilde 与他们每个人交谈的不同方式。

units.en: To write good dialogue, you also need to consider that: Gestures are a part of dialogue.
units.zh: 要写出良好的对话，您还需要考虑：手势是对话的一部分。

units.en: Silence is a part of dialogue.
units.zh: 沉默是对话的一部分。

units.en: The environment (the scene around the character) can also be a part of dialogue.
units.zh: 环境（角色周围的场景）也可以成为对话的一部分。

units.en: Dialogue is not necessarily grammatically correct.
units.zh: 对话不一定在语法上是正确的。

units.en: Look at the following example:
units.zh: 看下面的例子：

units.en: 36 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 36 思辨写作 1

units.en: The woman brought two glasses of beer and two felt pads.
units.zh: 女人带来了两杯啤酒和两个毛毡垫。

units.en: She put the felt pads and the beer glasses on the table and looked at the man and the girl.
units.zh: 她把毛毡垫和啤酒杯放在桌子上，看着男人和女孩。

units.en: The girl was looking off at the line of hills.
units.zh: 女孩正看着山线。

units.en: They were white in the sun and the country was brown and dry.
units.zh: 它们在阳光下是白色的，这个国家是棕色和干燥的。

units.en: "They look like white elephants," she said "I've never seen one," the man drank his beer.
units.zh: “它们看起来像白象，”她说“我从未见过一只，”男人喝了他的啤酒。

units.en: "No, you wouldn't have."
units.zh: “不，你不会有的。”

units.en: "I might have," the man said.
units.zh: “我可能有，”男人说。

units.en: "Just because you say I wouldn't have doesn't prove anything."
units.zh: “仅仅因为你说我不会有，这并不能证明任何事情。”

units.en: The girl looked at the bead curtain.
units.zh: 女孩看着珠帘。

units.en: "They've painted something on it, she said. "What does it say?"
units.zh: “他们在上面画了一些东西，她说。“这说明了什么？”

units.en: -"Hills like White Elephants" by Ernest Hemingway
units.zh: - 欧内斯特·海明威的《像白象一样的山丘》

units.en: The gestures are boldfaced in this excerpt.
units.zh: 手势在本摘录中以粗体显示。

units.en: This dialogue happened in the situation where the man and the woman were drinking beer.
units.zh: 这种对话发生在男人和女人喝啤酒的情况下。

units.en: Notice how the gestures inform the way the dialogue is spoken.
units.zh: 注意手势如何告知对话的方式。

units.en: When the man drank his beer after saying, "T've never seen one," he was dismissing what the girl said.
units.zh: 当那个男人说“你从来没有见过一个”后喝了他的啤酒，他是在忽视女孩说的话。

units.en: When the girl looked at the bead curtain, she was trying to change the subject to defuse the tension between them.
units.zh: 当女孩看着珠帘时，她正试图改变话题，以化解他们之间的紧张关系。

units.en: In both cases, the gestures can be considered extensions of the dialogue.
units.zh: 在这两种情况下，手势都可以被认为是对话的延伸。

units.en: In general, having your characters do something while they are speaking adds verisimilitude to the exchange; we rarely just sit there, frozen, as we speak to one another.
units.zh: 一般来说，让你的角色在说话时做点什么会增加交流的逼真度； 当我们互相交谈时，我们很少只是坐在那里，冻结。

units.en: It is natural for gestures and actions to enter into the dialogue itself.
units.zh: 手势和动作自然进入对话本身是很自然的。

units.en: • Balance telling and showing in narrative writing It is important to balance the acts of telling and showing in developing characters.
units.zh: • 在叙事写作中平衡讲述和展示 平衡讲述和展示角色的行为非常重要。

units.en: Ideally, showing and telling are organically intertwined.
units.zh: 理想情况下，展示和讲述是有机地交织在一起的。

units.en: However, a common practice is "to show, not tell" This is because good telling is difficult to do.
units.zh: 然而，一种常见的做法是“表现出来，而不是告诉”这是因为很难说好。

units.en: Good telling needs to be concrete and specific.
units.zh: 好的讲述需要具体和具体。

units.en: It is quite easy to generalize or go abstract in telling, especially for novice writers.
units.zh: 在讲述中很容易概括或抽象，尤其是对于新手作家。

units.en: Showing.
units.zh: 显示。

units.en: The American Heritage Dictionary defines "to show" as "to cause or allow to be seen."
units.zh: 美国遗产词典将“展示”定义为“导致或允许被看到”。

units.en: In literature, showing is also referred to as dramatizing.
units.zh: 在文学中，展示也被称为戏剧化。

units.en: If something is shown, or dramatized, the reader is allowed to be an eyewitness (of sorts) to the events of the story, novel or essay through the use of dialogue (what
units.zh: 如果某物被展示或戏剧化，读者可以通过使用对话成为故事、小说或散文事件的目击者（某种程度上）。

units.en: Tips
units.zh: 提示

units.en: characters say and action (what characters do).
units.zh: 角色说和行动（角色做什么）。

units.en: Telling.
units.zh: 说。

units.en: Also referred to as summary or narration, telling is used to directly communicate or describe what is happening to the reader.
units.zh: 也称为摘要或叙述，讲述用于直接交流或描述发生在读者身上的事情。

units.en: That is, as a writer, you can describe the setting (e.g., It was a dark and stormy night; you can describe the characters (e.g., She had a face as broad and as innocent as a cabbage); and you can even "tell" the plot by summarizing what happens at a particular point.
units.zh: 也就是说，作为一个作家，你可以描述这个场景（例如，这是一个黑暗和暴风雨的夜晚；你可以描述角色（例如，她的脸像卷心菜一样宽阔和无辜）；你甚至可以通过总结发生什么来“告诉”情节 在特定点。

units.en: Here is an example of showing (or scene) vs. telling (or narration) made by Paul Wood:
units.zh: 以下是显示（或场景）与保罗伍德制作的讲述（或叙述）的示例：

units.en: Pure Narration:
units.zh: 纯叙述：

units.en: My mother and I were having an argument.
units.zh: 我和我妈妈正在争吵。

units.en: Like all our arguments, it was purportedly about something very specific—in this case, who was the winner of the 1986 World Series-yet it seemed to indicate something of the larger issues facing us.
units.zh: 就像我们所有的论点一样，它据称是关于非常具体的事情——在这种情况下，谁是 1986 年世界大赛的赢家——但它似乎表明了我们面临的更大问题。

units.en: We tended to mystify each other, my mother and me, and we got closest to one another in our arguments when we could crystallize or at least point to something concrete between us that we didn't agree on.
units.zh: 我们倾向于互相迷惑，我的母亲和我，当我们可以结晶或至少指出我们之间的具体一些我们不同意的具体事情时，我们在争论中彼此最接近。

units.en: Most of the time we existed in a floating state of nebulous bewilderment.
units.zh: 大多数时候，我们存在于模糊混乱的浮动状态。

units.en: She said the Yankees had won.
units.zh: 她说洋基队赢了。

units.en: I said the Orioles.
units.zh: 我说金莺。

units.en: That was basically all there was to our argument: each stating the position over and over again, each stating for evidence such things like our personal emotions about the outcome.
units.zh: 这就是我们的论点的全部内容：每个人一遍又一遍地陈述立场，每个人都在陈述证据，比如我们对结果的个人情绪。

units.en: She said she knew it was the Yankees because she had visited New York that year (she hated New York) and had come back with a Yankees T-shirt for me and my father.
units.zh: 她说她知道那是洋基队，因为那年她去过纽约（她讨厌纽约），并为我和我父亲带着一件洋基队的 T 恤回来了。

units.en: I said I knew it was the Orioles because the fact that they were birds had impressed itself upon my teenaged mind.
units.zh: 我说我知道这是金莺队，因为它们是鸟类的事实在我十几岁的头脑中留下了深刻的印象。

units.en: I remembered thinking, I told her, how strange it was that birds were the national baseball champions.
units.zh: 我记得当时我想，我告诉她，鸟类是国家棒球冠军是多么奇怪。

units.en: Readers have a natural desire to be present when the drama heats up-they tend not to be satisfied with having key scenes summarized for them.
units.zh: 当戏剧升温时，读者自然渴望出现——他们往往不满足于为他们总结关键场景。

units.en: On the other hand, telling supplements what is shown.

units.en: It is used to "set the scene" or prepare the reader for what will shortly be shown, to provide important information that would be difficult or awkward to dramatize in the existing context.
units.zh: 它用于“设置场景”或为即将显示的内容做好准备，以提供在现有环境中难以或尴尬的重要信息。

units.en: The following two passages are about two best friends, Deanna and Beverly.

units.en: [1] Deanna and Beverly are best friends.

units.en: [2] Deanna is an ordinary fifteen-year-old who is sure of herself and very independent.

units.en: "Oh, yeah!"
units.zh: “哦，是的！”

units.en: Deanna exclaimed, standing before a full-length mirror with a smile as bright as her outfit.
units.zh: 迪安娜惊呼道，站在一面全身镜子前，笑容和她的衣服一样灿烂。

units.en: "I look good! This is definitely me. What do you think?"
units.zh: “我看起来不错！这绝对是我。你觉得呢？”

units.en: Beverly looked up at her best friend and replied sheepishly, "Uh.... yeah, I guess..." her voice trailing off as she looked down and began to fidget with some of the cosmetics on the vanity table, silently wishing she could look so ravishing in the same clothes.

units.en: Deanna twirled playfully before the mirror and laughed, then stopped as she noticed Beverly aimlessly twisting a lipstick in and out of its case.
units.zh: 迪安娜开玩笑地在镜子前旋转并大笑，然后停下来，因为她注意到贝弗利漫无目的地在外壳里扭动着一条唇膏。

Bad enough you're dating this guy, but you just let him do whatever he wants! I tell you, girl, you better hold on to him. You keep this up, you don't keep tabs on him, you're going to lose him."

units.en: ASSIGNMENT 1
units.zh: 作业 1

units.en: Write a short story in no less than 300 words about a person who has a great influence on you.
units.zh: 用不少于 300 字的短篇小说写一篇关于对你有很大影响的人的短篇小说。

units.en: In particular, select one event or experience that the person went through.
units.zh: 特别是，选择该人所经历的一项事件或体验。

units.en: You need to balance your use of showing and telling in your attempt to create a round character.
units.zh: 在尝试创建圆形角色时，您需要平衡对展示和讲述的使用。

units.en: Step A: Recall a person who has a great influence on you.
units.zh: 步骤 A：召回对您有很大影响的人。

units.en: Use the following questions to help you recall the details:
units.zh: 使用以下问题来帮助您回忆详细信息：

units.en: 1) Who is the person?
units.zh: 1) 谁是人？

units.en: 2) When and where did you meet this person?
units.zh: 2) 你是在何时何地遇到这个人的？

units.en: 3) What was this person's profession or job at the time you met him or her?
units.zh: 3) 你遇到他或她时这个人的职业或工作是什么？

units.en: What was your relationship to him or her?
units.zh: 你和他或她是什么关系？

units.en: 4) What happened between you and this person?
units.zh: 4) 你和这个人之间发生了什么？

units.en: Did this person say or do anything that impressed you or have a great impact on you?
units.zh: 这个人有没有说过或做过什么让你印象深刻或对你有很大影响的事情？

units.en: 5) What have you learned from this person?
units.zh: 5) 你从这个人身上学到了什么？

units.en: 6) Why is this person still influential in your life?
units.zh: 6）为什么这个人对你的生活仍然有影响力？

units.en: Unit 2 Empathy and Justice
units.zh: 第二单元 同理心和正义

units.en: Step B: On a separate sheet of paper, brainstorm a list of details related to the above six questions.

units.en: "Twenty years ago tonight," said the man, "I dined here at 'Big Joe' Brady's with Jimmy Wells, my best chum, and the finest chap in the world. He and I were raised here in New York, just like two brothers, together. I was eighteen and Jimmy was twenty. The next morning I was to start for the West to make my fortune. You couldn't have dragged Jimmy out of New York; he thought it was the only place on earth. Well, we agreed that night that we would meet here again exactly twenty years from that date and time, no matter what our conditions might be or from what distance we might have to come. We figured that in twenty years each of us ought to have our destiny worked out and our fortunes made, whatever they were going to be."
units.zh: “二十年前的今晚，”那名男子说，“我和吉米·威尔斯、我最好的朋友和世界上最好的小伙子一起在‘大乔’布雷迪餐厅用餐。他和我在纽约长大，就像两个兄弟一样，我是 十八岁，吉米二十岁，第二天早上，我要出发去西方发财。你不可能把吉米拖出纽约；他认为这是地球上唯一的地方。 无论我们的条件如何，或者我们可能要走多远。我们认为，在二十年后，我们每个人的命运都应该得到成功，我们的命运，无论它们将是什么。”

units.en: Part III: Language Study
units.zh: 第三部分：语言学习

units.en: • Concrete language (I)
units.zh: • 具体语言 (i)

units.en: In Unit 1, we have learned that concrete details are critical to good writing.
units.zh: 在第 1 单元中，我们了解到具体的细节对于好的写作至关重要。

units.en: We
units.zh: 我们

units.en: need to use concrete language when showing or telling our story.
units.zh: 在展示或讲述我们的故事时需要使用具体的语言。

units.en: The key to create a good character lies in those concrete words that can successfully demonstrate the character's specific details, including his or her actions, behavior, attitudes, values and feelings.
units.zh: 创造一个好的性格的关键在于那些可以成功地展示角色的具体细节，包括他或她的行为、行为、态度、价值观和感受的具体词语。

units.en: Concreteness depends on the writer's ability to perceive, not merely to see, and to translate those perceptions into concrete language.
units.zh: 具体性取决于作者的感知能力，而不仅仅是看到并将这些感知转化为具体的语言。

units.en: Concreteness can be achieved by the use of adjectives, adverbs, nouns and especially verbs.
units.zh: 具体性可以通过使用形容词、副词、名词，尤其是动词来实现。

units.en: In the following two passages from "The Selfish Giant," we can notice that the author uses concrete language (in bold) to create a live scene for readers such as the sound that the Giant heard, the sight that the Giant saw and the feeling that the Giant had about the sound and the sight.
units.zh: 在《自私的巨人》的以下两段中，我们可以注意到作者使用具体的语言（粗体）为读者创造了一个现场场景，例如巨人听到的声音、巨人看到的景象以及巨人对声音和视觉的感觉。

units.en: Without the use of concrete language, would the two passages draw your attention or touch you?

units.en: of action verbs (in bold) to show what the Giant did after he became aware of his selfishness.
units.zh: 动作动词（粗体）以显示巨人在意识到自己的自私后所做的事情。

units.en: With these action verbs, we can picture the scene in our minds.

units.en: So he crept downstairs and opened the front door quite softly, and went out into the

units.en: But when the children saw him they were so frightened that they all ran away, and the garden became winter again.
units.zh: 但是孩子们看到他时，吓坏了，他们都跑了，花园又变成了冬天。

units.en: Only the little boy did not run, for his eyes were so full of tears that he did not see the Giant coming.
units.zh: 只有小男孩没有奔跑，因为他的眼里充满了泪水，以至于他没有看到巨人的来。

units.en: And the Giant stole up behind him and took him gently in his hand, and put him up into the tree.
units.zh: 巨人偷走在他身后，轻轻地把他握在手中，把他放在树上。

units.en: • Figurative language (I)
units.zh: • 比喻语言 (i)

units.en: In addition to concrete language such as verbs, adjectives and nouns, effective
units.zh: 除了动词、形容词和名词等具体语言外，还有效

units.en: descriptions usually depend on a variety of figurative language (or figures of speech).
units.zh: 描述通常取决于各种比喻语言（或修辞格）。

units.en: Let's examine the nature and functions of three figures of speech: simile, metaphor and personification.
units.zh: 让我们来看看三个修辞格的性质和功能：明喻、隐喻和拟人化。

units.en: Simile makes a direct comparison frequently using such words as like or as.
units.zh: Simile 经常使用 like 或 as 等词进行直接比较。

units.en: We
units.zh: 我们

units.en: can find a good example in "The Selfish Giant": He was dressed in grey, and his breath was like ice.
units.zh: 可以在《自私的巨人》中找到一个很好的例子：他穿着灰色，呼吸像冰一样。

units.en: This simile likens the Hail to ice.
units.zh: 这个比喻把冰雹比作冰。

units.en: Metaphor is an implied comparison.
units.zh: 隐喻是隐含的比较。

units.en: Instead of pointing to the likeness of two
units.zh: 而不是指向两个人的相似之处

units.en: otherwise unrelated concepts, metaphor states that one thing is another.
units.zh: 否则不相关的概念，隐喻指出一件事是另一回事。

units.en: Metaphor, because it contains an implied rather than a stated comparison, is more complex.
units.zh: 隐喻，因为它包含隐含而不是陈述的比较，所以更复杂。

units.en: Again we can find an example in "The Selfish Giant": "I have many beautiful flowers," he said, "but the children are the most beautiful flowers of all" The Giant considered the children the most beautiful flowers of all, revealing his love toward them and his
units.zh: 再一次我们可以在《自私的巨人》中找到一个例子：“我有许多美丽的花朵，”他说，“但孩子们是最美丽的花朵” 巨人认为孩子们是最美丽的花朵，向他们展示了他对他们和他的爱

units.en: Unit 2 Empathy and Justice
units.zh: 第二单元 同理心和正义

units.en: change from a selfish person to an unselfish person.
units.zh: 从一个自私的人变成一个无私的人。

units.en: Personification gives a special kind of animation to objects, concepts, etc.
units.zh: 拟人化为对象、概念等提供了一种特殊的动画。

units.en: Like metaphors, personification makes an implicit comparison.
units.zh: 像隐喻一样，人格化进行了隐含的比较。

units.en: In "The Selfish Giant," the author uses a great deal of personification in describing the garden: The Snow covered up the grass with her great white cloak, and the Frost painted all the trees silver.
units.zh: 在《自私的巨人》中，作者在描述花园时使用了大量的拟人化：雪覆盖了草地上的大白袍，霜把所有的树都漆成了银色。

units.en: Then they invited the North Wind to stay with them, and he came.
units.zh: 然后他们邀请北风和他们在一起，他来了。

units.en: He was wrapped in furs, and he roared all day about the garden, and blew the chimney-pots down.
units.zh: 他裹着皮草，整天在花园里咆哮，把烟囱的罐子炸了。

units.en: In this example, the author personifies snow, frost and the north wind, making them act like human beings.
units.zh: 在这个例子中，作者将雪、霜和北风拟人化，使它们像人类一样行事。

units.en: Figurative language can add to the quality of your writing, making the words more memorable.
units.zh: 比喻语言可以增加你的写作质量，使单词更令人难忘。

units.en: The writing is simply more fun.
units.zh: 写作更有趣。

units.en: However, the use of clichés should be limited.
units.zh: 但是，陈词滥调的使用应该是有限的。

units.en: A cliché is an expression that has been used so much and is therefore worn out.
units.zh: 陈词滥调是一种被使用了很多的表达方式，因此已经磨损了。

units.en: Examples include "Don't put off until tomorrow what you can get done today!" and "It's raining cats and dogs!"
units.zh: 例子包括“不要推迟到明天你今天能完成的事情！” 和“下雨了猫狗！”

units.en: Instead of using clichés, be original.
units.zh: 与其使用陈词滥调，不如原创。

units.en: Think of new figures of speech to add interest to your narrative writing.
units.zh: 想想新的修辞格，为你的叙事写作增添趣味。

units.en: The following sentences are developed from the sentence Sheila replied, "I don't know where he is."
units.zh: 以下句子是从希拉回答的句子中发展出来的：“我不知道他在哪里。”

units.en: With different concrete details, Sheila becomes different kinds of person.
units.zh: 有了不同的具体细节，希拉变成了不同类型的人。

units.en: Discuss with your partner your understanding of what kind of person Sheila is in each context.
units.zh: 与您的伴侣讨论您在每种情况下对希拉是什么样的人的理解。

units.en: 1) Sheila rolled her eyes and sighed loudly, then threw up her hands in exasperation and replied curtly, "I don't know where he is"
units.zh: 1）希拉翻了个白眼，大声叹了口气，然后怒气冲冲地举起双手，简短地回答：“我不知道他在哪里”

units.en: 2) Staring blankly out of the window, Sheila exhaled softly, closed her eyes for a moment and replied, "I don't know where he is."
units.zh: 2) 希拉茫然地盯着窗外，轻轻地呼了一口气，闭上了眼睛，回答说：“我不知道他在哪里。”

units.en: 3) Sheila stared at her mother, teary-eyed, shuddering with fear, and sobbingly replied, "I don't know where he is."
units.zh: 3) 希拉盯着她的母亲，泪流满面，恐惧地颤抖着，抽泣着回答：“我不知道他在哪里。”

units.en: 4) Sheila continued to pass the items over the scanner, staring down at the counter, and without even looking at the customer, replied indifferently, "I don't know where he is."
units.zh: 4) 希拉继续把物品从扫描仪上移过，低头盯着柜台，甚至没有看顾客，冷漠地回答：“我不知道他在哪里。”

units.en: • What is setting?
units.zh: • 什么是设置？

units.en: The setting is the time and place in which a story occurs.
units.zh: 设置是故事发生的时间和地点。

units.en: The setting can be
units.zh: 设置可以是

units.en: imaginary, like the island Neverland in the story of Peter Pan, or can be real.
units.zh: 想象中的，就像彼得潘的故事中的梦幻岛，或者可以是真实的。

units.en: The setting can be determined by the story, or the story can be determined by the setting.
units.zh: 设置可以由故事决定，也可以由设置决定。

units.en: Settings can set the parameters for a story.
units.zh: 设置可以设置故事的参数。

units.en: Even without knowing the plot of a story, being given the location is helpful for readers to make assumptions about characters and events.
units.zh: 即使不知道故事的情节，也有助于读者对人物和事件做出假设。

units.en: For example, in The Story of My Life (Chapter 4) (Text A of Unit 1), the first sentence of the first paragraph (The most important day I remember in all my life is the one on which my teacher, Anne Mansfield Sullivan, came to me.) and the first sentence of the second paragraph (On the afternoon of that eventful day, I stood on the porch, dumb, expectant.) arouse the reader' interest in knowing why that day was important and what happened to Helen who stood on the porch.
units.zh: 例如，在我的生活故事（第 4 章）（第 1 单元的文本 A）中，第一段的第一句话（我一生中最重要的一天是我的老师安妮·曼斯菲尔德·沙利文（Anne Mansfield Sullivan）来找我的那一天。）和第二段的第一句话 段落（在那个多事的日子的下午，我站在门廊上，哑巴，期待。）引起了读者的兴趣，了解为什么那一天很重要，以及站在门廊上的海伦发生了什么事。

units.en: In "After Twenty Years" (Text A of Unit 2), O. Henry starts the story with the sentence The policeman on the beat moved up the avenue impressively.
units.zh: 在“二十年后”（第 2 单元的文本 A）中，O. 亨利以句子上的警察令人印象深刻地向上移动的句子开始了故事。

units.en: This sentence introduces the general setting of the story—the avenue.
units.zh: 这句话介绍了故事的一般背景——大道。

units.en: Then the author describes the habitual action of a policeman until he slowed his walk:
units.zh: 然后作者描述了警察的习惯性行为，直到他放慢了行走：

units.en: When about midway of a certain block the policeman suddenly slowed his walk.
units.zh: 大约在某个街区的中间时，警察突然放慢了他的行走速度。

units.en: In the doorway of a darkened hardware store a man leaned, with an unlighted cigar in his mouth.
units.zh: 在一家黑暗的五金店门口，一个男人靠在嘴里，嘴里含着一支没有发光的雪茄。

units.en: As the policeman walked up to him the man spoke up quickly.
units.zh: 当警察走到他身边时，男人迅速开口。

units.en: The policeman's stop brings out the specific setting and the protagonists of the
units.zh: 警察的停止带出了具体的场景和主角

units.en: story.
units.zh: 故事。

units.en: We really want to know what the man and the policeman are going to talk about.
units.zh: 我们真的很想知道那个人和警察要谈什么。

units.en: Read the following passages and find the answers to the questions:

units.en: Passage 1
units.zh: 第 1 段

units.en: The air was hot and dry in the Arizona desert.
units.zh: 亚利桑那州沙漠中的空气又热又干。

units.en: It had been a two-hour ride into Rio
units.zh: 去里约需要两个小时的车程

units.en: Verde, not so much a town as a collection of leaning walls and sagging roofs.
units.zh: 佛得角，与其说是一个小镇，不如说是倾斜墙壁和下垂屋顶的集合。

units.en: Two saloons, a general store, a barbershop and a livery stable.
units.zh: 两个沙龙，一家杂货店，一家理发店和一个制服马厩。

units.en: No bank, no jail and no obvious reason to exist, Rio Verde was either dying or waiting to be reborn.
units.zh: 没有银行，没有监狱，也没有明显的存在理由，里约佛得德要么死去，要么等待重生。

units.en: Passage 2

units.en: The brownstones of East 23rd Street shook every ten minutes as the elevated train passed behind them.
units.zh: 当高架列车从他们身后经过时，东 23 街的褐砂石每十分钟就摇晃一下。

units.en: Children played on the sidewalk and in the street, while mothers stood in doorways or sat on concrete stairs telling stories about the women over on 10th, where the homes had yards and the children played inside.
units.zh: 孩子们在人行道和街上玩耍，而母亲们则站在门口或坐在混凝土楼梯上，讲述 10 日妇女的故事，那里的房屋有院子，孩子们在里面玩耍。

units.en: By the time he was within a few leagues of his home, he was almost exhausted
units.zh: 当他在离家的几个联赛范围内时，他几乎已经筋疲力尽了

units.en: with cold and fatigue.
units.zh: 带着寒冷和疲劳。

units.en: Though he knew it would take some hours to get through the forest, he resolved to go on.
units.zh: 虽然他知道穿越森林需要几个小时，但他还是决定继续前进。

units.en: But night overtook him, and the deep snow and bitter frost made it impossible for his horse to carry him any farther.
units.zh: 但夜晚超越了他，深雪和寒霜使他的马无法将他带到更远的地方。

units.en: Not a house was to be seen.
units.zh: 没有房子可以看到。

units.en: The only shelter he could get was the hollow trunk
units.zh: 他唯一能得到的避难所是空心树干

units.en: of a great tree, and there he crouched all the night, which seemed to him the longest he had ever known.
units.zh: 一棵大树，他整夜蹲在那里，在他看来，这似乎是他所知道的最长的。

units.en: The howling of the wolves kept him awake, and even when at last the day broke, he was not much better off, for the falling snow had covered up every path, and he did not know which way to turn.
units.zh: 狼的嚎叫让他保持清醒，即使最后一天破了，他也好不了多少，因为飘落的雪已经覆盖了每一条路，他不知道该转向哪条路。

units.en: At length he made out some sort of path, but it was so rough and slippery that he fell down more than once.
units.zh: 最后，他走出了某种道路，但它是如此粗糙和滑溜，以至于他不止一次摔倒。

units.en: Presently it led him into an avenue of trees which ended in a splendid castle.
units.zh: 不久，它把他带到了一条树木大道，这条大道变成了一座壮丽的城堡。

units.en: It
units.zh: 它

units.en: 60 Writing Critically 1

units.en: seemed to the merchant very strange that no snow had fallen in the avenue, which was entirely composed of orange trees, covered with flowers and fruit.
units.zh: 对商人来说，这似乎很奇怪，大道上没有下雪，那里完全由橙树组成，上面覆盖着鲜花和水果。

units.en: When he reached the first court of the castle, he saw before him a flight of agate steps.
units.zh: 当他到达城堡的第一个宫廷时，他看到了他面前的一道玛瑙台阶。

units.en: He went up them and passed through several splendidly furnished rooms.
units.zh: 他上去，穿过几间布置精美的房间。

units.en: The pleasant warmth of the air revived him, and he felt very hungry; but there
units.zh: 空气中愉悦的温暖使他恢复了活力，他感到非常饥饿； 但那里

units.en: seemed to be nobody in all this vast and splendid palace.
units.zh: 在这广阔而壮丽的宫殿中，似乎没有人。

units.en: Deep silence reigned everywhere, and at last, tired of roaming through empty rooms and galleries, he stopped in a room smaller than the rest, where a clear fire was burning, and a couch was drawn up cozily before it.
units.zh: 到处都是深沉的寂静，终于，他厌倦了在空荡荡的房间和画廊里漫游，他停在一个比其他房间小的房间里，那里有一层清晰的火在燃烧，沙发在它面前舒适地被拉起。

units.en: Thinking this must be prepared for someone who was expected, he sat down to wait till he should come and very soon fell into a sweet sleep
units.zh: 认为这必须为一个预期的人准备好，他坐下来等到他应该来，很快就进入了甜蜜的睡眠

units.en: Then his extreme hunger wakened him after several hours.
units.zh: 然后他极度的饥饿感在几个小时后唤醒了他。

units.en: He was still alone,
units.zh: 他还是一个人，

units.en: but a little table, with a good dinner on it, had been drawn up close to him.
units.zh: 但是一张小桌子，上面有一顿丰盛的晚餐，已经被拉到了他的身边。

units.en: He lost no time in beginning his meal, hoping he might soon thank his considerate host, whoever it might be.
units.zh: 他不失时机地开始吃饭，希望他能尽快感谢他体贴的主人，无论是谁。

units.en: But no one appeared, and even after another long sleep, from which he awoke completely refreshed, there was no sign of anybody, though a fresh meal of dainty cakes and fruit was prepared upon the little table at his elbow.
units.zh: 但没有人出现，即使在他醒来的又一次长时间的睡眠中完全清醒过来，也没有任何人的迹象，尽管在他肘部的小桌子上准备了一顿新鲜的蛋糕和水果。

units.en: Because he was naturally timid, the silence began to terrify him, and he resolved
units.zh: 因为他天生胆小，沉默开始吓坏他，他下定决心

units.en: to search once more through all the rooms; but it was of no use; there was no sign of life in the palace!
units.zh: 再次搜索所有房间； 但这没有用； 宫殿里没有生命的迹象！

units.en: He wondered what he should do.
units.zh: 他想知道他应该怎么做。

units.en: To amuse himself, he began pretending that all the treasures he saw were his own and considering how he would divide them among his children.
units.zh: 为了自娱自乐，他开始假装他看到的所有宝藏都是他自己的，并考虑如何将它们分割给他的孩子。

units.en: Then he went down into the garden, and though it was winter everywhere else, here the sun shone, the birds sang, the flowers bloomed, and the air was soft and sweet.
units.zh: 然后他下到花园里，虽然到了其他地方的冬天，但这里的太阳照耀着，鸟儿在歌唱，鲜花盛开，空气柔软而甜美。

units.en: The merchant, in ecstasies with all he saw and heard, said to himself: "All this must be meant for me. I will go this minute and bring my children to share all these delights."
units.zh: 商人对他所看到和听到的一切感到欣喜若狂，对自己说：“这一切都必须是给我的。我会走到这一刻，带着我的孩子们分享所有这些乐趣。”

units.en: In spite of being so cold and weary when he reached the castle, he had taken his
units.zh: 到了城堡时，他既冷又疲惫，他把他的

units.en: horse to the stable and fed it.
units.zh: 马去马厩喂它。

units.en: Now he thought he would saddle it for his homeward journey, and he turned down the path which led to the stable.
units.zh: 现在他以为他会为他的回家之旅加鞍，他推倒了通往马厩的小路。

units.en: This path had a hedge of roses on each side of it, and the merchant thought he had never seen such exquisite flowers.
units.zh: 这条路两边都有一片玫瑰，商人以为他从来没有见过这么精致的花。

units.en: They reminded him of his promise to Beauty, and he stopped and had just gathered one to take to her when he was startled by a strange noise behind him.
units.zh: 他们让他想起了他对美的应许，他停下来，刚刚召集了一个，就被他身后的奇怪声音吓了一跳。

units.en: • What is the relationship between the setting and sensory details?
units.zh: • 设置和感官细节之间的关系是什么？

units.en: A key part of Sigmund Freud's theory of psychoanalysis has to do with the idea of transference.
units.zh: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的精神分析理论的一个关键部分与移情的概念有关。

units.en: The idea is that we commonly take emotions that we are feeling and transfer them onto other people.
units.zh: 这个想法是我们通常接受我们感受到的情绪并将它们转移到其他人身上。

units.en: This is exactly what we do in writing.
units.zh: 这正是我们在写作中所做的。

units.en: We take emotional meaning and transfer it onto people, places or things.
units.zh: 我们将情感意义转移到人、地方或事物上。

units.en: Therefore, with "Little Red Riding Hood," a walk in the woods becomes much more than just that—it becomes filled with emotional as well as physical danger and the potential loss of innocence.
units.zh: 因此，在“小红帽”中，在树林中散步不仅仅是这样——它变得充满了情感和身体上的危险和潜在的纯真丧失。

units.en: Therefore, in writing, we transfer complex emotions onto the sensory objects and events we have chosen to render in the story.
units.zh: 因此，以书面形式，我们将复杂的情感转移到我们选择在故事中呈现的感官对象和事件上。

units.en: Hence, sensory
units.zh: 因此，感觉

units.en: details allow readers to put themselves in a particular setting mentally by forming a picture in their mind.
units.zh: 细节允许读者通过在他们的脑海中形成一幅画面，将自己置于特定的环境中。

units.en: Without sensory details, readers would become bored and cannot be emotionally connected to the story.
units.zh: 没有感官细节，读者会变得无聊，无法与故事建立情感联系。

units.en: When we read the following paragraph, we can picture the scene in which a blind young girl (Helen Keller) was acting and thinking with the aid of those sensory details.
units.zh: 当我们阅读以下段落时，我们可以想象一个盲人年轻女孩（海伦凯勒）在这些感官细节的帮助下行动和思考的场景。

units.en: On the afternoon of that eventful day, I stood on the porch, dumb, expectant.
units.zh: 在那个多事的一天的下午，我站在门廊上，哑巴，期待。

units.en: guessed vaguely from my mother's signs and from the hurrying to and fro in the house that something unusual was about to happen, so I went to the door and waited on the steps.
units.zh: 从我母亲的标志和房子里的匆忙来回猜测，有些不寻常的事情即将发生，所以我走到门口等着台阶。

units.en: The afternoon sun penetrated the mass of honeysuckle that covered the porch, and fell on my upturned face.
units.zh: 午后的阳光穿透了覆盖门廊的金银花，落在了我仰起的脸上。

units.en: My fingers lingered almost unconsciously on the familiar leaves and blossoms which had just come forth to greet the sweet southern spring.
units.zh: 我的手指几乎无意识地徘徊在刚刚出来迎接甜蜜的南方春天的熟悉的树叶和花朵上。

units.en: I did not know what the future held of—marvel or surprise for me.
units.zh: 我不知道未来会发生什么——对我来说是惊叹或惊喜。

units.en: Anger and bitterness had preyed upon me continually for weeks and a deep languor had succeeded this passionate struggle.
units.zh: 愤怒和苦涩持续了数周，一直持续着，深深的疲惫已经成功地成功了这场激烈的斗争。

units.en: In "After Twenty Years," O. Henry does not provide a lengthy description about the setting.
units.zh: 在“二十年后”中，O. Henry 没有提供关于该环境的冗长描述。

units.en: But the concrete information given (such as the words in bold below) works well for readers in terms of situating the story:
units.zh: 但是给出的具体信息（例如下面的粗体字）对读者的定位效果很好：

units.zh: 乔布雷迪餐厅。

units.en: At the corner stood a drug store, brilliant with electric lights.
units.zh: 角落里有一家药店，电灯亮丽。

units.en: On rocky islands gulls woke.

units.en: Time to be about their business.
units.zh: 是时候谈谈他们的生意了。

units.en: Silently they
units.zh: 他们默默地

units.zh: 太阳照进来

units.en: horizontally from the east, flashing upon weathervanes-brass cocks and arrows, here a glass-eyed Indian, there a copper grasshopper-and the bells in the steeples cling-clanged, telling the people it was time to be up and about.
units.zh: 水平地从东方，在风向标黄铜公鸡和箭头上闪烁，这里是一个玻璃眼睛的印第安人，那里有一个铜蚱蜢——尖顶上的钟声紧紧地夹着，告诉人们是时候起床了。

units.en: • What is the relationship between the setting and characters?
units.zh: • 设置和字符之间的关系是什么？

units.en: The setting is an integral part of the whole story.
units.zh: 设置是整个故事不可或缺的一部分。

units.en: Settings affect characters' actions and feelings.
units.zh: 设置会影响角色的行为和感受。

units.en: It is often found that locations are used to provide clues to a character's mood or as a means of externalizing his or her inner turmoil.
units.zh: 经常发现位置用于提供角色情绪的线索或将其内在动荡的外化方式。

units.en: If you change the setting, you may have a fundamentally different story.
units.zh: 如果您更改设置，您可能会有一个根本不同的故事。

units.en: For example, in "The Necklace," five main settings are given, including Mathilde's apartment, Madame Forestier's place, the palace of the ministry, a shop at the Palais-Royal and the Champs-Elysees.
units.zh: 例如，在“项链”中给出了五个主要设置，包括马蒂尔德的公寓、森林人夫人的地方、事工宫、皇家宫的商店和香榭丽舍大街。

units.en: Mathilde's fate altered with the changing of these settings.
units.zh: 马蒂尔德的命运随着这些设置的变化而改变。

units.en: ACTIVITY 5
units.zh: 活动 5

units.en: The following passages are developed on the basis of the setting "There is an air of mystery in the house."
units.zh: 以下段落是在“房子里有一种神秘的气息”的背景下发展起来的。

units.en: Read and highlight the words and phrases that describe sounds, feelings, smells and sights, and discuss with your partner how these words and phrases can help demonstrate the character's inner world in the setting.
units.zh: 阅读并突出描述声音、感受、气味和景象的单词和短语，并与您的伴侣讨论这些单词和短语如何帮助在场景中展示角色的内心世界。

units.en: Passage I
units.zh: 段落一

units.en: I shivered terribly at the sight of the deserted mansion that stood on the hilltop.
units.zh: 看到山顶上那座荒凉的豪宅，我吓得发抖。

units.en: With much curiosity, I treaded gingerly toward the mansion.
units.zh: 怀着极大的好奇心，我小心翼翼地走向豪宅。

units.en: Suddenly, I heard a distant howl that pierced through the silent night.
units.zh: 突然，我听到一道遥远的嚎叫穿透了寂静的夜晚。

units.en: At my wit's end, I slowly walked toward the mansion.
units.zh: 在我的智慧尽头，我慢慢地走向豪宅。

units.en: My face turned ashen and my hair stood on ends when I got a better view of the spooky mansion.
units.zh: 当我更好地看到幽灵般的豪宅时，我的脸变成了苍白，我的头发站在了头上。

units.en: The wind sent chills down my spine as I walked slowly toward the gigantic door.
units.zh: 当我慢慢地走向巨大的门时，风吹过我的脊椎。

units.en: Passage 2
units.zh: 第 2 段

units.en: Behind the dark alley stood a deserted house.
units.zh: 黑暗的小巷后面是一座荒凉的房子。

units.en: I stood meekly outside the haunted
units.zh: 我温顺地站在闹鬼的外面

units.en: house with my jaws hung open.
units.zh: 我的下巴张开的房子。

units.en: Suddenly, I saw a silhouette of a person in the house.
units.zh: 突然，我在屋子里看到了一个人的轮廓。

units.en: Shivers ran down my spine as I approached the house cautiously.
units.zh: 当我小心翼翼地接近房子时，我的脊椎不寒而栗。

units.en: When 1 reached the
units.zh: 当 1 到达

units.en: Unit 3 Growth and Maturity
units.zh: 单元 3 增长和成熟度

units.en: doorstep, I was paralyzed with fear.
units.zh: 门口，我吓得瘫痪了。

units.en: I muttered uneasily to myself about what was going to happen next as I could feel cold air blowing toward me.
units.zh: 我不安地自言自语地想着接下来会发生什么，因为我能感觉到冷空气向我吹来。

units.en: My face turned ashen when the door opened itself.
units.zh: 当门自己打开时，我的脸变得苍白。

units.en: Passage 3
units.zh: 第 3 段

units.en: I crept behind the house since the door was left ajar.
units.zh: 自从门被半开着，我爬到了房子后面。

units.en: The whole place was covered with dust and cobwebs.
units.zh: 整个地方都被灰尘和蜘蛛网覆盖。

units.en: I stood meekly all alone when a big strong wind caused the wooden door to slam hard.
units.zh: 当一阵大风使木门重重地砰砰作响时，我一个人呆呆地站着。

units.en: I was paralyzed with fear.
units.zh: 我因恐惧而瘫痪。

units.en: I picked up my courage and continued walking until I reached a smaller silver door.
units.zh: 我鼓起勇气继续前行，直到我到达一扇较小的银门。

units.en: An eerie scream came from the door and soon, it turned into a howl.
units.zh: 一声怪异的尖叫声从门口传来，很快，它变成了嚎叫。

units.en: I decided to put on a brave front and walk into the room...
units.zh: 我决定穿上勇敢的正面，走进房间……

units.en: Passage 4
units.zh: 第 4 段

units.en: Benjamin's hair stood on ends as the eerie scream pierced through the still night.
units.zh: 当诡异的尖叫穿透了寂静的夜晚时，本杰明的头发竖着。

units.en: The howling of dogs made him stood meekly.
units.zh: 狗的嚎叫让他温柔地站着。

units.en: He treaded gingerly through the dark and scary corridor.
units.zh: 他小心翼翼地穿过黑暗而可怕的走廊。

units.en: He saw a trail of bloodstains on the wall and maggots were crawling all over the place.
units.zh: 他看到墙上有一道血迹，蛆虫到处爬行。

units.en: What Benjamin saw later will be forever etched in his mind.
units.zh: 本杰明后来看到的将永远铭刻在他的脑海中。

units.en: It was the toilet's light flickering.
units.zh: 那是马桶的轻微闪烁。

units.en: The continuous switching of the switch could be heard even when no visible being could be seen doing it.
units.zh: 即使在看不到可见的存在时，也可以听到开关的连续开关。

units.en: He then smelt a strong stench of urine coming from the toilet bowl.
units.zh: 然后他闻到了从马桶里流出的浓烈的尿液。

units.en: ACTIVITY 6
units.zh: 活动 6

units.en: Read the following short story "The Flowers" by Alice Walker and discuss the following questions with your partner:
units.zh: 阅读 Alice Walker 的以下短篇小说《鲜花》，并与您的伴侣讨论以下问题：

units.en: 1) What is the setting?
units.zh: 1) 设置是什么？

units.en: What are the elements in this setting?
units.zh: 这个设置中的要素是什么？

units.en: 2) How does the setting influence the characterization and the plot?
units.zh: 2) 设置如何影响特征和情节？

units.en: 3) What does the author mean by saying "And the summer was over"?
units.zh: 3) 作者所说的“夏天结束了”是什么意思？

units.en: It seemed to Myop as she skipped lightly from hen house to pigpen to smokehouse that the days had never been as beautiful as these.
units.zh: 在 Myop 看来，当她从 Hen House 到 Pigpen 到 Smokehouse 时，她似乎从未像现在这样美丽。

units.en: The air held a keenness that made her nose twitch.
units.zh: 空气中有一种敏锐的感觉，让她的鼻子抽搐了一下。

units.en: The harvesting of the corn and cotton, peanuts and squash, made each day a golden surprise that caused excited little tremors to run up her jaws.
units.zh: 玉米和棉花、花生和南瓜的收获使每一天都成为一个金色的惊喜，导致她的下巴向上袭来。

units.en: Myop carried a short, knobby stick.
units.zh: Myop 拿着一根短而多节的棍子。

units.en: She struck out at random at chickens she
units.zh: 她随意对她的鸡三发

units.en: liked, and worked out the beat of a song on the fence around the pigpen.
units.zh: 喜欢，并在猪圈周围的栅栏上制作了一首歌的节拍。

units.en: She felt light and good in the warm sun.
units.zh: 在温暖的阳光下，她感到轻松和美好。

units.en: She was ten, and nothing existed for her but her song, the stick clutched in her dark brown hand, and the tat-de-ta-ta-ta of accompaniment.
units.zh: 她十岁，除了她的歌、深棕色的手上抓着的棍子，以及伴奏的达德塔塔塔塔，什么都不存在。

units.en: Turning her back on the rusty boards of her family's sharecropper cabin, Myop
units.zh: 把她背在她家的佃农小屋的生锈板上，Myop

units.en: walked along the fence till it ran into the stream made by the spring.
units.zh: 沿着栅栏走，直到它跑进春天形成的溪流。

units.en: Around the
units.zh: 周围

units.en: 64 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 64 思辨写作 1

units.en: spring, where the family got drinking water, silver ferns and wildflowers grew.
units.zh: 春天，一家人在那里得到了饮用水，银蕨和野花生长。

units.en: Along the shallow banks pigs rooted.
units.zh: 沿着浅滩猪扎根。

units.en: Myop watched the tiny white bubbles disrupt the thin black scale of soil and the water that silently rose and slid away down the stream.
units.zh: Myop 看着微小的白色气泡扰乱了薄薄的黑色土壤和无声地上升和滑下溪流的水。

units.en: She had explored the woods behind the house many times.
units.zh: 她曾多次探索房子后面的树林。

units.en: Often, in late autumn,
units.zh: 很多时候，在深秋

units.en: her mother took her to gather nuts among the fallen leaves.
units.zh: 她的母亲带她在落叶中采摘坚果。

units.en: Today she made her own path, bouncing this way and that way, vaguely keeping an eye out for snakes.
units.zh: 今天她走了自己的路，以这种方式弹跳，隐约地留意着蛇。

units.en: She found, in addition to various common but pretty ferns and leaves, an armful of strange blue flowers with velvety ridges and a sweet suds bush full of the brown, fragrant buds.
units.zh: 除了各种常见但漂亮的蕨类植物和叶子外，她还发现了一大堆奇怪的蓝色花朵，带有天鹅绒般的山脊和满是棕色、芬芳的花蕾的甜蜜灌木丛。

units.en: By twelve o'clock, her arms laden with sprigs of her findings, she was a mile or more from home.
units.zh: 到了十二点钟，她的手臂上长满了她的发现，离家一英里或更远。

units.en: She had often been as far before, but the strangeness of the land made it not as pleasant as her usual haunts.
units.zh: 她以前常常这么远，但这片土地的陌生感使它不像她平时的出没那么令人愉快。

units.en: It seemed gloomy in the little cove in which she found herself.
units.zh: 在她发现自己的小海湾里，它似乎是阴沉的。

units.en: The air was damp, the silence close and deep.
units.zh: 空气是潮湿的，寂静又近又深。

units.en: Myop began to circle back to the house, back to the peacefulness of the morning
units.zh: Myop开始转身回到房子里，回到早晨的宁静

units.en: It was then she stepped smack into his eyes.
units.zh: 就在这时，她猛地一拍他的眼睛。

units.en: Her heel became lodged in the broken ridge between brow and nose, and she reached down quickly, unafraid, to free herself.
units.zh: 她的脚后跟陷在眉头和鼻子之间的破裂脊上，她迅速伸手，不怕地伸手解脱。

units.en: It was only when she saw his naked grin that she gave a little yelp of surprise.
units.zh: 只有当她看到他赤裸的笑容时，她才发出一声惊讶的叫喊。

units.en: He had been a tall man.
units.zh: 他是个高个子。

units.en: From feet to neck covered a long space.
units.zh: 从脚到脖子覆盖了一个长的空间。

units.en: His head lay
units.zh: 他的头躺着

units.en: beside him.
units.zh: 在他身边。

units.en: When she pushed back the leaves and layers of earth and debris Myop saw that hed had large white teeth, all of them cracked or broken, long fingers, and very big bones.
units.zh: 当她推回叶子和层层土和碎片时，Myop 看到他有大白牙，所有的牙齿都裂开或断裂，手指长，骨头很大。

units.en: All his clothes had rotted away except some threads of blue denim from his overalls.
units.zh: 除了他的工作服上的一些蓝色牛仔布外，他所有的衣服都已经腐烂了。

units.en: The buckles of the overall had turned green.
units.zh: 整体的扣环已经变成绿色。

units.en: Myop gazed around the spot with interest.
units.zh: Myop感兴趣地环顾四周。

units.en: Very near where shed stepped into the
units.zh: 非常靠近棚子踏入的地方

units.en: head was a wild pink rose.
units.zh: 头是一朵狂野的粉红色玫瑰。

units.en: As she picked it to add to her bundle she noticed a raised mound, a ring, around the roses root.
units.zh: 当她挑选它添加到她的捆绑中时，她注意到玫瑰根周围有一个凸起的土堆，一个环。

units.en: It was the rotted remains of a noose, a bit of shredding plowline, now blending benignly into the soil.
units.zh: 那是一个绞索的腐烂残骸，一点碎的犁线，现在和谐地融入了土壤中。

units.en: Around an overhanging limb of a great spreading oak clung another piece.
units.zh: 围绕着一块巨大的铺开的橡木的悬垂的树枝紧贴着另一块。

units.en: Frayed, rotted, bleached, and frazzled— barely there—but spinning restlessly in the breeze.
units.zh: 磨损、腐烂、漂白和疲惫——几乎没有——但在微风中不安地旋转。

units.en: Myop laid down her flowers.
units.zh: 米奥普放下她的花。

units.en: And the summer was over.
units.zh: 夏天结束了。

units.en: ACTIVITY 7
units.zh: 活动 7

units.en: Read the following excerpt from Chapter 6 of The Secret Garden.
units.zh: 阅读《秘密花园》第 6 章的以下摘录。

units.en: Mary went to live with her uncle Mr. Archibald Craven in a big house after her parents died.
units.zh: 在她的父母去世后，玛丽和她的叔叔阿奇博尔德·克雷文先生一起住在一个大房子里。

units.en: She was exploring the rooms in the house when she heard someone's crying.
units.zh: 当她听到有人在哭泣时，她正在探索房子里的房间。

units.en: Pay attention to how the setting adds to the mystery of the big house and thus enhances the characterization of another character in the story: Colin Craven, the son of Mr. Craven, who is going to be introduced in the following chapters.
units.zh: 注意场景如何增加大房子的神秘感，从而增强了故事中另一个角色的特征：科林·克雷文，克拉文先生的儿子，他将在以下章节中介绍。

units.en: She opened the door of the room and went into the corridor, and then she began her wanderings.
units.zh: 她打开房间的门，走进走廊，然后开始流浪。

units.en: It was a long corridor and it branched into other corridors and it led her up short flights of steps which mounted to others again.
units.zh: 那是一条长长的走廊，它延伸到其他走廊，它带领她走上了短暂的台阶，这些台阶再次安装在其他人身上。

units.en: There were doors and doors,
units.zh: 有门和门，

units.en: Unit 3 Growth and Maturity
units.zh: 单元 3 增长和成熟度

units.en: and there were pictures on the walls.
units.zh: 墙上有照片。

units.en: Sometimes they were pictures of dark, curious landscapes, but oftenest they were portraits of men and women in queer, grand costumes made of satin and velvet.
units.zh: 有时它们是黑暗、好奇的风景的照片，但通常它们是穿着缎子和天鹅绒制成的古怪的男人和女人的肖像。

units.en: She found herself in one long gallery whose walls were covered with these portraits.
units.zh: 她发现自己在一个长长的画廊里，墙上挂满了这些肖像。

units.en: She had never thought there could be so many in any house.
units.zh: 她从没想过任何房子里会有这么多。

units.en: She walked slowly down this place and stared at the faces which also seemed to stare at her.
units.zh: 她慢慢地走下这个地方，盯着似乎也盯着她看的脸。

units.en: She felt as if they were wondering what a little girl from India was doing in their house.
units.zh: 她觉得他们好像在想一个来自印度的小女孩在他们家做什么。

units.en: Some were pictures of children-little girls in thick satin frocks which reached to their feet and stood out about them, and boys with puffed sleeves and lace collars and long hair, or with big ruffs around their necks.
units.zh: 有些是孩子们的照片——穿着厚实的缎面连衣裙的小女孩的照片，站在他们的脚边，站在他们周围，有泡泡的袖子，蕾丝领和长发，或者脖子上戴着大褶边的男孩的照片。

units.en: She always stopped to look at the children, and wonder what their names were, and where they had gone, and why they wore such odd clothes.
units.zh: 她总是停下来看着孩子们，想知道他们的名字是什么，他们去了哪里，以及他们为什么穿这么奇怪的衣服。

units.en: There was a stiff, plain little girl rather like herself.
units.zh: 有一个僵硬、朴素的小女孩，就像她自己一样。

units.en: She wore a green brocade dress and held a green parrot on her finger.
units.zh: 她穿着一件绿色的锦缎连衣裙，手指上拿着一只绿色的鹦鹉。

units.en: Her eyes had a sharp, curious look "Where do you live now?" said Mary aloud to her.
units.zh: 她的眼神尖锐而好奇的神色：“你现在住在哪里？” 玛丽大声对她说。

units.en: "I wish you were here."
units.zh: “我希望你在这里。”

units.en: Surely no other little girl ever spent such a queer morning.
units.zh: 当然，没有其他小女孩曾经度过过这样一个奇怪的早晨。

units.en: It seemed as if there was
units.zh: 好像有

units.en: no one in all the huge rambling house but her own small self, wandering about upstairs and down, through narrow passages and wide ones, where it seemed to her that no one but herself had ever walked.
units.zh: 除了她自己的小自我，在所有巨大的漫无边际的房子里，没有人在楼上和楼下，穿过狭窄的通道和宽阔的通道，在她看来，除了她自己之外没有人走过。

units.en: Since so many rooms had been built, people must have lived in them, but it all seemed so empty that she could not quite believe it true.
units.zh: 既然有这么多房间建成，人们一定住在那里，但一切似乎都如此空虚，以至于她无法完全相信这是真的。

units.en: It was not until she climbed to the second floor that she thought of turning the handle of a door.
units.zh: 直到她爬到二楼，她才想转动一扇门的把手。

units.en: All the doors were shut, as Mrs. Medlock had said they were, but at last she put her hand on the handle of one of them and turned it.
units.zh: 正如梅德洛克夫人所说，所有的门都关上了，但最后她把手放在其中一个的把手上转动了。

units.en: She was almost frightened for a moment when she felt that it turned without difficulty and that when she pushed upon the door itself it slowly and heavily opened.
units.zh: 当她感觉到它毫无困难地转动时，她几乎吓了一跳，当她推开门本身时，它缓慢而重重地打开了。

units.en: It was a massive door and opened into a big bedroom.
units.zh: 这是一扇巨大的门，通向一间大卧室。

units.en: There were embroidered hangings on the wall, and inlaid furniture such as she had seen in India stood about the room.
units.zh: 墙上挂着刺绣，她在印度看到的镶嵌家具矗立在房间周围。

units.en: A broad window with leaded panes looked out upon the moor; and over the mantel was another portrait of the stiff, plain little girl who seemed to stare at her more curiously than ever.
units.zh: 一扇宽阔的窗户，有铅板，望向荒野； 壁炉架上是另一个僵硬、朴素的小女孩的肖像，她似乎比以往任何时候都更奇怪地盯着她看。

units.en: "Perhaps she slept here once" said Mary.
units.zh: “也许她睡在这里一次”玛丽说。

units.en: "She stares at me so that she makes me feel queer."
units.zh: “她盯着我看，让我觉得很奇怪。”

units.en: After that she opened more doors and more.
units.zh: 在那之后，她打开了更多的门等等。

units.en: She saw so many rooms that she became
units.zh: 她看到了这么多房间，她变成了

units.en: quite tired and began to think that there must be a hundred, though she had not counted them.
units.zh: 很累，开始认为一定有一百个，虽然她没有数过。

units.en: In all of them there were old pictures or old tapestries with strange scenes worked on them.
units.zh: 在所有这些中，都有旧照片或旧挂毯，上面有奇怪的场景。

units.en: There were curious pieces of furniture and curious ornaments in nearly all of them.

units.en: Write a story in no less than 300 words, paying attention to the relationship

units.en: between the setting and the character's actions or emotions.

units.en: Step A: Recall your personal experience or any stories you have read and then write down the main ideas about it.
units.zh: 步骤A：回忆你的个人经历或你读过的任何故事，然后写下关于它的主要想法。

units.en: Step B: On a separate sheet of paper, brainstorm a list of details related to the main ideas.
units.zh: 步骤 B：在另一张纸上，集思广益，列出与主要思想相关的细节。

units.en: Think about where your experience or the story took place and what you or the character did Step C: Organize your list of details into who, when, where and what.

units.en: Then think of your story by considering the following questions: Who was the character?
units.zh: 然后考虑以下问题来思考你的故事：这个角色是谁？

units.en: Where was the character?
units.zh: 角色在哪里？

units.en: What did the character do?
units.zh: 角色做了什么？

units.en: What do you want to convey through this story?
units.zh: 你想通过这个故事传达什么？

units.en: Finally, write an outline for your story.
units.zh: 最后，为你的故事写一个大纲。

units.en: In some stories the setting is incidental, simply providing a backdrop for the action.
units.zh: 在某些故事中，设置是偶然的，只是为动作提供了背景。

units.en: Stories that are primarily concerned with a character's thoughts and feelings—an inner landscape-are not dependent on the setting.
units.zh: 主要关注角色的思想和感受的故事——内在的景观——不依赖于环境。

units.en: However, we often find that locations are used to provide clues to a character's mood or as a means of externalizing inner turmoil.
units.zh: 然而，我们经常发现位置被用来为角色的情绪提供线索或将内在动荡的一种方式外化。

units.en: In other stories the setting is integral.
units.zh: 在其他故事中，设置是不可或缺的。

units.en: The change of the setting may result in another story.
units.zh: 设置的变化可能会导致另一个故事。

units.en: A carefully realized setting can develop a readers belief in the story through the inclusion of details that provide clues to a place or period.
units.zh: 仔细实现的环境可以通过包含为某个地方或时期提供线索的细节来培养读者对故事的信念。

units.en: Read the following texts and consider the questions: Is the setting integral to the story or merely a backdrop?
units.zh: 阅读以下文本并考虑问题：设置是故事的组成部分还是仅仅是背景？

units.en: How does the setting influence the mood of the characters or highlight the conflict?
units.zh: 设置如何影响角色的情绪或突出冲突？

units.en: What is the significance of the setting?
units.zh: 设置的意义是什么？

units.en: How do shifts in the setting impact on the story?
units.zh: 设置中的转变如何影响故事？

units.en: She was holding the can with the porcupine grease.
units.zh: 她用豪猪油脂拿着罐头。

units.en: "I'm going to have something to eat," she said coolly.
units.zh: “我要吃点东西，”她冷冷地说。

units.en: "You kids can't have any yet. And I don't want any squalling, mind""
units.zh: “你们这些孩子还不能有。我不想让任何人吵闹，介意”

units.en: It was a cruel thing, what she did then.
units.zh: 这是一件残酷的事情，她当时做了什么。

units.en: She sliced that big, solid mushroom and heated grease in a pan.
units.zh: 她在平底锅里切了那个又大又硬的蘑菇和加热的油脂。

units.en: The smell of it brought the little girls out of their quilt, but she told them to go back in so fierce a voice that they obeyed.
units.zh: 它的气味把小女孩从被子里拿出来，但她告诉她们回去用如此凶猛的声音回去，以至于她们服从了。

units.en: They cried to break your heart.
units.zh: 他们哭着要伤你的心。

units.en: I didn't cry.
units.zh: 我没有哭。

units.en: I watched, hating her.
units.zh: 我看着，恨她。

units.en: I endured the smell of the mushroom frying as long as I could.
units.zh: 我尽可能长时间地忍受着蘑菇煎炸的味道。

units.en: Then I said, "Give me some."
units.zh: 然后我说：“给我一些。”

units.en: "Tomorrow," Mary answered.
units.zh: “明天，”玛丽回答。

units.en: "Tomorrow, maybe. But not tonight."
units.zh: “明天，也许吧。但不是今晚。”

units.en: She turned to me with a sharp command: "Don't bother me! Just leave me be."
units.zh: 她用尖锐的命令转向我：“别打扰我！让我去吧。”

units.en: She knelt there by the fire and finished frying the slice of mushroom.
units.zh: 她跪在那里，把蘑菇片煎完。

units.en: If I'd had Pa's rifle, I'd have been willing to kill her right then and there.
units.zh: 如果我有 PA 的步枪，我会愿意当场杀死她。

units.en: She didn't eat right away.
units.zh: 她没有马上吃。

units.en: She looked at the brown, fried slice for a while and
units.zh: 她看了看棕色油炸片片刻，然后

units.en: said, "By tomorrow morning, I guess you can tell whether you want any."
units.zh: 说：“到明天早上，我想你可以判断你是否想要任何东西。”

units.en: The little girls stared at her as she ate.
units.zh: 小女孩们一边吃饭一边盯着她看。

units.en: Sarah was chewing an old leather glove.
units.zh: 莎拉正在咀嚼旧皮手套。

units.en: When Mary crawled into the quilts with them, they moved away as far as they could get.
units.zh: 当玛丽和他们一起爬进被子时，他们尽可能地搬走了。

units.en: I was so scared that my stomach heaved, empty as it was.
units.zh: 我很害怕，我的胃像它一样起伏，空虚。

units.en: Mary didn't stay in the quilts long.
units.zh: 玛丽没有在被子里呆太久。

units.en: She took a drink out of the water bucket
units.zh: 她从水桶里喝了一杯

units.en: and sat down by the fire and looked through the smoke at me.
units.zh: 坐在火边坐下，透过烟雾看着我。

units.en: She said in a low voice, "I don't know how it will be if it's poison. Just do the best you can with the girls. Because your pa will come back, you know... You better go to bed. I'm going to sit up."
units.zh: 她低声说：“我不知道如果它是毒药会怎么样。尽你所能和女孩们在一起。因为你的爸爸会回来，你知道……你最好去睡觉。我要坐起来。”

units.en: And so would you sit up.
units.zh: 你也会坐起来。

units.en: If it might be your last night on earth and the pain
units.zh: 如果这可能是你在地球上的最后一晚和痛苦

units.en: of death might seize you at any moment, you would sit up by the smoky fire, wide awake, remembering whatever you had to remember, savoring life.
units.zh: 死亡可能随时抓住你，你会坐在烟雾缭绕的火焰旁，完全清醒，记住你必须记住的任何东西，享受生命。

units.en: We sat in silence after the girls had gone to sleep.
units.zh: 女孩们睡着后，我们默默地坐着。

units.en: Once I asked, "How long does it take?"
units.zh: 有一次我问：“需要多长时间？”

units.en: "I never heard," she answered.
units.zh: “我从来没有听说过，”她回答。

units.en: "Don't think about it"
units.zh: “不要想它”

units.en: I slept after a while, with my chin on my chest.
units.zh: 过了一会儿，我的下巴放在胸前睡着了。

units.en: Maybe Peter dozed that way at Gethsemane as the Lord knelt praying.
units.zh: 也许彼得在主跪着祈祷时在客西马尼园打瞌睡。

units.en: Mary's moving around brought me wide awake.
units.zh: 玛丽的移动让我完全清醒。

units.en: The black of night was
units.zh: 黑夜是

units.en: fading.
units.zh: 褪色。

units.en: "I guess it's all right," Mary said.
units.zh: “我想没关系，”玛丽说。

units.en: "I'd be able to tell by now, wouldn't I?"
units.zh: “我现在可以说出来了，不是吗？”

units.en: I answered gruffly, "I don't know."
units.zh: 我粗暴地回答：“我不知道。”

units.en: Mary stood in the doorway for a while, looking out at the dripping world as if she found it beautiful.
units.zh: 玛丽在门口站了一会儿，看着滴水的世界，好像她觉得它很漂亮。

units.en: Then she fried slices of the mushroom while the little girls danced with anxiety.
units.zh: 然后她炸了蘑菇片，小女孩们因焦虑而跳舞。

units.en: We feasted, we three, my sisters and I, until Mary ruled, "That'll hold you," and would not cook any more.
units.zh: 我们吃饱了，我们三个，我和我的姐妹，直到玛丽统治着“那会抓住你”，并且不会再做饭了。

units.en: She didn't touch any of the mushroom herself.
units.zh: 她自己没有碰任何蘑菇。

units.en: That was a strange day in the moldy cabin.
units.zh: 在发霉的小屋里，那是一个奇怪的日子。

units.en: Mary laughed and was gay; she
units.zh: 玛丽笑了，是同性恋； 她

units.en: told stories, and we played "Who's Got the Thimble?" with a pine cone.
units.zh: 讲故事，我们播放了“谁有顶针？” 用松果。

units.en: In the afternoon we heard a shout, and my sisters screamed and I ran ahead
units.zh: 下午我们听到一声喊叫，我的姐妹们尖叫着，我跑到前面

units.en: of them across the clearing.
units.zh: 他们穿过空地。

units.en: The rain had stopped.
units.zh: 雨停了。

units.en: My father came plunging out of the woods leading a
units.zh: 我父亲从树林里跳出来，带领一个

units.en: pack horse-and well I remember the treasures of food in that pack.
units.zh: 打包马——我记得那包里有食物的宝藏。

units.en: He glanced at us anxiously as he tore at the ropes that bound the pack.
units.zh: 他焦急地瞥了我们一眼，他撕毁了绑着背包的绳索。

units.en: "Where's the other one?" he demanded.
units.zh: “另一个在哪里？” 他要求。

units.en: Mary came out of the cabin then, walking sedately.
units.zh: 玛丽从小屋里出来，平静地走着。

units.en: As she came toward us,
units.zh: 当她向我们走来时，

units.en: the sun began to shine.
units.zh: 太阳开始发光。

units.en: My stepmother was a wonderful woman.
units.zh: 我的继母是一个很棒的女人。

units.en: Task 3 Writing practice

units.en: 1) Write about Mary's thoughts and feelings in no less than 70 words as she sat up all night waiting to find out if the mushroom was poisonous.
units.zh: 1) 用不少于 70 个字写出玛丽的想法和感受，因为她整夜坐着等待，以了解蘑菇是否有毒。

units.en: 2) Make up a dialogue in no less than 70 words creating a scene that is suggested but does not actually occur in the story, for example, Pa falling in love with Mary, their wedding day or Mary's relationship with her stepson.
units.zh: 2) 用不少于 70 个单词组成一个对话，创造了一个建议但实际上并没有发生在故事中的场景，例如，爸爸爱上了玛丽、他们的婚礼或玛丽与她的继子的关系。

units.en: 3) The story is narrated by an eleven-year-old boy.
units.zh: 3) 故事由一个 11 岁的男孩讲述。

units.en: Rewrite it from Mary's or Pas perspective.
units.zh: 从 Mary 或 PAS 的角度重写它。

units.en: Text B
units.zh: 文本 B

units.en: My Father Sits in the Dark
units.zh: 我父亲坐在黑暗中

units.en: Jerome Weidman
units.zh: 杰罗姆·魏德曼

units.en: My father has a peculiar habit.
units.zh: 我父亲有一个特殊的习惯。

units.en: He is fond of sitting in the dark, alone.
units.zh: 他喜欢独自坐在黑暗中。

units.en: Sometimes I come home very late.
units.zh: 有时我很晚才回家。

units.en: The house is dark.
units.zh: 房子很黑。

units.en: I let myself in quietly because I do not want to disturb my mother.
units.zh: 我让自己安静地进来，因为我不想打扰我的母亲。

units.en: She is a light sleeper.
units.zh: 她是一个轻睡者。

units.en: I tiptoe into my room and undress in the dark.
units.zh: 我踮起脚尖，在黑暗中脱掉衣服。

units.en: I go to the kitchen for a drink of water.
units.zh: 我去厨房喝水。

units.en: My bare feet make no noise.
units.zh: 我的赤脚没有发出任何声音。

units.en: I step into the room and almost trip over my father.
units.zh: 我走进房间，差点绊倒我父亲。

units.en: He is sitting in a kitchen chair, in his pajamas, smoking his pipe.
units.zh: 他坐在厨房的椅子上，穿着睡衣，抽着烟斗。

units.en: "Hello, Pop," I say.
units.zh: “你好，波普，”我说。

units.en: "Hello, son."
units.zh: “你好，儿子。”

units.en: "Why don't you go to bed, Pa?"
units.zh: “你为什么不去睡觉，爸爸？”

units.en: will, he says.
units.zh: 威尔，他说。

units.en: But he remains there.
units.zh: 但他仍然在那里。

units.en: Long after I am asleep I feel sure that he is still sitting there, smoking.
units.zh: 在我睡着很久之后，我确信他还坐在那里，吸烟。

units.en: Many times I am reading in my room.
units.zh: 很多次我在我的房间里读书。

units.en: I hear my mother get the house ready for the night.
units.zh: 我听说我妈妈把房子准备好过夜。

units.en: I hear my kid brother go to bed.
units.zh: 我听说我的小弟弟上床睡觉了。

units.en: I hear my sister come in.
units.zh: 听说姐姐进来了。

units.en: I hear her do things with jars and combs until she, too, is quiet.
units.zh: 我听到她用罐子和梳子做事，直到她也安静下来。

units.en: I know she has gone to sleep.
units.zh: 我知道她已经睡着了。

units.en: In a little while I hear my mother say good night to my father.
units.zh: 一会儿，我听到妈妈对父亲说晚安。

units.en: I continue to read.
units.zh: 我继续阅读。

units.en: Soon I become thirsty.
units.zh: 很快我就变得口渴了。

units.en: (I drink a lot of water.) | go to the kitchen for a drink.
units.zh: （我喝了很多水。） | 去厨房喝一杯。

units.en: Again I almost stumble across my father.
units.zh: 我又一次差点偶然发现我的父亲。

units.en: Many times it startles me. I forget about him.
units.zh: 很多时候它让我大吃一惊。 我忘记了他。

units.en: And there he is-smoking, sitting, thinking.
units.zh: 他在那里吸烟、坐着、思考。

units.en: "Why don't you go to bed, Pop?"
units.zh: “你为什么不去睡觉，波普？”

units.en: "I will, son."
units.zh: “我会的，儿子。”

units.en: But he doesn't.
units.zh: 但他没有。

units.en: He just sits there and smokes and thinks.
units.zh: 他只是坐在那里抽烟和思考。

units.en: It worries me. I can't
units.zh: 它让我担心。 我不能

units.en: understand it.
units.zh: 了解它。

units.en: What can he be thinking about?
units.zh: 他能在想什么？

units.en: Once I asked him.
units.zh: 有一次我问他。

units.en: "What are you thinking about, Pa?"
units.zh: “你在想什么，爸爸？”

units.en: "Nothing," he said.
units.zh: “没什么，”他说。

units.en: Once I left him there and went to bed.
units.zh: 有一次我把他留在那里上床睡觉。

units.en: I awoke several hours later.
units.zh: 几个小时后我醒来。

units.en: I was thirsty.
units.zh: 我很渴。

units.en: I went to the kitchen.
units.zh: 我去了厨房。

units.en: There he was.
units.zh: 他在那里。

units.en: His pipe was out.
units.zh: 他的烟斗没了。

units.en: But he sat there, staring into a corner of the kitchen.
units.zh: 但他坐在那里，盯着厨房的角落。

units.en: After a moment I became accustomed to the darkness.
units.zh: 过了一会儿，我习惯了黑暗。

units.en: I took my drink.
units.zh: 我拿了我的饮料。

units.en: He still sat and stared.
units.zh: 他仍然坐着盯着。

units.en: His eyes did not blink.
units.zh: 他的眼睛没有眨眼。

units.en: I thought he was not even aware of me. I was afraid.
units.zh: 我以为他甚至不知道我。 我很害怕。

units.en: "Why don't you go to bed, Pop?"
units.zh: “你为什么不去睡觉，波普？”

units.en: "I will, son." he said.
units.zh: “我会的，儿子。” 他说。

units.en: "Don't wait up for me." "But," I said, "you've been sitting here for hours.
units.zh: “别等我。” “但是，”我说，“你已经坐了好几个小时了。

units.en: What's wrong?
units.zh: 有什么问题吗?

units.en: What are you
units.zh: 你是什么

units.en: thinking about?"
units.zh: 想着吗？”

units.en: "Nothing, son," he said.
units.zh: “没什么，儿子，”他说。

units.en: "Nothing. It's just restful. That's all."
units.zh: “没什么。这只是安宁。仅此而已。”

units.en: The way he said it was convincing.
units.zh: 他说的方式令人信服。

units.en: He did not seem worried.
units.zh: 他似乎并不担心。

units.en: His voice was
units.zh: 他的声音是

units.en: even and pleasant.
units.zh: 甚至和愉快。

units.en: It always is.
units.zh: 它总是。

units.en: But I could not understand it.
units.zh: 但我无法理解。

units.en: How could it be restful to sit alone in an uncomfortable chair far into the night, in darkness?
units.zh: 一个人坐在一张不舒服的椅子上，在黑暗中，在黑暗中怎么可能是安宁的呢？

units.en: What can it be?
units.zh: 它可以是什么？

units.en: I review all the possibilities.
units.zh: 我回顾了所有的可能性。

units.en: It can't be money.
units.zh: 它不能是钱。

units.en: I know that.
units.zh: 我知道。

units.en: We haven't much,
units.zh: 我们没有太多，

units.en: but when he is worried about money he makes no secret of it.
units.zh: 但当他担心钱时，他并不秘密。

units.en: It can't be his health.
units.zh: 这不可能是他的健康。

units.en: He is not reticent about that either.
units.zh: 他对此也没有沉默寡言。

units.en: It can't be the health of anyone in the family.
units.zh: 这不可能是家庭中任何人的健康。

units.en: We are a bit short on money, but we are long on health.
units.zh: 我们有点缺钱，但我们对健康很长。

units.en: (Knock wood, my mother would say.)
units.zh: （敲木头，我妈妈会说。）

units.en: What can it be?
units.zh: 它可以是什么？

units.en: I am afraid I do not know.
units.zh: 恐怕我不知道。

units.en: But that does not stop me from worrying.
units.zh: 但这并不能阻止我担心。

units.en: Maybe he is thinking of his brothers in the old country.
units.zh: 也许他在想他在旧国家的兄弟。

units.en: Or of his mother and
units.zh: 或他的母亲和

units.en: two stepmothers.
units.zh: 两个继母。

units.en: Or of his father.
units.zh: 或他父亲的。

units.en: But they are all dead.
units.zh: 但他们都死了。

units.en: And he would not brood about them like that.
units.zh: 他不会那样为他们深思。

units.en: I say brood, but it is not really true.
units.zh: 我说母语，但这不是真的。

units.en: He does not brood.
units.zh: 他不沉思。

units.en: He does not even seem to be thinking.
units.zh: 他甚至似乎没有思考。

units.en: He looks too peaceful, too, well not contented, just too peaceful, to be brooding.
units.zh: 他看起来也太平静了，很好，没有满足，太平静，无法沉思。

units.en: Perhaps it is as he says.
units.zh: 也许正如他所说的那样。

units.en: Perhaps it is restful.
units.zh: 也许它是宁静的。

units.en: But it does not seem possible.
units.zh: 但这似乎是不可能的。

units.en: It worries me.
units.zh: 它让我担心。

units.en: If I only knew what he thinks about.
units.zh: 如果我只知道他在想什么。

units.en: If I only knew that he thinks at all.
units.zh: 如果我只知道他是这么想的话。

units.en: I might not be able to help him.

units.en: • Sensory details
