units.en: In Units 1 and 2, we have learned that the characters express their feelings through
units.zh: 在第 1 和第 2 单元中，我们了解到角色通过

units.en: what they say and what they do.
units.zh: 他们说什么和做什么。

units.en: In this unit, we have learned that settings can also
units.zh: 在本单元中，我们了解到设置也可以

units.en: Unit 3 Growth and Maturity 77
units.zh: 单元 3 增长和到期 77

units.en: be greatly helpful in terms of portraying characters and delivering a story's theme.
units.zh: 在描绘人物和传达故事的主题方面非常有帮助。

units.en: When you write a setting, it is better to call upon more, if not all the senses.
units.zh: 当你写一个设置时，最好呼唤更多的东西，如果不是所有的感官的话。

units.en: The first impression the author gives the reader is often what a place looks like-what the narrator sees.
units.zh: 作者给读者的第一印象通常是一个地方的样子——叙述者看到的东西。

units.en: For example, in The Story of My Life (Chapter 4) (Text A of Unit 1), the author presents us the growth or change in herself mainly through physical interactions between herself and her surroundings.
units.zh: 例如，在《我的生活故事》（第 4 章）（第 1 单元的文本 A）中，作者主要通过自己与周围环境之间的身体互动向我们展示了自己的成长或变化。

units.en: Likewise, in "The Selfish Giant" (Text B of Unit 2), sentences such as "It [music] sounded so sweet to his ears that he thought it must be the King's musicians passing by" vividly demonstrate how much the Giant wanted to keep the garden as his own.
units.zh: 同样，在“自私的巨人”（第 2 单元的文本 B）中，诸如“它 [音乐] 在他的耳朵里听起来如此甜美，以至于他认为一定是国王的音乐家路过”等句子生动地展示了巨人想要将花园保持为自己的程度。

units.en: Here are some words that can help to show the five senses:
units.zh: 以下是一些有助于展示五种感官的词语：

units.en: 1) SMELL: rotten, spicy, balmy, musty, putrid, savory, acidic, pungent...
units.zh: 1）气味：腐烂，辛辣，温暖，发霉，腐烂，咸味，酸性，辛辣的...

units.en: 2) TASTE: salty, peppery, repulsive, tart, tangy, delicious, luscious...
units.zh: 2）口味：咸味、辣味、令人厌恶的、酸味的、美味的、美味的、甜美的……

units.en: 3) TOUCH: gentle, aching, tingling, mangy, velvety, rubbery, itchy...
units.zh: 3) 触摸：温柔、疼痛、刺痛、闷热、天鹅绒、橡胶、发痒……

units.en: 4) SOUND: thundering, murmur, crackle, soothing, hissing, shrill, yelp...
units.zh: 4) 声音：雷鸣、低语、噼啪声、舒缓、嘶嘶声、尖叫、叫喊声……

units.en: 5) SIGHT: angular, blurry, transparent, dim, foggy, fluorescent, glowing...
units.zh: 5) 视线：角度、模糊、透明、昏暗、有雾、荧光、发光……

units.zh: • 具体语言 (ii)

units.en: In Unit 2, we discussed the importance of concrete language in writing.
units.zh: 在第 2 单元中，我们讨论了具体语言在写作中的重要性。

units.en: Concrete words improve the quality of writing.
units.zh: 具体的词语可以提高写作质量。

units.en: Using concrete words is a good way to make your description (or telling) believable, visualized and readable.
units.zh: 使用具体的词语是使您的描述（或讲述）可信、可视化和可读性的好方法。

units.en: For example, in "Too Soon a Woman," the author uses simple but concrete words to show us the difficult situation (here the setting) that the boy's family and Mary experienced:
units.zh: 例如，在“过早的女人”中，作者用简单但具体的词向我们展示了男孩的家人和玛丽所经历的困难情况（这里是场景）：

units.en: We left the home place behind, mile by slow mile, heading for the mountains, across the prairie where the wind blew forever.
units.zh: 我们离开了家乡，一路缓慢地走向山脉，穿过草原，风永远吹过。

units.en: At first there were four of us with the one-horse wagon and its skimpy load.
units.zh: 起初，我们四个人带着一匹马车和它的轻便负载。

units.en: Pa and I
units.zh: 爸爸和我

units.en: walked, because I was a big boy of eleven.
units.zh: 走路，因为我是一个十一岁的大男孩。

units.en: My two little sisters romped and trotted until they got tired and had to be boosted up into the wagon bed.
units.zh: 我的两个小姐妹们嬉戏和小跑，直到她们累了，不得不被提升到马车床上。

units.en: Concrete words can be adjectives, adverbs, nouns and especially verbs.
units.zh: 具体的词可以是形容词、副词、名词，尤其是动词。

units.en: Whenever
units.zh: 每当

units.en: you try to create a believable scene, you are doing some description.
units.zh: 您尝试创建一个可信的场景，您正在做一些描述。

units.en: A good description can give readers a clear and vivid picture of the things or events recorded.
units.zh: 一个好的描述可以让读者清楚而生动地了解所记录的事物或事件。

units.en: • What is point of view?
units.zh: • 什么是观点？

units.en: In narrative writing, the author decides what the reader will see and know from the story through choices of point of view.
units.zh: 在叙事写作中，作者通过视角的选择来决定读者将从故事中看到和了解的内容。

units.en: Point of view can generally be defined as who tells the story, how the story is told or the way in which it is narrated.
units.zh: 观点通常可以定义为讲故事的人、故事的讲述方式或叙述的方式。

units.en: The view can be limited to characters' actions or extended to their inner thoughts and feelings.
units.zh: 这种观点可以限于角色的行为或扩展到他们内心的想法和感受。

units.en: The point of view can offer insight into a single character or expand to everyone involved in the story.
units.zh: 观点可以提供对单个角色的洞察力或扩展到参与故事的每个人。

units.en: When you read a story, you may ask: What is the point of view?
units.zh: 当你阅读一个故事时，你可能会问：观点是什么？

units.en: Does the point of view provide me with adequate information or would the story be better with an alternative?
units.zh: 这种观点是否为我提供了足够的信息，或者故事会更好吗？

units.en: How does the point of view work to reveal the characters?
units.zh: 观点如何揭示人物？

units.en: • What are the types of point of view?
units.zh: • 观点的类型有哪些？

units.en: Different people come up with different classifications about the types of point of view in writing.
units.zh: 不同的人以书面形式提出了对观点类型的不同分类。

units.en: First person (D) and third person (he/she/ they) are more frequently used in narrative writing.
units.zh: 第一人称 (D) 和第三人称（他/她/他们）在叙事写作中更常使用。

units.en: Second person is possible and is more commonly seen in business writing and technical writing, and sometimes appears in letters and speeches.
units.zh: 第二人称是可能的，在商业写作和技术写作中更常见，有时出现在信件和演讲中。

units.en: 1. First person point of view
units.zh: 1. 第一人称视角

units.en: In the first person point of view (or personal narration), the narrator, "1," can be
units.zh: 在第一人称视角（或个人叙述）中，叙述者“1”可以是

units.en: the author or one of the characters.
units.zh: 作者或角色之一。

units.en: This kind of narration offers the reader a chance to get an insight into the character's feelings or thoughts.
units.zh: 这种叙述让读者有机会深入了解角色的感受或想法。

units.en: Read the following examples and find out what the "I" refers to in each excerpt.
units.zh: 阅读以下示例并找出每个摘录中“i”指的是什么。

units.en: Example 1
units.zh: 示例 1

units.en: Early on the morning of August 19, 1946, I was born under a clear sky after a violent
units.zh: 1946年8月19日清晨，我出生在晴朗的天空下

units.en: summer storm to a widowed mother in the Julia Chester Hospital in Hope, a town of about six thousand in southwest Arkansas, thirty-three miles east of the Texas border at Texarkana.
units.zh: 夏季风暴对位于阿肯色州西南部约六千人的朱莉娅·切斯特医院（Texarkana）以东 33 英里的地方的朱莉娅·切斯特医院的一位丧偶母亲。

units.en: My mother named me William Jefferson Blythe III after my father, William Jefferson Blythe Jr, one of nine children of a poor farmer in Sherman, Texas, who died when my father was seventeen.
units.zh: 母亲沿用了父亲威廉·杰斐逊·布莱斯二世的名字，给我取名为威廉·杰斐逊·布莱斯三世。父亲是得克萨斯州谢尔曼一个贫穷农民的九个孩子之一；那位农民在父亲十七岁时去世。

units.en: According to his sisters, my father always tried to take care of them, and he grew up to be a handsome, hardworking, fun-loving man.
units.zh: 据他的姐妹们说，我父亲总是试图照顾她们，他长大后成为一个英俊、勤奋、爱玩的人。

units.en: He met my mother at Tri-State Hospital in Shreveport, Louisiana, in 1943, when she was training to be a nurse.
units.zh: 1943 年，他在路易斯安那州什里夫波特的 Tri-State 医院认识了我的母亲，当时她正在接受培训成为一名护士。

units.en: Many times when I was growing up, I asked Mother to tell me the story of their meeting, courting and marriage.
units.zh: 很多时候，我在成长的过程中，请妈妈告诉我他们的相遇、求爱和婚姻的故事。

units.en: Example 2
units.zh: 示例 2

units.en: I was born at Blunderstone, in Suffolk, or "there by," as they say in Scotland.
units.zh: 我出生在萨福克的布勒斯通，或者他们在苏格兰说的“那里”。

units.en: I was a posthumous child.
units.zh: 我是一个死后的孩子。

units.en: My father's eyes had closed upon the light of this world six months, when mine opened on it.
units.zh: 当我的父亲睁开时，我父亲的眼睛已经闭上了这个世界的光明六个月。

units.en: There is something strange to me, even now, in the reflection
units.zh: 即使是现在，在倒影中对我来说也有一些奇怪的东西

units.en: that he never saw me; and something stranger yet in the shadowy remembrance that! have of my first childish associations with his white grave-stone in the churchyard, and of the indefinable compassion l used to feel for it lying out alone there in the dark night, when our little parlor was warm and bright with fire and candle, and the doors of our house were-almost cruelly, it seemed to me sometimes-bolted and locked against it.
units.zh: 他从未见过我； 还有一些更奇怪的东西，但在阴暗的记忆中！ 我的第一次与他在墓地里的白色墓碑和他在墓地里的白色墓碑，以及我曾经在黑暗的夜晚独自在那里感受到的无限的同情心，当我们的小客厅里有着火和蜡烛的温暖和明亮的时候，我们家的门几乎是—— 残酷地，在我看来，它有时会被锁住并锁定在它上面。

units.en: Example 3
units.zh: 示例 3

units.en: When I was well grown, at last, I was sold and taken away, and I never saw her again.
units.zh: 当我长大了，终于，我被卖掉了，我再也没有见过她。

units.en: She was broken-hearted, and so was I, and we cried; but she comforted me as well as she could, and said we were sent into this world for a wise and good purpose, and must do our duties without repining, take our life as we might find it, live it for the best good of others, and never mind about the results; they were not our affair.
units.zh: 她心碎了，我也是，我们哭了； 但她尽可能地安慰我，并说我们被送到这个世界是为了一个明智和好的目的，必须履行我们的职责，不屈不挠，尽我们所能，为他人的最好利益而生活，不要理会结果； 他们不是我们的婚外情。

units.en: She said men who did like this would have a noble and beautiful reward by and by in another world, and although we animals would not go there, to do well and right without reward would give to our brief lives a worthiness and dignity which in itself would be a reward.
units.zh: 她说，这样做的人会在另一个世界中逐步获得高贵而美丽的奖励，尽管我们动物不会去那里，但没有奖赏，做得好，正确，会给我们短暂的生命带来价值和尊严，这本身就是一种奖励。

units.en: She had gathered these things from time to time when she had gone to the Sunday-school with the children, and had laid them up in her memory more carefully than she had done with those other words and phrases; and she had studied them deeply, for her good and ours.
units.zh: 当她和孩子们一起去主日学时，她时不时地收集这些东西，并且比她用其他单词和短语更仔细地将它们放在记忆中。 她已经深入研究了它们，为了她和我们的利益。

units.en: One may see by this that she had a wise and thoughtful head, for all there was so much lightness and vanity in it.
units.zh: 人们可以从中看出，她有一个聪明而深思熟虑的脑袋，尽管其中有如此多的轻盈和虚荣。

units.en: The first excerpt is from former U.S. President Bill Clinton's autobiography My Life.
units.zh: 第一个摘录来自美国前总统比尔克林顿的自传《我的生活》。

units.en: His father died before he was born.
units.zh: 他的父亲在他出生之前就去世了。

units.en: Therefore, he said that "I was born under a clear sky after a violent summer storm to a widowed mother..."
units.zh: 因此，他说：“在一场猛烈的夏日风暴之后，我出生在晴朗的天空下，给一个丧偶的母亲……”

units.en: As part of an autobiography, this "I" refers to the author himself.
units.zh: 作为自传的一部分，这个“我”指的是作者本人。

units.en: The second excerpt is from the English writer Charles Dickens' novel David Copperfield.
units.zh: 第二个摘录来自英国作家查尔斯·狄更斯的小说大卫·科波菲尔。

units.en: David Copperfield, the main character, the "T" in the novel, said that "I was a posthumous child. My father's eyes had closed upon the light of this world six months, when mine opened on it."
units.zh: 小说中的主角大卫·科波菲尔（David Copperfield）说：“我是一个死后的孩子。我父亲的眼睛已经闭上了这个世界的光芒六个月，当时我的眼睛打开了。”

units.en: We know this "I" refers to the character, not the author.
units.zh: 我们知道这个“我”是指人物，而不是作者。

units.en: The third excerpt is from the American writer Mark Twain's short story "A Dog's Tale."
units.zh: 第三个摘录来自美国作家马克吐温的短篇小说《狗的故事》。

units.en: A careful reader will find clues from the passage that the narrator "" is not a human being but a kind of animal.
units.zh: 一个细心的读者会从这段话中找到线索，即叙述者“”不是人，而是一种动物。

units.en: Actually, it is a dog who tells its tale.
units.zh: 实际上，它是一只讲故事的狗。

units.en: 2. Second person point of view
units.zh: 2. 第二人称视角

units.en: With the second person point of view, the narrator tells the story to another
units.zh: 以第二人称的观点，叙述者将故事讲述给另一个人

units.en: character using "you," and the story is being told through the addressee's point of view.
units.zh: 角色使用“你”，故事是通过收件人的角度讲述的。

units.en: In narrative writing, the second person point of view is used much less compared with the first person or third person point of view.
units.zh: 在叙事写作中，与第一人称或第三人称观点相比，第二人称视角的使用要少得多。

units.en: Sometimes, it might be "an inverted first person," that is, a first person narrator refers himself or herself as "you."
units.zh: 有时，它可能是“倒置的第一人称”，即第一人称叙述者称自己为“你”。

units.en: Or this "you" appears as part of the monologue or letters.
units.zh: 或者这个“你”作为独白或字母的一部分出现。

units.en: Occasionally, this "you" might refer to the reader.
units.zh: 偶尔，这个“你”可能指的是读者。

units.en: Another is the use of second person point of view as
units.zh: 另一个是使用第二人称视角作为

units.en: Unit 4 Truth and Interpretation
units.zh: 第四单元真相与解释

units.en: an attempt to involve the reader as if they were the characters in the stories, which is more often used in non-fiction rather than fiction writing, particularly in feature journalism published in newspapers and magazines.
units.zh: 试图让读者像他们是故事中的人物一样让读者参与进来，这更常用于非小说类写作，而不是小说写作，特别是在报纸和杂志上发表的专题新闻中。

units.en: Read the following examples and find out what "you" refers to in each excerpt.
units.zh: 阅读以下示例并在每个摘录中找出“您”所指的内容。

units.en: Example 1
units.zh: 示例 1

units.en: You are not the kind of guy who would be at a place like this at this time of the morning.
units.zh: 你不是那种在早上的这个时候会在这样的地方的人。

units.en: But here you are, and you cannot say that the terrain is entirely unfamiliar, although the details are fuzzy.
units.zh: 但是你在这里，你不能说地形完全不熟悉，尽管细节是模糊的。

units.en: You are at a nightclub talking to a girl with a shaved head.
units.zh: 你在一家夜总会和一个剃光头的女孩说话。

units.en: The club is either Heartbreak or the Lizard Lounge.
units.zh: 俱乐部要么心碎，要么是蜥蜴休息室。

units.en: All might come clear if you could just slip into the bathroom and do a little more Bolivian Marching Powder.
units.zh: 如果你能溜进浴室并做更多的玻利维亚行军粉，一切都可能会变得清晰。

units.en: Then again, it might not.
units.zh: 再说一次，它可能不会。

units.en: A small voice inside you insists that this epidemic lack of clarity is a result of too much of that already.
units.zh: 你内心的一个小声音坚持认为，这种流行病缺乏明确性已经是太多了。

units.en: The night has already turned on that imperceptible pivot where 2 a.m. changes to 6 a.m.
units.zh: 夜晚已经打开了凌晨 2 点变为早上 6 点的不可察觉的枢纽。

units.en: You know this moment has come and gone, but you are not yet willing to concede that you have crossed the line beyond which all is gratuitous damage and the palsy of unraveled nerve endings.
units.zh: 你知道这一刻已经过去了，但你还不愿意承认你已经越过了这条线，所有这些都是无缘无故的伤害和破碎的神经末梢的麻痹。

units.en: Example 2
units.zh: 示例 2

units.en: You must be aware, first, that because Susan is my girlfriend pretty much everything she discusses with you she also discusses with me.
units.zh: 首先，你必须知道，因为苏珊几乎是她与你讨论的一切，所以她也和我讨论过。

units.en: She tells me what she said and what you said.
units.zh: 她告诉我她说了什么和你说了什么。

units.en: We have been seeing each other for about six months now and I am pretty familiar with her story, or stories.
units.zh: 我们已经见面大约六个月了，我对她的故事或故事非常熟悉。

units.en: Similarly, with your responses, at least the general pattern.
units.zh: 同样，对于您的回答，至少是一般模式。

units.en: I know, for example, that my habit of referring to you as "the sandman" annoys you but let me assure you that I mean nothing unpleasant by it.
units.zh: 例如，我知道我将你称为“沙人”的习惯让你很恼火，但让我向你保证，我的意思没有什么不愉快的。

units.en: It is simply a nickname.
units.zh: 它只是一个昵称。

units.en: The reference is to the old rhyme: "Sea-sand does the sandman bring/Sleep to end the day/He dusts the children's eyes with sand/And steals their dreams away."
units.zh: 参考的是古老的韵律：“沙滩人会带来/睡觉以结束这一天/他用沙子为孩子们的眼睛掸掉灰尘/偷走他们的梦想。”

units.en: Example 3
units.zh: 示例 3

units.en: You are always in danger in the forest, where no people are.
units.zh: 你总是在森林里处于危险之中，没有人。

units.en: Step between the portals of the great pines where the shaggy branches tangle about you, trapping the unwary traveler in nets as if the vegetation itself were in plot with the wolves who live there, as though the wicked trees go fishing on behalf of their friends-step between the gateposts of the forest with the great trepidation and infinite precautions, for if you stray from the path for one instant, the wolves will eat you.
units.zh: 步伐在大松的门户之间，蓬松的树枝缠绕着你，将野蛮的旅行者困在网中，仿佛植被本身与生活在那里的狼群在地上，仿佛那些邪恶的树木代表他们的朋友们去钓鱼 森林的门柱带着巨大的恐惧和无限的预防措施，因为如果你一瞬间偏离了路，狼就会吃掉你。

units.en: They are grey as famine, they are as unkind as plague.
units.zh: 它们像饥荒一样是灰色的，它们像瘟疫一样不友善。

units.en: The first example is from the novel Bright Lights, Big City by Jay McInerney.
units.zh: 第一个例子来自杰伊·麦金纳尼 (Jay McInerney) 的小说《大城市》。

units.en: The
units.zh: 那个

units.en: character in this excerpt was talking about himself, but he was distancing himself from what he had done by using a second person point of view as if he was talking about someone else.
units.zh: 这段摘录中的角色是在谈论自己，但他通过使用第二人称的观点来远离他所做的事情，就好像他在谈论别人一样。

units.en: The use of second person point of view provides a means to demonstrate the character's thoughts.
units.zh: 第二人称视角的使用提供了一种展示角色思想的手段。

units.en: The second excerpt is from the comic book series The Sandman by Neil Gaiman.
units.zh: 第二个摘录来自尼尔·盖曼的漫画系列《桑德曼》。

units.en: "You" refers to a specific character-"the sandman."
units.zh: “你”指的是一个特定的角色——“沙人”。

units.en: However, we can still feel that a first person narrator is close by, even if
units.zh: 但是，我们仍然可以感觉到第一人称叙述者就在附近，即使

units.en: Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 思辨写作 1

units.en: the first person narrator is hidden behind the "you."
units.zh: 第一人称叙述者隐藏在“你”后面。

units.en: In this excerpt, the first person narrator is a man who is writing a letter to his girlfriend's psychiatrist.
units.zh: 在这段摘录中，第一人称叙述者是一个正在给女朋友的精神病医生写信的男人。

units.en: The third excerpt is from the novel The Company of Wolves by Angela Carter.
units.zh: 第三个摘录来自安吉拉·卡特的小说《狼的公司》。

units.en: The writer is making you, the reader, into a character in the story.
units.zh: 作者正在让你，读者，成为故事中的一个角色。

units.en: You are being instructed to step through the forest, and warned, directly, of the dangers to you if you should do so.
units.zh: 你被指示穿过森林，并直接警告你是否应该这样做对你的危险。

units.en: The choice of second person point of view usually shows that the author has a specific purpose in mind.
units.zh: 第二人称视角的选择通常表明作者有特定的目的。

units.en: Second person point of view is more capable of making the reader feel like a participant in the story, thus making the character more personal and intimate.
units.zh: 第二人称观点更能让读者感觉自己像是故事的参与者，从而使角色更加个性化和亲密。

units.en: However, second person point of view is not widely used.
units.zh: 然而，第二人称的观点并没有被广泛使用。

units.en: It can work, but it's a little gimmicky, and runs the danger of getting tiresome except in shorter pieces.
units.zh: 它可以工作，但它有点花哨，除了较短的部分外，它还存在令人厌烦的危险。

units.en: Still, you can experiment with it, and see what you think of it for yourself.
units.zh: 尽管如此，您可以尝试一下，看看您自己的想法。

units.en: 3. Third person point of view
units.zh: 3. 第三人称视角

units.en: In narrative writing, third person point of view is frequently used.
units.zh: 在叙事写作中，经常使用第三人称的观点。

units.en: It can be
units.zh: 有可能

units.en: further divided into three subcategories: objective point of view, omniscient point of view and limited omniscient point of view.
units.zh: 进一步分为三个子类别：客观视点、无所不知的观点和有限的无所不知的观点。

units.en: 1) Objective point of view
units.zh: 1）客观观点

units.en: With the objective point of view, the author simply describes what happens
units.zh: 以客观的观点，作者简单地描述了发生的事情

units.en: without stating more than can be inferred from the story's actions and dialogue.
units.zh: 没有说明可以从故事的行动和对话中推断出来的东西。

units.en: The author never discloses anything about what the characters think or feel, remaining a detached observer.
units.zh: 作者从不透露任何关于角色的想法或感受的信息，仍然是一个超然的观察者。

units.en: Simply speaking, the action speaks for itself.
units.zh: 简单地说，行动不言自明。

units.en: Read the following excerpt and think about how the story is presented.
units.zh: 阅读以下摘录并思考故事的呈现方式。

units.en: "Where's Papa going with the ax?" said Fern to her mother as they were setting the table for breakfast.
units.zh: “爸爸拿着斧头去哪儿了？” 当他们摆好餐桌吃早餐时，弗恩对她的母亲说。

units.en: "Out to the hog house," replied Mrs. Arable.
units.zh: “去猪屋，”阿贝尔夫人回答。

units.en: "Some pigs were born last night." "I don't see why he needs an ax," continued Fern, who was only eight.
units.zh: “有些猪是昨晚出生的。” “我不明白他为什么需要一把斧头，”只有八岁的弗恩继续说道。

units.en: "Well, said her mother, "one of the pigs is a runt.
units.zh: “嗯，她的母亲说，“其中一只猪是个矮子。

units.en: It's very small and weak, and it will never amount to anything.
units.zh: 它非常小而虚弱，它永远不会有任何意义。

units.en: So your father has decided to do away with it.
units.zh: 所以你父亲决定取消它。

units.en: " "Do away with it?" shrieked Fern. "You mean kill it?
units.zh: ” “取消它？”弗恩尖叫道。“你的意思是杀了它？

units.en: Just because it's smaller than the others?"
units.zh: 只是因为它比其他人小？”

units.en: Mrs. Arable put a pitcher of cream on the table.
units.zh: 阿拉布尔夫人把一罐奶油放在桌子上。

units.en: "Don't yell, Fern!" she said.
units.zh: “别大喊大叫，弗恩！” 她说。

units.en: "Your father is right. The pig would probably die anyway."
units.zh: “你父亲是对的。无论如何，猪可能会死。”

units.en: Fern pushed a chair out of the way and ran outdoors.
units.zh: 弗恩把椅子推开，跑到户外。

units.en: The grass was wet and the earth
units.zh: 草是湿的，大地

units.en: smelled of springtime.
units.zh: 闻到春天的味道。

units.en: Fern's sneakers were sopping by the time she caught up with her father.
units.zh: 当她赶上父亲时，Fern 的运动鞋正在湿透。

units.en: "Please don't kill it!" she sobbed.
units.zh: “请不要杀人！” 她抽泣着。

units.en: "It's unfair."
units.zh: “这是不公平的。”

units.en: Mr. Arable stopped walking.
units.zh: 阿拉布尔先生停止了步行。

units.en: "Fern" he said gently, "you will have to learn to control yourself"
units.zh: “Fern”他轻轻地说：“你必须学会控制自己”

units.zh: “控制自己？” 弗恩大喊。

units.en: "This is a matter of life and death, and you talk about
units.zh: “这是生死攸关的问题，你说

units.zh: 控制着自己”泪水顺着她的脸颊滑落，她抓住斧头，试图从她父亲的手中拉出来

units.en: -Charlotte's Web by E. B. White
units.zh: - 夏洛特的网络，由 E. B. 怀特

units.en: In this excerpt, a little pig was born on Fern's farm.
units.zh: 在这段摘录中，一只小猪出生在弗恩的农场。

units.en: Her father wanted to kill
units.zh: 她的父亲想杀人

units.en: it because it was so weak.
units.zh: 因为它太弱了。

units.en: Fern, a little girl, was sympathetic toward the little pig.
units.zh: 弗恩，一个小女孩，对小猪很有同情心。

units.en: But the author does not tell us what the little girl was thinking.
units.zh: 但作者并没有告诉我们这个小女孩在想什么。

units.en: Instead, the author presents Fern's and her parents' actions and words.
units.zh: 相反，作者介绍了 Fern 和她父母的行为和言论。

units.en: The reader will get the message just from the author's description of the scene.
units.zh: 读者将仅从作者对场景的描述中得到消息。

units.en: 2) Omniscient point of view
units.zh: 2）无所不知的观点

units.en: Similar to the objective point of view, the author does not participate in the action of the story in omniscient point of view narrative writing.
units.zh: 与客观的观点类似，作者不参与无所不知的叙事写作中的故事动作。

units.en: However, the author appears to know everything.
units.zh: 然而，作者似乎什么都知道。

units.en: Using this kind of viewpoint, the author can enter the mind of any of the characters and reveal their feelings and thoughts.
units.zh: 借助这种观点，作者可以进入任何人物的脑海，揭示他们的感受和想法。

units.en: This method was once quite popular because it gives the writer more freedom with all the characters in the narrative and, therefore, gives the reader more information about the characters.
units.zh: 这种方法曾经非常流行，因为它让作者在叙述中的所有角色中获得了更多的自由，因此，它为读者提供了更多关于人物的信息。

units.en: Read the following excerpt and see how the narrator reveals the feelings and thoughts of the characters.
units.zh: 阅读以下摘录，看看叙述者如何揭示人物的感受和想法。

units.en: Tom begged her to pluck up hope again, and she said she could not.
units.zh: 汤姆恳求她再次振作起来，她说她不能。

units.en: He fell to blaming and abusing himself for getting her into this miserable situation; this had a better effect.
units.zh: 他倒下了责备和自责，因为让她陷入了这种悲惨的境地。 这有更好的效果。

units.en: She said she would try to hope again, she would get up and follow wherever he might lead if only he would not talk like that any more.
units.zh: 她说她会尝试再次希望，如果他不再那样说话，她会站起来跟随他可能带领的任何地方。

units.en: For he was no more to blame than she, she said.
units.zh: 她说，因为他并不比她更受责备。

units.en: So they moved on again-aimlessly-simply at random—all they could do was to move, keep moving
units.zh: 于是他们又继续前行——只是随意地——他们所能做的就是移动，继续前进

units.en: By-and-by, Tom took Becky's candle and blew it out.
units.zh: 顺便说一句，汤姆拿起贝基的蜡烛吹灭了它。

units.en: This economy meant so much!
units.zh: 这个经济意义太大了！

units.en: Words were not needed.
units.zh: 不需要言语。

units.en: Becky understood, and her hope died again.
units.zh: 贝基明白了，她的希望又消失了。

units.en: She knew that Tom had a whole candle and three or four pieces in his pockets—yet he must economize By-and-by, fatigue began to assert its claims; the children tried to pay attention, for it was dreadful to think of sitting down when time was grown to be so precious, moving, in some direction, in any direction, was at least progress and might bear fruit; but to sit down was to invite death and shorten its pursuit.
units.zh: 她知道汤姆的口袋里有一整支蜡烛和三四件——但他必须不断地节约，疲劳开始断言； 孩子们试图集中注意力，因为在时间变得如此宝贵、朝某个方向移动、朝着某个方向移动时，坐下来至少是进步，可能会结出果实，这很可怕。 但坐下来就是邀请死亡并缩短它的追求。

units.en: At last Becky's frail limbs refused to carry her farther.
units.zh: 终于，贝基的四肢虚弱的四肢拒绝把她拉得更远。

units.en: She sat down.
units.zh: 她坐了下来。

units.en: Tom rested with her, and they talked of home, and the friends there, and the comfortable beds and, above all, the light!
units.zh: 汤姆和她一起休息，他们谈到了家，那里的朋友，舒适的床，最重要的是光！

units.en: Becky cried, and Tom tried to think of some way of comforting her, but all his encouragements were grown threadbare with use, and sounded like sarcasms.
units.zh: 贝基哭了，汤姆想办法安慰她，但他所有的鼓励都随着使用而变得陈旧，听起来像是讽刺。

units.en: Fatigue bore so heavily upon Becky that she drowsed off to sleep.
units.zh: 疲劳对贝基来说太重了，以至于她昏昏沉沉地睡着了。

units.en: Tom was grateful.
units.zh: 汤姆很感激。

units.en: He sat looking
units.zh: 他坐着看

units.en: into her drawn face and saw it grow smooth and natural under the influence of pleasant dreams; and by-and-by a smile dawned and rested there.
units.zh: 在她画的脸上，在美梦的影响下看到它变得光滑自然； 渐渐地，一个微笑突然出现并在那里休息。

units.en: The peaceful face reflected somewhat of peace and healing into his own spirit, and his thoughts wandered away to bygone times and dreamy memories.
units.zh: 平静的脸庞，在他自己的精神中体现了某种平静和治愈的力量，他的思绪徘徊在过去的时代和梦幻的记忆中。

units.en: -The Adventure of Tom Sawyer by Mark Twain
units.zh: - 马克·吐温的《汤姆·索耶历险记》

units.en: In this excerpt, two characters are mentioned: Tom and Becky.
units.zh: 在这段摘录中，提到了两个角色：汤姆和贝基。

units.en: The reader can
units.zh: 读者可以

units.en: know not only the two characters' actions and words, but also what they were thinking, for instance, "She [Becky] knew that Tom had a whole candle... yet he must economize" and "Tom tried to think of some way of comforting her... Tom was grateful."
units.zh: 不仅要知道两个角色的行为和言语，还要知道他们在想什么，例如，“她 [Becky] 知道汤姆有一支蜡烛……但他必须节约”和“汤姆试图想办法安慰她……汤姆很感激。”

units.en: All this is made known to the reader directly through the narrator's observation as if he were on the scene and knew everything.
units.zh: 所有这一切都通过叙述者的观察直接向读者了解，就好像他在现场并且知道一切一样。

units.en: This is very typical omniscient point of view.
units.zh: 这是非常典型的无所不知的观点。

units.en: Let's look at another example:
units.zh: 让我们看另一个例子：

units.en: Mary had liked to look at her mother from a distance and she had thought her very pretty, but as she knew very little of her she could scarcely have been expected to love her or to miss her very much when she was gone.
units.zh: 玛丽本来喜欢从远处看她的母亲，她觉得她很漂亮，但由于她对她知之甚少，她几乎不能被期望爱她或在她离开时非常想念她。

units.en: She did not miss her at all, in fact, and as she was a self-absorbed child she gave her entire thought to herself, as she had always done.
units.zh: 事实上，她一点也不想念她，因为她是一个自私自利的孩子，她把整个想法都给了自己，就像她一直做的那样。

units.en: If she had been older she would no doubt have been very anxious at being left alone in the world, but she was very young, and as she had always been taken care of, she supposed she always would be.
units.zh: 如果她年纪大了，她无疑会非常担心独自留在这个世界上，但她很年轻，而且她一直被照顾，她想她会一直这样。

units.en: What she thought was that she would like to know if she was going to nice people, who would be polite to her and give her her own way as her Ayah and the other native servants had done.
units.zh: 她认为她想知道她是否会像她的 Ayah 和其他本地仆人那样对她有礼貌并给予她自己的方式。

units.en: To avoid this problem, some authors choose the limited omniscient point of view.
units.zh: 为了避免这个问题，一些作者选择了有限的无所不知的观点。

units.en: Jonas was careful about language.
units.zh: 乔纳斯对语言很小心。

units.en: Not like his friend, Asher, who talked too fast and mixed things up, scrambling words and phrases until they were barely recognizable and often very funny.
units.zh: 不像他的朋友 Asher，他说得太快，混淆了，争先恐后地单词和短语，直到它们几乎无法识别并且经常很有趣。

units.en: Jonas grinned, remembering the morning that Asher had dashed into the classroom, late as usual, arriving breathlessly in the middle of the chanting of the morning anthem.
units.zh: 乔纳斯咧嘴一笑，想起了亚瑟冲进教室的那天早上，像往常一样迟到，在晨唱的吟唱中气喘吁吁地到达。

units.en: When the class took their seats at the conclusion of the patriotic hymn, Asher remained standing to make his public apology as was required " apologize for inconveniencing my learning community."
units.zh: 当全班在爱国赞美诗结束时就座时，亚瑟仍然站着公开道歉，因为这需要“为给我的学习社区带来不便而道歉”。

units.en: Asher ran through the standard apology phrase rapidly, still catching his breath.
units.zh: 亚瑟迅速跑过标准的道歉短语，仍然屏住呼吸。

units.en: The Instructor and class waited patiently for his explanation.
units.zh: 教官和班级耐心等待他的解释。

units.en: The students had all been grinning, because they had listened to Asher's explanations so many times before.
units.zh: 学生们都笑了，因为他们以前听了很多次阿舍的解释。

units.en: In this excerpt, the author describes what happened from the memory of one character: Jonas.
units.zh: 在这段摘录中，作者描述了从一个角色的记忆中发生的事情：乔纳斯。

units.en: The reader can enter Jonas' of Asher's apology.
units.zh: 读者可以进入亚瑟的道歉乔纳斯。

units.en: Meanwhile, the author restricts herself from seeing things from other characters' eyes.
units.zh: 与此同时，作者限制自己从其他角色的眼睛中看到事物。

units.en: For instance, here the reader does not really know what Asher was thinking or what the instructor was thinking.
units.zh: 例如，在这里，读者并不真正知道 Asher 在想什么或教练在想什么。

units.en: Therefore, we can say that the author is using a limited omniscient point of view.
units.zh: 因此，我们可以说作者使用的是有限的无所不知的观点。

units.en: Excerpt 1
units.zh: 摘录 1

units.en: Mr. Johnson looked at Charles sternly.
units.zh: 约翰逊先生严厉地看着查尔斯。

units.en: He simply didn't know what to do with this boy.
units.zh: 他根本不知道该怎么处理这个男孩。

units.en: Charles had been in Mr. Johnson's office twice earlier this week.
units.zh: 查尔斯本周早些时候曾两次在约翰逊先生的办公室里。

units.en: Now, here he was again, and this time he was charged with something much more serious.
units.zh: 现在，他又来了，这次他被指控犯有更严重的事情。

units.en: Mr. Johnson shook his head.
units.zh: 约翰逊先生摇了摇头。

units.en: There really was no doubt in his mind.
units.zh: 他心中真的毫无疑问。

units.en: Charles was guilty.
units.zh: 查尔斯有罪。

units.en: He looked at the police officer standing next to Charles.
units.zh: 他看着站在查尔斯旁边的警察。

units.en: No question whatsoever-Charles had done it.
units.zh: 毫无疑问，查尔斯已经做到了。

units.en: Excerpt 2
units.zh: 摘录 2

units.en: I can't believe what is happening to me. I know that I'll never convince Mr. Johnson and the cop that I had nothing to do with this.
units.zh: 我无法相信发生在我身上的事情。 我知道我永远不会说服约翰逊先生和警察我与这无关。

units.en: Man!
units.zh: 伙计!

units.en: I didn't do it.
units.zh: 我没有这样做。

units.en: Why won't anyone believe me?
units.zh: 为什么没有人相信我？

units.en: I've been in trouble before, but I've never done anything like this!
units.zh: 我以前遇到过麻烦，但我从来没有做过这样的事情！

units.en: I've got to convince them, or I might as well kiss my life good-bye.
units.zh: 我必须说服他们，否则我还不如亲吻我的生活。

units.en: Excerpt 3
units.zh: 摘录 3

units.en: Officer Wiley looked at Charles and scratched his head.
units.zh: 威利警官看着查尔斯，挠了挠头。

units.en: All the evidence pointed to Charles' guilt, but the officer just couldn't be sure.
units.zh: 所有的证据都指向查尔斯的内疚，但军官无法确定。

units.en: Mr. Johnson, on the other hand, knew that Charles was guilty as sin.
units.zh: 另一方面，约翰逊先生知道查尔斯是有罪的。

units.en: His numerous brushes with authority in the past left no question in his mind at all.
units.zh: 他过去的无数次刷子毫无疑问地在他的脑海中留下了任何问题。

units.en: Charles hung his head, knowing that this time he would not be able to talk his way out of trouble.
units.zh: 查尔斯垂下头，知道这一次他无法摆脱困境。

units.en: Excerpt 4
units.zh: 摘录 4

units.en: When I saw them taking Charlie into the office, I lingered outside the door, hoping to find out what he had done this time.
units.zh: 当我看到他们把查理带进办公室时，我徘徊在门外，希望能知道他这次做了什么。

units.en: Charlie was my best friend, but I was getting a little tired of defending him when I knew he was wrong.
units.zh: 查理是我最好的朋友，但当我知道他错了时，我有点厌倦了为他辩护。

units.en: He must have done something really big this time to have the cops involved.
units.zh: 这次他一定做了一件非常大的事情，让警察参与进来。

units.en: A story can be told from different types of point of view such as first person, second person or third person.
units.zh: 故事可以从不同类型的角度讲述，例如第一人称、第二人称或第三人称。

units.en: The third person point of view can be further divided into the objective, omniscient and limited omniscient point of view.
units.zh: 第三人称视点又可分为客观、无所不知和有限无所不知的观点。

units.en: As illustrated in the picture Six Blind Men and an Elephant, different types of point of view might lead to drastically different narrations.
units.zh: 如图所示，六个盲人和一头大象，不同类型的观点可能会导致截然不同的叙述。

units.en: Everybody knows the story of "The Three Little Pigs."

units.en: Or at least they think
units.zh: 或者至少他们认为

units.en: Nobody knows the real story, because nobody has ever heard my side of the story.
units.zh: 没有人知道真实的故事，因为没有人听说过我的故事。

units.en: I'm Alexander T. Wolf.
units.zh: 我是亚历山大·T·沃尔夫。

units.en: You can call me Al. I don't know how this whole Big Bad Wolf thing got started, but it's all wrong.
units.zh: 你可以叫我艾尔。 我不知道这整个大灰狼的事情是如何开始的，但这一切都是错误的。

units.en: Maybe it's because of our diet.
units.zh: 也许是因为我们的饮食。

units.en: Hey, it's not my fault that wolves eat cute little animals like bunnies and sheep and pigs.
units.zh: 嘿，狼吃兔子、羊和猪等可爱的小动物不是我的错。

units.en: That's just the way we are.
units.zh: 我们就是这样。

units.en: If cheeseburgers were cute, folks would probably think you were Big and Bad, too.
units.zh: 如果芝士汉堡很可爱，人们可能也会认为你又大又坏。

units.en: But like I was saying, the whole Big Bad Wolf thing is all wrong.
units.zh: 但就像我说的，整个大坏狼的事情都是错误的。

units.en: The real story is about a sneeze and a cup of sugar.
units.zh: 真实的故事是关于打喷嚏和一杯糖。

units.en: THIS IS THE REAL STORY.
units.zh: 这是真实的故事。

units.en: Way back in Once Upon a Time, I was making a birthday cake for my dear old granny.
units.zh: 回到过去，我正在为我亲爱的老奶奶做一个生日蛋糕。

units.en: I had a terrible sneezing cold.
units.zh: 我得了一个可怕的打喷嚏感冒。

units.en: I ran out of sugar.
units.zh: 我用完了糖。

units.en: So I walked down the street to ask my neighbor for a cup of sugar.
units.zh: 于是我走在街上，向邻居要一杯糖。

units.en: Now this neighbor was a pig.
units.zh: 现在这个邻居是一头猪。

units.en: And he wasn't too bright either.
units.zh: 而且他也不是太聪明。

units.en: He had built his whole house out of straw.
units.zh: 他用稻草建造了他的整个房子。

units.en: Can you believe it?
units.zh: 你能相信吗？

units.en: I mean who in his right mind would build a house of straw?
units.zh: 我的意思是，在他头脑中的人会建造一座稻草屋吗？

units.en: So of course the minute I knocked on the door, it fell right in.
units.zh: 所以当然，当我敲门的那一刻，它就掉进了。

units.en: I didn't want to just walk into someone else's house.
units.zh: 我不想只是走进别人家。

units.en: So I called, "Little Pig, Little Pig, are you in?"
units.zh: 所以我打电话说：“小猪，小猪，你在吗？”

units.en: No answer.
units.zh: 没有答案。

units.en: So l was just about to go home without the cup of sugar for my dear old granny's
units.zh: 所以我正要回家不喝我亲爱的老奶奶的糖

units.en: That's when my nose started to itch.
units.zh: 那是我的鼻子开始发痒的时候。

units.en: I felt a sneeze coming on.
units.zh: 我感觉到一阵喷嚏来了。

units.en: Well I huffed.
units.zh: 好吧，我气喘吁吁。

units.en: And I snuffed.
units.zh: 我鼻塞了。

units.en: And I sneezed a great sneeze.
units.zh: 我打了个大喷嚏。

units.en: And you know what?
units.zh: 你知道吗？

units.en: The whole darn straw house fell down.
units.zh: 整个该死的稻草屋都倒塌了。

units.en: And right in the
units.zh: 就在

units.en: middle of the pile of straw was the First Little Pig-dead as a doornail.
units.zh: 一堆稻草的中间是第一个像门钉一样死去的小猪。

units.en: He had been home the whole time.
units.zh: 他一直在家。

units.en: It seemed like a shame to leave a perfectly good ham dinner lying there in the straw.
units.zh: 把一顿完美的火腿晚餐放在稻草上似乎是一种耻辱。

units.en: So I ate it up.
units.zh: 所以我把它吃掉了。

units.en: Think of it as a cheeseburger just lying there.
units.zh: 把它想象成一个只是躺在那里的芝士汉堡。

units.en: I was feeling a little better.
units.zh: 我感觉好多了。

units.en: But I still didn't have my cup of sugar.
units.zh: 但我仍然没有我的一杯糖。

units.en: So I went to the next neighbor's house.
units.zh: 所以我去了下一个邻居家。

units.en: This neighbor was the First Little Pig's brother.
units.zh: 这个邻居是小猪的第一个兄弟。

units.en: He was a little smarter, but not much.
units.zh: 他有点聪明，但并不多。

units.en: He has built his house of sticks.
units.zh: 他建造了他的木棍之家。

units.en: I rang the bell on the stick house.
units.zh: 我在棍屋上敲响了铃铛。

units.en: Nobody answered.
units.zh: 没有人回答。

units.en: I called, "Mr. Pig, Mr. Pig, are you in?"
units.zh: 我打电话说：“猪先生，猪先生，你在吗？”

units.en: He yelled back, "Go away Wolf! You can't come in. I'm shaving the hairs on my shinny chin-chin."
units.zh: 他喊道：“走开，狼！你不能进来。我正在剃我闪亮的下巴上的头发。”

units.en: I had just grabbed the doorknob when I felt another sneeze coming on.
units.zh: 当我感觉到另一个打喷嚏响起时，我刚刚抓住了门把手。

units.en: huffed.
units.zh: 气喘吁吁。

units.en: And I snuffed.
units.zh: 我鼻塞了。

units.en: And I tried to cover my mouth, but I sneezed a great sneeze.
units.zh: 我试图捂住嘴，但我打了一个大喷嚏。

units.en: And you are not going to believe this, but the guy's house fell down just like his brother's.
units.zh: 你不会相信这一点，但那个人的房子像他兄弟的房子一样倒塌了。

units.en: When the dust cleared, there was the Second Little Pig-dead as a doornail.
units.zh: 当尘埃散去时，还有第二只死猪一样的门钉。

units.en: Wolf's honor.
units.zh: 狼的荣誉。

units.en: Now you know food will spoil if you just leave it out in the open.
units.zh: 现在你知道如果你把食物放在外面，食物会变质的。

units.en: So l did the only thing there was to do.
units.zh: 所以我做了唯一的事情。

units.en: I had dinner again.
units.zh: 我又吃了晚饭。

units.en: Think of it as a second helping.
units.zh: 将其视为第二个帮助。

units.en: I was getting awfully full.
units.zh: 我变得非常满。

units.en: But my cold was feeling a little better.
units.zh: 但我的感冒感觉好多了。

units.en: And I still didn't have that cup of sugar for my dear old granny's birthday cake.
units.zh: 而且我还没有那杯糖作为我亲爱的老奶奶的生日蛋糕。

units.en: So I went to the next house.
units.zh: 于是我去了下一个房子。

units.en: This guy was the First and Second Little Pig's brother.
units.zh: 这家伙是第一个和第二个小猪的兄弟。

units.en: He must have been the brains of the family.
units.zh: 他一定是这个家庭的大脑。

units.en: He had built his house of bricks.
units.zh: 他建造了他的砖房。

units.en: I knocked on the brick house.
units.zh: 我敲了敲砖房。

units.en: No answer.
units.zh: 没有答案。

units.en: I called, "Mr. Pig, Mr. Pig, are you in?"
units.zh: 我打电话说：“猪先生，猪先生，你在吗？”

units.en: And do you know what that rude little porker answered?
units.zh: 你知道那个粗鲁的小猪肉回答了什么吗？

units.en: "Get out of here, Wolf! Don't bother me again.""
units.zh: “离开这里，沃尔夫！不要再打扰我了。”

units.en: Talk about impolite!
units.zh: 谈论不礼貌！

units.en: He probably had a whole sack full of sugar.
units.zh: 他可能有一整袋装满糖的袋子。

units.en: And he
units.zh: 而他

units.en: wouldn't give me even one little cup for my dear sweet old granny's birthday cake.
units.zh: 连一小杯都给我亲爱的老奶奶的生日蛋糕。

units.en: What a pig!
units.zh: 什么猪！

units.en: I was just about to go home and maybe make a nice birthday card instead of a cake, when I felt my cold coming on.
units.zh: 我正要回家，也许会做一张漂亮的生日贺卡而不是蛋糕，这时我感到我的感冒快到了。

units.en: I huffed.
units.zh: 我气喘吁吁。

units.en: And I snuffed.
units.zh: 我鼻塞了。

units.en: And I sneezed once again.
units.zh: 我又打了个喷嚏。

units.en: Then the Third Little Pig yelled, "And your old granny can sit on a pin!"
units.zh: 然后第三只小猪大喊：“你的老奶奶可以坐在别针上！”

units.en: Now I'm usually a pretty calm fellow.
units.zh: 现在我通常是一个相当冷静的人。

units.en: But when somebody talks about my granny like that, I go a little crazy.
units.zh: 但是当有人这样说我奶奶时，我有点发疯了。

units.en: When the cops drove up, of course I was trying to break down this pig's door.
units.zh: 当警察开车上来时，我当然是想打破这只猪的门。

units.en: And the whole time I was huffing and puffing and sneezing and making a real scene.
units.zh: 整个过程中，我都在喘着粗气，打喷嚏，制作一个真实的场景。

units.en: The rest, as they say, is history.
units.zh: 其余的，正如他们所说，是历史。

units.en: The news reporters found out about the two pigs I had for dinner.
units.zh: 新闻记者发现了我晚餐吃的两只猪。

units.en: They
units.zh: 他们

units.en: figured a sick guy going to borrow a cup of sugar didn't sound very exciting.
units.zh: 想一个生病的人去借一杯糖听起来不太令人兴奋。

units.en: So they jazzed up the story with all of that "Huff and puff and blow your house in."
units.zh: 所以他们用所有这些“气喘吁吁地吹嘘你的房子”为故事增添了活力。

units.en: And they made me the Big Bad Wolf.
units.zh: 他们让我成为了大灰狼。

units.en: That's it.
units.zh: 就是这样。

units.en: The real story.
units.zh: 真实的故事。

units.en: I was framed.
units.zh: 我被陷害了。

units.en: But maybe you could loan me a cup of sugar?
units.zh: 但也许你可以借给我一杯糖？

units.en: He came into the room to shut the windows while we were still in bed and I saw he looked ill.
units.zh: 当我们还在床上时，他走进房间关上窗户，我看到他看起来病了。

units.en: He was shivering, his face was white, and he walked slowly as though it ached to move.
units.zh: 他颤抖着，脸是白的，他慢慢地走着，仿佛要动起来。

units.en: "What's the matter, Schatz?"
units.zh: “怎么了，沙茨？”

units.en: "I've got a headache."
units.zh: “我头疼。”

units.en: "You better go back to bed."
units.zh: “你最好回去睡觉。”

units.zh: “不。我没事。”

units.zh: “你去睡觉吧，我穿好衣服的时候我会和你在一起的。”

units.zh: 但是当我下楼时，他穿着衣服，坐在火炉旁，看起来很

units.en: sick and miserable boy of nine years.
units.zh: 九年的病态和悲惨的男孩。

units.en: When I put my hand on his forehead I knew he had a fever.
units.zh: 当我把手放在他的额头上时，我知道他发烧了。

units.en: "You go up to bed," I said.

units.en: "You're sick." "I'm all right," he said.
units.zh: “你病了。” “我没事，”他说。

units.en: When the doctor came he took the boy's temperature.
units.zh: 当医生来的时候，他测量了男孩的体温。

units.en: "What is it?"

units.en: I asked him.
units.zh: 我问他。

units.en: "One hundred and two."
units.zh: “一百零二。”

units.en: Downstairs, the doctor left three different medicines in different colored
units.zh: 楼下，医生留下了三种不同颜色的不同药物

units.en: capsules with instruction for giving them.
units.zh: 胶囊，说明给予它们。

units.en: One was to bring down the fever, another a purgative, the third to overcome an acid condition.
units.zh: 一种是降低发烧，另一种是泻药，第三种是克服酸性状况。

units.en: The germs of influenza can only exist in an acid condition, he explained.
units.zh: 他解释说，流感的细菌只能在酸性条件下存在。

units.en: He seemed to know all about influenza and said there was nothing to worry about if the fever did not go above one hundred and four degrees.
units.zh: 他似乎对流感了如指掌，并说如果发烧没有超过一百零四度，就没有什么可担心的。

units.en: This was a light epidemic of flu and there was no danger if you avoided pneumonia.
units.zh: 这是一种轻微的流感流行病，如果您避免使用肺炎，就没有危险。

units.en: Back in the room I wrote the boy's temperature down and made a note of the time to give the various capsules.
units.zh: 回到房间里，我把男孩的体温写下来，记下了给各种胶囊的时间。

units.en: "Do you want me to read to you?"

units.zh: 仿佛所有光秃秃的树木、灌木丛、割草和所有的草地和光秃秃的地面都被冰上漆了。

units.en: I took the young Irish setter for a walk up the road and along a frozen creek, but it was difficult to stand or walk on the glassy surface and the red dog slipped and slithered and I fell twice, hard, once dropping my gun and having it slide away over the ice.
units.zh: 我带着年轻的爱尔兰二传手在路上和一条结冰的小溪上散步，但在玻璃般的表面上很难站立或行走，红狗滑倒了，我摔倒了两次，我摔倒了两次，一次放下枪，让它滑过冰面。

units.zh: 从早上九点开始，他就一直在等死。

units.en: "You poor Schatz," I said.
units.zh: “你这个可怜的沙茨，”我说。

units.en: "Poor old Schatz. It's like miles and kilometers. You aren't going to die. That's different thermometer. On that thermometer thirtyseven is normal. On this kind it's ninety-eight." "Are you sure?"
units.zh: “可怜的老沙茨。就像英里和公里。你不会死。那是不同的温度计。在那个温度计上，三十七是正常的。在这种情况下，它是九十八。” “你确定？”

units.en: "Absolutely," I said.
units.zh: “绝对，”我说。

units.en: "It's like miles and kilometers. You know, like how many kilometers we make when we do seventy miles in the car?" "Oh," he said.
units.zh: “这就像英里和公里。你知道，就像我们在车里跑七十英里时我们跑了多少公里？” “哦，”他说。

units.en: But his gaze at the foot of the bed relaxed slowly.
units.zh: 但他的目光却慢慢的放松了下来。

units.en: The hold over himself
units.zh: 对自己的控制

units.en: relaxed too, finally, and the next day it was very slack and he cried very easily at little things that were of no importance.
units.zh: 最后也很放松，第二天很放松，他很容易为那些不重要的小事哭泣。

units.en: Part III: Language Study
units.zh: 第三部分：语言学习

units.en: • Precise word choice
units.zh: • 精确的单词选择

units.en: In writing, precise words can work effectively in describing what the author
units.zh: 在写作中，精确的词可以有效地描述作者的内容

units.en: intends to convey to the reader.
units.zh: 打算传达给读者。

units.en: At the same time, you should be clear that good word choices do not mean that you always have to use those big or elaborate words.
units.zh: 同时，您应该清楚，好的单词选择并不意味着您总是必须使用那些大或复杂的单词。

units.en: A frequent use of unusual words would greatly increase the reader's load and might kill their interest in your writing.
units.zh: 经常使用不寻常的词会大大增加读者的负担，并可能会扼杀他们对你写作的兴趣。

units.en: Another problem is the overuse of certain words or phrases.
units.zh: 另一个问题是过度使用某些单词或短语。

units.en: Too much repetition (unless for specific rhetorical purposes) would weaken your writing.
units.zh: 太多的重复（除非出于特定的修辞目的）会削弱你的写作。

units.en: Good use of words means using the right words to say the right thing in the right way.
units.zh: 善用词意味着用正确的词语以正确的方式说出正确的话。

units.en: In this section, we are going to see some examples and see how the authors strengthen their writing by effectively using the specific words or phrases.
units.zh: 在本节中，我们将看到一些例子，并通过有效地使用特定的单词或短语来了解作者如何加强他们的写作。

units.en: It was a bright, cold day, the ground covered with a sleet that had frozen so that it
units.zh: 那是一个明亮而寒冷的日子，地上覆盖着一块冰雪奇缘

units.en: seemed as if all the bare trees, the bushes, the cut brush and all the grass and the bare ground had been varnished with ice.
units.zh: 仿佛所有光秃秃的树木、灌木丛、割草和所有的草地和光秃秃的地面都被冰上漆了。

units.en: I took the young Irish setter for a walk up the road and along a frozen creek, but it was difficult to stand or walk on the glassy surface and the red dog slipped and slithered and I fell twice, hard, once dropping my gun and having it slide away over the ice.
units.zh: 我带着年轻的爱尔兰二传手在路上和一条结冰的小溪上散步，但在玻璃般的表面上很难站立或行走，红狗滑倒了，我摔倒了两次，我摔倒了两次，一次放下枪，让它滑过冰面。

units.en: —"A Day's Wait" by Ernest Hemingway
units.zh: ——欧内斯特·海明威的《一天的等待》

units.en: In this paragraph, the author uses a variety of specific words and phrases such as sleet, frozen, bare, varnished with ice and glassy to create a vivid cold winter day.
units.zh: 在本段中，作者使用了各种特定的单词和短语，例如雨夹雪、冷冻、光秃秃的、用冰和玻璃涂抹的，营造出生动的寒冷冬日。

units.en: Sleet refers to frozen raindrops.
units.zh: 雨夹是冰冻雨滴。

units.en: If there is a sleet, the ground will be all covered with
units.zh: 如果有雨夹雪，地面将全部覆盖

units.en: frozen raindrops.
units.zh: 冰冻的雨滴。

units.en: Then the author mentions the "bare" trees to help enhance a winter image-bare trees means trees without leaves, with only the branches and tree trunk standing there, showing the solemn winter.
units.zh: 然后作者提到了“光秃秃的”树木，以帮助增强冬天的形象——没有树叶的树木意味着没有叶子的树木，只有树枝和树干站在那里，展示了庄严的冬天。

units.en: Next, the author uses a metaphor to say that it seemed as if everything had been "varnished with ice."
units.zh: 接下来，作者用一个比喻说，似乎一切都被“涂上了冰”。

units.en: The word varnish means to apply a hard transparent cover on something.
units.zh: 清漆这个词的意思是在某物上涂上硬透明的封面。

units.en: Here it means everything is covered with glossy, hard and transparent ice.
units.zh: 在这里，这意味着一切都被光滑、坚硬和透明的冰覆盖。

units.en: Just imagine what it is like in your mind!
units.zh: 想象一下在你的脑海中是什么样的！

units.en: As it continued, the narrator walked along "a frozen creek," which tells the reader more about how cold it was.
units.zh: 随着它的继续，叙述者沿着“冰冻的小溪”行走，这让读者更多地了解它有多冷。

units.en: The author also uses other ways to describe the icy and cold world, such as "... it was difficult to stand or walk on the glassy surface..."
units.zh: 作者还使用其他方式来描述冰冷的世界，例如“……很难站立或在玻璃表面上行走……”

units.en: The word glassy vividly tells how slippery
units.zh: glassy这个词生动地讲述了多么滑

units.en: 100 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 100 思辨写作 1

units.en: it might be to walk on such an icy road.
units.zh: 可能是在这样一条冰冷的道路上行走。

units.en: The author then uses another three specific words to further strengthen the reader's impression of the cold icy world: slip, slither and slide.
units.zh: 然后作者使用另外三个特定的词来进一步加强读者对冰冷世界的印象：滑动、滑动和滑动。

units.en: To be specific, slide means to move smoothly along a surface; slip has the meaning of moving involuntarily usually because of wet or icy road conditions; slither means to slip or slide unsteadily.
units.zh: 具体来说，滑动意味着沿着表面平稳移动； 滑倒通常是由于潮湿或冰冷的路况而非自愿移动的意思； 滑动意味着不稳定地滑倒或滑动。

units.en: These words also share similar sounds, creating the image of the slippery road conditions.
units.zh: 这些词也共享相似的声音，营造出湿滑的路况。

units.en: The slippery road condition is also reflected when the author uses expressions such as "fell twice, hard."
units.zh: 当作者使用“倒下两次，努力”等表达方式时，滑行的路况也反映了。

units.en: Combining all of these, the author presents a vivid image of a cold and icy winter day.
units.zh: 结合所有这些，作者呈现了寒冷和冰冷的冬日的生动形象。

units.en: ACTIVITY 6
units.zh: 活动 6

units.en: The following is an excerpt from "The Selfish Giant."
units.zh: 以下是《自私的巨人》的摘录。

units.en: Read and discuss how the words and phrases create the image of a harsh winter.
units.zh: 阅读并讨论单词和短语如何营造严酷冬天的形象。

units.en: Then the Spring came, and all over the country there were little blossoms and
units.zh: 然后春天来了，全国各地都有小花和

units.en: little birds.
units.zh: 小鸟。

units.en: Only in the garden of the Selfish Giant it was still winter.
units.zh: 只有在自私的巨人的花园里，它仍然是冬天。

units.en: The birds did not care to sing in it as there were no children, and the trees forgot to blossom.
units.zh: 鸟儿不愿意在里面唱歌，因为没有孩子，树也忘了开花。

units.en: Once a beautiful flower put its head out from the grass, but when it saw the notice-board it was so sorry for the children that it slipped back into the ground again, and went off to sleep.
units.zh: 一朵美丽的花从草地上伸出来，但当它看到布告栏时，它为孩子们感到难过，它又滑回了地上，然后就睡着了。

units.en: The only people who were pleased were the Snow and the Frost.
units.zh: 唯一高兴的人是雪和霜。

units.en: "Spring has forgotten this garden," they cried, "so we will live here all the year round."
units.zh: “春天已经忘记了这个花园，”他们喊道，“所以我们一年四季都住在这里。”

units.en: The Snow covered up the grass with her great white cloak, and the Frost painted all the trees silver.
units.zh: 雪用她那巨大的白色斗篷覆盖了草地，霜把所有的树都漆成了银色。

units.en: Then they invited the North Wind to stay with them, and he came.
units.zh: 然后他们邀请北风和他们在一起，他来了。

units.en: He was wrapped in furs, and he roared all day about the garden, and blew the chimney-pots down.
units.zh: 他裹着皮草，整天在花园里咆哮，把烟囱的罐子炸了。

units.en: "This is a delightful spot," he said.
units.zh: “这是一个令人愉快的地方，”他说。

units.en: "We must ask the Hail on a visit."
units.zh: “我们必须在访问时询问冰雹。”

units.en: So the Hail came.
units.zh: 所以冰雹来了。

units.en: Every day for three hours he rattled on the roof of the castle till he broke most of the slates, and then he ran round and round the garden as fast as he could go.
units.zh: 每天三个小时，他在城堡的屋顶上嘎嘎作响，直到他打破了大部分石板，然后他以最快的速度在花园里转来转去。

units.en: He was dressed in grey, and his breath was like ice.
units.zh: 他穿着灰色，呼吸像冰一样。

units.en: • Narrative tense
units.zh: • 叙事紧张

units.en: When we narrate, we use a combination of tenses to show the order events occurred in.
units.zh: 当我们叙述时，我们使用时态的组合来显示发生的顺序事件。

units.en: If we keep writing about events as they happened, that is, one event followed by the next, the writing may sound abstract and boring.
units.zh: 如果我们继续写下发生的事件，也就是说，接下来的一个事件，下一个事件，写作可能听起来很抽象和无聊。

units.en: For example, "I went cycling; I was with my family; we saw a car; the car drove fast; the car overtook us; it hit the tractor" The sentence could be rewritten as: "While I was cycling with my family, we saw a car which drove so fast that it hit the tractor soon after it overtook us."
units.zh: 例如，“我去骑自行车；我和家人在一起；我们看到了一辆车；汽车开得很快；它撞到了拖拉机。” 在拖拉机超越我们后不久就撞上拖拉机。”

units.en: By changing tenses and rearranging the events, we are able to describe events more effectively.
units.zh: 通过改变时态和重新排列事件，我们能够更有效地描述事件。

units.en: Read the following passage and consider the use of
units.zh: 阅读以下文章并考虑使用

units.en: tenses.
units.zh: 时态。

units.en: Unit 4 Truth and Interpretation
units.zh: 第四单元真相与解释

units.en: Most people, the vast majority in fact, lead the lives that circumstances have thrust upon them, and though some repine, looking upon themselves as round pegs in square holes, and think that if things had been different they might have made a much better showing, the greater part accept their lot, if not with serenity, at all events with resignation.
units.zh: 大多数人，实际上是绝大多数人，过着环境强加给他们的生活，尽管有些人认为自己就像方孔中的圆形钉子，并认为如果情况有所不同，他们可能会做出更好的展示，如果不是平静的话，大部分人接受他们的命运， 无论如何，辞职。

units.en: They are like train-cars travelling forever on the selfsame rails.
units.zh: 它们就像火车车厢，永远在相同的轨道上行驶。

units.en: They go backwards and forwards, backwards and forwards, inevitably, till they can go no longer and then are sold as scrap-iron.
units.zh: 它们不可避免地向前和向前，向前和向前移动，直到它们无法再走，然后作为废铁出售。

units.en: It is not often that you find a man who has boldly taken the course of his life into his own hands.
units.zh: 你很少能找到一个大胆地将他的人生轨迹掌握在自己手中的人。

units.en: When you do, it is worthwhile having a good look at him.
units.zh: 当你这样做时，值得好好看看他。

units.en: That was why I was curious to meet Thomas Wilson.
units.zh: 这就是为什么我很想见到托马斯·威尔逊。

units.en: It was an interesting and a bold thing he had done.
units.zh: 这是他做的一件有趣且大胆的事情。

units.en: Of course the end was not yet and until the experiment was concluded it was impossible to call it successful.
units.zh: 当然，结局还没有结束，直到实验结束，不可能称之为成功。

units.en: But from what I had heard it seemed he must be an odd sort of fellow and I thought I should like to know him.
units.zh: 但从我所听到的看来，他一定是个奇怪的人，我想我想认识他。

units.en: I had been told he was reserved, but I had a notion that with patience and tact I could persuade him to confide in me. I wanted to hear the facts from his own lips.
units.zh: 我被告知他是保守的，但我有一个想法，我有耐心和机智，可以说服他向我倾诉。 我想从他自己的嘴里听到事实。

units.en: People exaggerate; they love to romanticize, and I was quite prepared to discover that his story was not nearly so singular as I had been led to believe
units.zh: 人们夸大其词； 他们喜欢浪漫化，我已经准备好发现他的故事并没有我被引导相信的那么单一

units.en: -"The Lotus Eater" by W. Somerset Maugham
units.zh: - W. Somerset Maugham的“莲花食客”

units.en: In the above passage, the author uses a variety of tenses.
units.zh: 在上面的段落中，作者使用了多种时态。

units.en: The first paragraph mainly uses the present tense and the second mainly the past tense.
units.zh: 第一段主要使用现在时，第二段主要使用过去时。

units.en: There is a contrast between these two paragraphs in terms of tense.
units.zh: 这两个段落在时态方面存在对比。

units.en: Why is this so?
units.zh: 为什么会这样？

units.en: The first paragraph is about the narrators general comment about life, something
units.zh: 第一段是关于叙述者对生活的一般评论，某事

units.en: that the narrator considered as truth.
units.zh: 叙述者认为是真理。

units.en: It applies to all: "Most people... lead the lives... and think..."
units.zh: 它适用于所有人：“大多数人……过着生活……并思考……”

units.en: Here the author uses the present perfect tense in the first sentence: ".. that circumstances have thrust upon them."
units.zh: 在这里，作者在第一句话中使用了现在的完成时：“……这种情况已经强加给他们了。”

units.en: Here we see the order of events.
units.zh: 在这里我们看到事件的顺序。

units.en: Because of the existing circumstances, people will live a certain kind of life.
units.zh: 由于现存的环境，人们会过着某种生活。

units.en: Besides tenses, subjective mood is also used in this paragraph.
units.zh: 除了时态，本段还使用了主观情绪。

units.en: All these together help enhance the narrator's point of view: Generally speaking, most people cannot live the life the way they want.
units.zh: 所有这些都有助于增强叙述者的观点：一般来说，大多数人无法按照自己想要的方式生活。

units.en: In the second paragraph, the author switches to the past tense.
units.zh: 在第二段中，作者切换到过去时。

units.en: Here the narrator
units.zh: 这里是叙述者

units.en: was talking about a particular person and a particular case.
units.zh: 正在谈论一个特定的人和一个特定的案例。

units.en: He started to talk about something that happened in the past, telling the reader about a person he had known and how this person led his life differently from others as an example of the point he put forward at the end of the first paragraph.
units.zh: 他开始谈论过去发生的事情，告诉读者他认识的一个人，以及这个人如何与其他人不同地生活，作为他在第一段末尾提出的观点的一个例子。

units.en: On top of other things, the different choices of tense in these two paragraphs
units.zh: 最重要的是，这两个段落中时态的不同选择

units.en: help the author compare the general situation and the specific case he is going to elaborate in more detail in the following part of the work.
units.zh: 帮助作者比较一般情况和具体情况，他将在以下部分中更详细地详细说明。

units.en: 102 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 102 思辨写作 1

units.en: ACTIVITY 7
units.zh: 活动 7

units.en: Read the following excerpts and discuss with your partner how many kinds of tenses are used in each excerpt and what the functions of tenses in narrative writing are.
units.zh: 阅读以下摘录并与您的伙伴讨论每个摘录中使用了多少种时态以及时态在叙事写作中的功能是什么。

units.en: Excerpt 1
units.zh: 摘录 1

units.en: Mary had liked to look at her mother from a distance and she had thought her very pretty, but as she knew very little of her she could scarcely have been expected to love her or to miss her very much when she was gone.
units.zh: 玛丽本来喜欢从远处看她的母亲，她觉得她很漂亮，但由于她对她知之甚少，她几乎不能被期望爱她或在她离开时非常想念她。

units.en: She did not miss her at all, in fact, and as she was a self-absorbed child she gave her entire thought to herself, as she had always done.
units.zh: 事实上，她一点也不想念她，因为她是一个自私自利的孩子，她把整个想法都给了自己，就像她一直做的那样。

units.en: If she had been older she would no doubt have been very anxious at being left alone in the world, but she was very young, and as she had always been taken care of, she supposed she always would be.
units.zh: 如果她年纪大了，她无疑会非常担心独自留在这个世界上，但她很年轻，而且她一直被照顾，她想她会一直这样。

units.en: So now I think of the fire; the steady film of yellow light upon the page of my book; the three chrysanthemums in the round glass bowl on the mantelpiece.

units.en: Yes, it must have been the winter time, and we had just finished our tea, for I remember that I was smoking a cigarette when I looked up and saw the mark on the wall for the first time.

units.en: I looked up through the smoke of my cigarette and my eye lodged for a moment upon the burning coals, and that old fancy of the crimson flag flapping from the castle tower came into my mind, and I thought of the cavalcade of red knights riding up the side of the black rock.

units.en: Rather to my relief the sight of the mark interrupted the fancy, for it is an old fancy, an automatic fancy, made as a child perhaps.

units.en: The mark was a small round mark, black upon the white wall, about six or seven inches above the mantelpiece.

units.zh: 曾经有一位绅士为他的第二任妻子结婚，这是有史以来最自豪和最傲慢的女人。

units.zh: 她以前结过婚，已经有两个女儿，在所有事情上都和她一模一样。

units.en: He had likewise, by his first wife, a young daughter, but of unequalled goodness and sweetness of temper, which she took from her mother, who was the best creature in the world.

units.zh: 这个可爱的小女孩想念她已经死去的母亲，非常多。

units.en: No sooner was the wedding ceremony over than the new wife began to show herself in her true colors.
units.zh: 婚礼刚结束，新婚妻子就开始以她的本色展现自己。

units.en: She could not bear the goodness of the gentleman's pretty girl, and especially as she made her own daughters appear the more horrid.

units.zh: 可怜的女孩耐心地忍受着，不敢告诉父亲，谁会生她的气； 因为他的新妻子完全统治了他。

units.en: When the little girl had done her work, she used to go into the chimney corner, and sit down among cinders and ashes, which led her to be called Cinderwench; but the youngest stepdaughter, who was not quite so rude and unkind as the eldest, called her Cinderella.
units.zh: 小女孩做完工作后，她经常走进烟囱角，坐在煤渣和灰烬中，这让她被称为Cinderwench； 但最小的继女，不像最年长的那样粗鲁和不友善，称她为灰姑娘。

units.en: However, Cinderella, even though she was dressed in rags, was a hundred times prettier than her sisters, though they were always dressed very richly.

units.en: A Hare, having ridiculed the slow movements of a Tortoise, was challenged by the latter to run a race.
units.zh: 一只兔子嘲笑了一只乌龟的缓慢动作，被后者挑战为要跑一场比赛。

units.en: A Fox was assigned to the goal and be the judge.

units.en: They got off well together: Hare at the top of her speed; Tortoise, who had no other intention than making his antagonist exert herself, going very leisurely.
units.zh: 他们走得很好：以她的速度达到顶峰； 乌龟，除了让他的对手发挥自己的作用之外，没有其他意图，非常悠闲地走着。

units.en: After sauntering along for some time he discovered Hare by the wayside, apparently asleep, and seeing a chance to win pushed on as fast as he could, arriving at the goal hours afterward, suffering from extreme fatigue and claiming the victory.
units.zh: 在漫步了一段时间后，他在路边发现了野兔，显然是睡着了，看到了一个获胜的机会，他在几个小时后到达了目标，遭受了极度的疲劳并取得了胜利。

units.en: "Not so," said the Fox.

units.en: "Hare was here long ago, and went back to cheer you on your way."
units.zh: “野兔很久以前就在这里，然后回去为你加油。”

units.en: Part I: Learning the Skills
units.zh: 第一部分：学习技能

units.en: • What is theme?
units.zh: • 什么是主题？

units.en: Theme is the central meaning of a narrative.
units.zh: 主题是叙事的核心意义。

units.en: It has been called the worldview,
units.zh: 它被称为世界观，

units.en: philosophy, message or moral lesson within a story.
units.zh: 故事中的哲学、信息或道德教训。

units.en: The theme of a story is the most important thing the author wants the reader to get from the story.
units.zh: 故事的主题是作者希望读者从故事中得到的最重要的东西。

units.en: Themes can be explicit or implicit.
units.zh: 主题可以是明确的或隐含的。

units.en: Read the following examples and find out the
units.zh: 阅读以下示例并找出

units.en: theme of each example.
units.zh: 每个例子的主题。

units.en: Example 1
units.zh: 示例 1

units.en: Michael Jordan
units.zh: 迈克尔·乔丹

units.en: In his sophomore year of high school, Michael Jordan tried out for the varsity basketball team at Laney High School in Wilmington, North Carolina.
units.zh: 在他高中二年级的时候，迈克尔·乔丹在北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿的莱尼高中为大学篮球队试训。

units.en: But at five feet and eleven inches tall, Jordan was believed by the coach to be too short to play at that level, so Jordan was cut from the team.
units.zh: 但是身高 5 英尺和 11 英寸的乔丹被教练认为太矮了，不能在那个水平上打球，所以乔丹被球队裁掉了。

units.en: Jordan didn't let this obstacle defeat him.
units.zh: 乔丹没有让这个障碍击败他。

units.en: In fact, it pushed him to work even harder.
units.zh: 事实上，这促使他更加努力地工作。

units.en: He trained vigorously and grew another four inches the following summer.
units.zh: 他进行了大力训练，并在接下来的夏天又长了四英寸。

units.en: 110 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 110 思辨写作 1

units.en: When he finally made the varsity squad, Jordan averaged 25 points a game and went on to become one of the greatest basketball players in history.
units.zh: 当他最终进入大学队时，乔丹场均得到 25 分，并继续成为历史上最伟大的篮球运动员之一。

units.en: Example 2
units.zh: 示例 2

units.en: The Wild Boar and the Fox
units.zh: 野猪和狐狸

units.en: A Wild Boar stood under a tree and rubbed his tusks against the trunk.
units.zh: 一只野猪站在树下，用他的长象摩擦树干。

units.en: A Fox passing by asked him why he sharpened his teeth when there was no danger threatening from either huntsman or hound.
units.zh: 一只路过的狐狸问他为什么在猎人或猎犬没有危险的情况下磨牙。

units.en: He replied, "I do it advisedly, for it would never do to have to sharpen my weapons just at the time I ought to be using them."
units.zh: 他回答说：“我这样做是明智的，因为在我应该使用它们的时候，我永远不必磨练我的武器。”

units.en: Example 3
units.zh: 示例 3

units.en: The Thieves and the Cock
units.zh: 小偷和公鸡

units.en: Some thieves broke into a house and found nothing but a Cock, whom they stole, and got off as fast as they could.
units.zh: 一些小偷闯入一所房子，只发现了一只公鸡，他们偷了它，并尽可能快地下车。

units.en: Upon arriving at home they prepared to kill the Cock, who thus pleaded for his life: "Pray spare me; I am very serviceable to men. I wake them up in the very early morning to their work. *That is the very reason why we must the more kill you," they replied,"for when you wake your neighbors, you entirely put an end to our business."
units.zh: 到家后，他们准备杀死公鸡，它因此为他的生命恳求：“请饶了我；我对男人很有用。我在清晨叫醒他们的工作。 邻居们，你完全结束了我们的业务。”

units.en: The safeguards of virtue are hateful to those with evil intentions.
units.zh: 美德的保障对那些有恶意的人来说是可恶的。

units.en: Example 1 is a piece of non-fiction narrative writing.
units.zh: 示例 1 是一段非小说类叙事写作。

units.en: Examples 2 and 3 are from Aesop's Fables.
units.zh: 示例 2 和 3 来自 Aesop 的寓言。

units.en: Examples 1 and 2 do not explicitly offer the theme.
units.zh: 示例 1 和 2 没有明确提供主题。

units.en: Yet the moral of each is very clear: The message in Example 1 is "to be persistent and never give up" while Example 2 tells that one should always be prepared.
units.zh: 然而，每个人的寓意非常清楚：示例 1 中的信息是“坚持不懈，永不放弃”，而示例 2 告诉我们应该始终做好准备。

units.en: In Example 3, there is an explicit moral message at the end
units.zh: 在示例 3 中，最后有一个明确的道德信息

units.en: As can be seen, themes are not unique to fictional literature.
units.zh: 可以看出，主题并非虚构文学独有。

units.en: Any form of
units.zh: 任何形式的

units.en: storytelling, including movies, television series, songs and poetry, can (and should) contain thematic elements.
units.zh: 讲故事，包括电影、电视连续剧、歌曲和诗歌，可以（并且应该）包含主题元素。

units.en: All the elements, such as characterization, plot and setting, work together to construct the theme.
units.zh: 所有元素，如表征、情节和设置，共同构建主题。

units.en: The theme is expressed through what the characters say, do and think, and through everything that takes place within the story.
units.zh: 主题通过角色的言论、所作所为以及故事中发生的一切来表达。

units.en: The theme is also revealed in how the plot and setting of the narrative are constructed and presented.
units.zh: 主题也体现在叙事的情节和背景是如何构建和呈现的。

units.en: C. Contentment with our lot is an element of happiness.

units.en: Story 1
units.zh: 故事 1

units.en: The Crab and the Fox
units.zh: 螃蟹和狐狸

units.en: A Crab, forsaking the seashore, chose a neighboring green meadow as its feeding ground.
units.zh: 一只螃蟹放弃了海边，选择了邻近的绿色草地作为它的觅食地。

units.en: A Fox came across him, and being very hungry ate him up.
units.zh: 一只狐狸遇到了他，非常饿把他吃掉了。

units.en: Just as he was on the point of being eaten, the Crab said, " well deserve my fate, for what business had I on the land, when by my nature and habits l am only adapted for the sea?"
units.zh: 就在他快要被吃的时候，螃蟹说：“我的命运是如此，因为我在这片土地上有什么生意，因为我的天性和习惯只适合大海？”

units.en: Story 2
units.zh: 故事 2

units.en: The Ants and the Grasshopper
units.zh: 蚂蚁和蚱蜢

units.en: The Ants were spending a fine winter's day drying grain collected in the summertime.
units.zh: 蚂蚁们正在度过一个美好的冬日干燥谷物在夏季收集。

units.en: A Grasshopper, perishing with famine, passed by and earnestly begged for a little food.
units.zh: 一只因饥荒而死的蚱蜢经过，恳切地乞求一点食物。

units.en: The Ants inquired of him, "Why did you not treasure up food during the summer?"
units.zh: 蚂蚁问他：“你为什么夏天不珍惜食物？”

units.en: He replied, "1 had not leisure enough. I passed the days in singing."
units.zh: 他回答说：“1 没有足够的闲暇时间。我在唱歌的日子里度过了这些日子。”

units.en: They then said in derision: "If you were foolish enough to sing all the summer, you must dance supperless to bed in the winter.
units.zh: 然后他们嘲笑地说：“如果你愚蠢到整个夏天都在唱歌，你就必须在冬天不吃晚饭。

units.en: Story 3
units.zh: 故事 3

units.en: The Farmer and the Snake
units.zh: 农夫和蛇

units.en: One winter a Farmer found a Snake stiff and frozen with cold.
units.zh: 一个冬天，一位农民发现一条蛇僵硬并被寒冷冻住了。

units.en: He had compassion on it, and taking it up, placed it in his bosom.
units.zh: 他对它有同情心，把它放在他的怀里。

units.en: The Snake was quickly revived by the warmth, and resuming its natural instincts, bit its benefactor, inflicting on him a mortal wound.
units.zh: 这条蛇很快就被温暖复活了，恢复了它的自然本能，咬住了它的恩人，给他造成了致命的伤口。

units.en: "Oh, cried the Farmer with his last breath, "I am rightly served for pitying a scoundrel.
units.zh: “哦，农夫最后一口气喊道：“我是为同情一个恶棍而服务的。

units.en: Story 4
units.zh: 故事 4

units.en: The Peacock and the Crane
units.zh: 孔雀和起重机

units.en: A Peacock spreading its gorgeous tail mocked a Crane that passed by, ridiculing the ashen hue of its plumage and saying,"I am robed, like a king, in gold and purple and all the colors of the rainbow; while you have not a bit of color on your wings." "True," replied the Crane, "but I soar to the heights of heaven and lift up my voice to the stars, while you walk below, like a cock, among the birds of the dunghill"
units.zh: 一只孔雀展开了它华丽的尾巴，嘲笑了经过的一只鹤，嘲笑它的羽毛的灰色色调，说：“我穿着金色和紫色的长袍和彩虹的所有颜色；而你的翅膀上没有一点颜色。” “真的，”鹤回答道，“但我翱翔到天堂的高度，把我的声音举到星空中，而你像一只公鸡一样，在粪便的鸟儿中走到下面，”

units.en: Story 5
units.zh: 故事 5

units.en: The Lion and the Three Bulls
units.zh: 狮子和三头公牛

units.en: Three Bulls for a long time pastured together.
units.zh: 三头公牛一起放牧了很长时间。

units.en: A Lion lay in ambush in the hope of making them his prey, but was afraid to attack them while they kept together.
units.zh: 一只狮子埋伏在伏击中，希望把它们变成猎物，但在它们在一起时害怕攻击它们。

units.en: Having at last by guileful speeches succeeded in separating them, he attacked them without fear as they fed alone, and feasted on them one by one at his own leisure.
units.zh: 他终于通过狡猾的言论成功地将他们分开，无所畏惧地攻击他们，因为他们独自喂食，并在他自己的闲暇时一个人地享用。

units.en: 112 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 112 思辨写作 1

units.en: • What are common themes in narrative writing?
units.zh: • 叙事写作中的共同主题是什么？

units.en: The theme of a story is the most important thing the author wants readers to
units.zh: 故事的主题是作者希望读者最重要的事情

units.en: understand.
units.zh: 明白。

units.en: It is the author's thoughts about a general belief of how things are or how they should be.
units.zh: 这是作者对事物如何或应该如何的普遍信念的想法。

units.en: Examples of themes include coming of age, nostalgia or loneliness, redemption, sacrifice, betrayal, loyalty, greed, justice, oppression, revenge and love.
units.zh: 主题的例子包括成年、怀旧或孤独、救赎、牺牲、背叛、忠诚、贪婪、正义、压迫、复仇和爱。

units.en: Themes might also involve types of conflict: between the individual and society, the individual and nature, the individual and oneself, and the individual and technology.
units.zh: 主题也可能涉及类型的冲突：个人与社会、个人和自然、个人和自己、个人和技术之间。

units.en: By telling the reader what the story is about, the theme expresses the ideas or issues raised within the story.
units.zh: 通过告诉读者故事的内容，主题表达了故事中提出的想法或问题。

units.en: Keep in mind that most stories have multiple themes.
units.zh: 请记住，大多数故事都有多个主题。

units.en: For example, in Harry Potter, the most significant themes are love and good vs. evil.
units.zh: 例如，在哈利波特中，最重要的主题是爱与善与恶。

units.en: However, there are also themes of friendship, sacrifice and redemption.
units.zh: 然而，也有友谊、牺牲和救赎的主题。

units.en: One theme might stretch across an entire series, while other themes appear in one book or one chapter of the series.
units.zh: 一个主题可能延伸到整个系列，而其他主题出现在该系列的一本书或一章中。

units.en: The following are some examples showing different themes.
units.zh: 以下是一些显示不同主题的示例。

units.en: All these excerpts are from Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets by J. K. Rowling.
units.zh: 所有这些摘录均来自 J.K. 罗琳的《哈利波特与密室》。

units.en: In the story, the protagonist Harry Potter spent the summer holidays at the house
units.zh: 在故事中，主角哈利·波特在家里度过了暑假

units.en: of his uncle and aunt's (the Dursleys).
units.zh: 他的叔叔和阿姨的（德思礼一家）。

units.en: His uncle and aunt, who were "Muggles"people without magic powers, hated the fact that Harry belonged to the wizard world and they tried to hide his letters from his wizard friends and imprisoned him in his own bedroom.
units.zh: 他的叔叔和阿姨，他们是“麻瓜”人，没有魔力，讨厌哈利属于巫师世界的事实，他们试图向巫师朋友隐瞒他的信，并将他囚禁在自己的卧室里。

units.zh: 在以下摘录中，他的朋友罗恩带着他的两个兄弟来救他。

units.en: "Ron!" breathed Harry, creeping to the window and pushing it up so they could talk through the bars.
units.zh: “罗恩！” 哈利呼吸着，爬到窗户前，把它推了起来，这样他们就可以在酒吧里说话了。

units.en: "Ron, how did you—? What the?"
units.zh: “罗恩，你怎么——？什么？”

units.en: Harry's mouth fell open as the full impact of what he was seeing hit him.
units.zh: 哈利的嘴巴张开，因为他所看到的一切的影响击中了他。

units.en: Ron was
units.zh: 罗恩是

units.en: leaning out of the back window of an old turquoise car, which was parked in midair.
units.zh: 靠在一辆停在半空中的老绿松石车的后窗外。

units.en: Grinning at Harry from the front seats were Fred and George, Ron's elder twin brothers.
units.zh: 前排座位上对哈利咧嘴一笑的是罗恩的双胞胎兄弟弗雷德和乔治。

units.en: "All right, Harry?" asked George.
units.zh: “好吧，哈利？” 乔治问道。

units.en: "What's been going on?" said Ron.
units.zh: “发生了什么事？” 罗恩说。

units.en: "Why haven't you been answering my letters? I've asked you to stay about twelve times, and then Dad came home and said you'd got an official warning for using magic in front of Muggles-" "It wasn't meand how did he know?"
units.zh: “你为什么不回我的信？我已经让你停留了大约十二次，然后爸爸回家说你在麻瓜面前使用魔法得到了官方警告——” “这不是他怎么知道的？”

units.en: "He works for the Ministry," said Ron.
units.zh: “他为事工工作，”罗恩说。

units.en: "You know we're not supposed to do spells outside school-"
units.zh: “你知道我们不应该在校外做咒语——”

units.en: *You should talk, said Harry, staring at the floating car.
units.zh: *你应该说话，哈利说，盯着漂浮的汽车。

units.en: "Oh, this doesn't count," said Ron.
units.zh: “哦，这不算数，”罗恩说。

units.en: "We're only borrowing this. It's Dad's, we didn't enchant it. But doing magic in front of those Muggles you live with "I told you, I didn't—but it'll take too long to explain now-look, can you tell them at Hogwarts that the Dursleys have locked me up and won't let me come back, and obviously I can't magic myself out, because the Ministry'll think that's the second spell I've done in three days, so-"
units.zh: “我们只是借用这个。这是爸爸的，我们没有附魔。但是在你生活的那些麻瓜面前做魔法“我告诉过你，我没有——但现在解释要花太长时间——看，你能告诉他们在霍格沃茨吗？ 德思礼一家把我锁起来不让我回来，显然我不能把自己弄出来，因为事工会认为这是我三天内完成的第二个咒语，所以——”

units.en: "Stop gibbering," said Ron.

units.en: "We've come to take you home with us."

units.en: "But you can't magic me out either" "We don't need to" said Ron, jerking his head toward the front seat and grinning.

units.en: Harry was very surprised when he found that Ron came to rescue him with his
units.zh: 当他发现罗恩带着他的来救他时，他非常惊讶

units.en: brothers.

units.en: The letters Ron sent to Harry were all intercepted; therefore, Harry failed to reply these letters.
units.zh: 罗恩寄给哈利的信都被截获； 因此，哈利没有回复这些信件。

units.en: Though he felt confused, Ron still came to Harry when he heard news about Harry.
units.zh: 尽管他感到困惑，但当罗恩听到有关哈利的消息时，他仍然来到哈利身边。

units.en: Furthermore, Ron was risking being criticized by his parents, particularly his mom, for using his dad's enchanted car without permission.
units.zh: 此外，罗恩冒着被父母，尤其是他妈妈批评的风险，因为他未经许可使用了他父亲的魔法汽车。

units.en: It is clear that Ron cared Harry as a friend.
units.zh: 很明显，罗恩关心哈利作为朋友。

units.en: Therefore, the conversations here show the theme of friendship between Harry and Ron.

units.en: • How is theme revealed through narration?
units.zh: • 主题如何通过叙述揭示？

units.en: Themes are one of the most fundamental aspects in narrative writing.
units.zh: 主题是叙事写作中最基本的方面之一。

units.en: These
units.zh: 这些

units.en: themes often have their roots in human motivations, feelings and relationships.
units.zh: 主题通常源于人类的动机、感受和人际关系。

units.en: Themes themselves could be rather dull, preachy or abstract, such as good vs. evil, betrayal and loss, altruism, self-sacrifice and the corrupting nature of power.
units.zh: 主题本身可能是相当乏味的、说教的或抽象的，例如善与恶、背叛和失落、利他主义、自我牺牲和权力的腐败性质。

units.en: But themes provide the foundation on which a story rests and themes are the soil from which all stories grow.
units.zh: 但主题提供了故事所依据的基础，主题是所有故事都源自的土壤。

units.en: The theme of a narrative is revealed to the reader through different techniques.
units.zh: 叙事的主题通过不同的技巧向读者揭示。

units.en: In general, it could be implicit or explicit.
units.zh: 一般来说，它可以是隐式的或明确的。

units.en: By "implicit," it means that the author is not directly telling the reader what the themes would be.
units.zh: “隐含”的意思是作者并没有直接告诉读者主题是什么。

units.en: Instead, they are woven into the plot development and characterization.
units.zh: 相反，它们融入了情节的发展和表征中。

units.en: For instance, after we read the above three excerpts, we know that there are several themes revealed to us.
units.zh: 例如，在我们阅读了上面的三个摘录后，我们知道有几个主题向我们揭示。

units.en: In the first excerpt, we can see the theme of friendship.
units.zh: 在第一个摘录中，我们可以看到友谊的主题。

units.en: It is demonstrated to us through the use of plot design.
units.zh: 它通过使用情节设计向我们展示。

units.en: That is, when Harry was locked up by his uncle, Ron came to rescue him.
units.zh: 也就是说，当哈利被他的叔叔锁起来时，罗恩来救他。

units.en: It is also revealed through the use of dialogue between Harry and Ron.
units.zh: 它也是通过使用哈利和罗恩之间的对话来揭示的。

units.en: In the second and third excerpts, themes such as love, greed and courage are also revealed through the development of the plot, particularly the dialogue between the protagonist and the antagonist.
units.zh: 在第二段和第三段的摘录中，爱、贪婪和勇气等主题也通过情节的发展，特别是主角和对手之间的对话展现出来。

units.en: Besides this implicit way of delivering themes, it might also be possible to be more explicit about the theme or the point that the author wants to share with his or her readers.
units.zh: 除了这种传递主题的隐含方式外，还可以更明确地说明作者想要与他或她的读者分享的主题或观点。

units.en: For example, in Excerpt 3 on Pages 102 and 103, the author indicates the theme in the first paragraph.
units.zh: 例如，在第 102 和 103 页的摘录 3 中，作者在第一段中指出了主题。

units.en: The author shows us a very ordinary interaction a father had with his daughter, who instructed her father about how to properly meet a kid in "the twenty-first century."
units.zh: 作者向我们展示了父亲与女儿的非常普通的互动，她教导她的父亲如何在“二十一世纪”中正确地认识一个孩子。

units.en: The theme is mentioned at the very beginning: The choices of the children not only depend on their own efforts and attitudes but also depend on men—and American society-respecting and accommodating the choices they make.
units.zh: 一开始就提到了这个主题：孩子们的选择不仅取决于他们自己的努力和态度，还取决于男人——以及美国尊重和适应他们做出的选择。

units.en: The father respected his daughter's idea about meeting a kid according to his or her ideas.
units.zh: 父亲尊重女儿的想法，即根据他或她的想法与孩子见面。

units.en: Other writing techniques might also affect how themes are presented.
units.zh: 其他写作技巧也可能影响主题的呈现方式。

units.en: For
units.zh: 为

units.en: instance, if a story is presented through only one point of view, the reader can conclude that this character's interpretation of events represents the only important interpretation of the narrative.
units.zh: 例如，如果一个故事仅通过一种观点呈现，读者可以得出结论，这个角色对事件的解释代表了对叙事的唯一重要解释。

units.en: On the other hand, if a story is presented from multiple points of view, the reader might have to interpret it on multiple levels and from multiple perspectives.
units.zh: 另一方面，如果一个故事是从多个角度呈现的，读者可能不得不从多个层面和多个角度解释它。

units.en: The theme may also be revealed by the narrator.
units.zh: 叙述者也可以透露主题。

units.en: A thirdperson omniscient narrator who presents various characters thoughts and feelings may reveal a more abstract and broader theme than a third-person limited narrator who presents only one character's thoughts and feelings.
units.zh: 呈现各种人物思想和感受的第三人称无所不知的叙述者可能会比仅呈现一个角色的思想和感受的第三人称受限叙述者更能揭示一个更抽象和更广泛的主题。

units.en: 116 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 116 思辨写作 1

units.en: • How to develop and interpret themes in narrative writing?
units.zh: • 如何在叙事写作中发展和解释主题？

units.en: There is a good chance that themes will manifest themselves even if you put
units.zh: 即使你把主题也很有可能会表现出来

units.en: no special effort into their development.
units.zh: 他们的发展没有特别的努力。

units.en: In fact, themes are always so closely tied to human nature that it is almost impossible to tell a story without a theme of some kind.
units.zh: 事实上，主题总是与人性紧密相关，以至于几乎不可能没有某种主题的故事。

units.en: But if you approach a theme with intent (even vague intent), your work will have greater depth and meaning.
units.zh: 但是，如果你有意图（甚至是模糊的意图）接近一个主题，你的作品将具有更大的深度和意义。

units.en: In most narrative writing, themes shouldn't be overly obvious.
units.zh: 在大多数叙事写作中，主题不应该过于明显。

units.en: If you're working on a theme involving sacrifice, you don't want to have your characters making sacrifices all the time.
units.zh: 如果你正在研究一个涉及牺牲的主题，你不想让你的角色一直做出牺牲。

units.en: Themes work best when they are subtle in most cases.
units.zh: 在大多数情况下，当主题很微妙时，主题效果最好。

units.en: Since themes can contain messages and morals, you should make a conscious effort not to force your personal beliefs and values onto your readers.
units.zh: 由于主题可以包含信息和道德，因此您应该有意识地努力，不要将您的个人信仰和价值观强加给您的读者。

units.en: There is a difference between making a statement and being preachy.
units.zh: 发表声明和说教是有区别的。

units.en: Most readers don't like novels that preach at them.
units.zh: 大多数读者不喜欢向他们宣讲的小说。

units.en: In fact, some themes work best when they are presented as questions and the reader gets to experience contrary viewpoints.
units.zh: 事实上，当一些主题被呈现为问题并且读者可以体验到相反的观点时，它们效果最好。

units.en: For example, we all accept that stealing is wrong, but we feel differently about it when a small starving child is stealing a piece of bread.
units.zh: 例如，我们都接受偷窃是错误的，但是当一个饥饿的小孩子偷了一块面包时，我们对此有不同的感觉。

units.en: After identifying a story's theme, the reader can make conclusions about the story.
units.zh: 在确定一个故事的主题后，读者可以对故事做出结论。

units.en: These conclusions are the reader's interpretation of the text.
units.zh: 这些结论是读者对文本的解释。
