units.zh: 我必须再次下到大海，去孤独的大海和天空，我所要求的只是一艘高大的船和一颗引导她的星星，轮子的脚踢和风的歌声和白色的帆在摇晃，海面上的灰色雾气，一个 灰色的黎明破碎。

units.en: I must down to the seas again, for the call of the running tide Is a wild call and a clear call that may not be denied; And all I ask is a windy day with the white clouds flying, And the flung spray and the blown spume, and the sea-gulls crying.
units.zh: 我必须再次下海，因为潮汐的召唤是一个狂野的呼唤和一个不可否认的明确呼唤； 我所要求的只是一个刮风的日子，白云飞扬，飞扬的喷雾和被吹的泡沫，海鸥在哭泣。

units.en: I must down to the seas again, to the vagrant gypsy life, To the gull's way and the whales way, where the wind's like a whetted knife; And all I ask is a merry yarn from a laughing fellow-rover, And quiet sleep and a sweet dream when the long trick's over.
units.zh: 我必须再次下到大海，流浪的吉普赛人的生活，到海鸥的路和鲸鱼的路，那里的风就像一把磨刀的刀； 我所要求的只是一个笑着的漫游者的快乐纱线，当长招结束时，安静的睡眠和甜蜜的梦。

units.en: Read the following passage, and then complete the statements that follow.
units.zh: 阅读以下文章，然后完成以下陈述。

units.en: Epaminondas: A Folk Tale Retold
units.zh: 埃帕米农达斯：一个民间故事重述

units.en: Epaminondas lived with his mama in a little house on a hill.
units.zh: 埃帕米农达斯和他的妈妈住在山上的一所小房子里。

units.en: He was a sweet
units.zh: 他是个甜蜜的人

units.en: boy, but as his mama always said, not the brightest bulb in the lamp!
units.zh: 男孩，但正如他妈妈常说的那样，灯中不是最亮的灯泡！

units.en: Most days, Epaminondas went to visit his auntie.
units.zh: 大多数时候，埃帕米农达斯去拜访他的阿姨。

units.en: She lived on the other side of the hill.
units.zh: 她住在山的另一边。

units.en: He loved to walk through the forest and cross the stream to her house.
units.zh: 他喜欢穿过森林，穿过溪流到她家。

units.en: Most days she gave him something to take home.
units.zh: 大多数时候，她给了他一些东西带回家。

units.en: One day Auntie gave Epaminondas half a cake.
units.zh: 一天阿姨给了Epaminondas半个蛋糕。

units.en: He grabbed it in his fists and carried it home.
units.zh: 他用拳头抓住它，把它带回家。

units.en: When he got there, it was smeared all over his hands.
units.zh: 当他到达那里时，它被涂抹在他的手上。

units.en: "What have you got there?" asked Mama.
units.zh: “你那里有什么？” 妈妈问。

units.en: "Cake, Mama," said Epaminondas.
units.zh: “蛋糕，妈妈，”埃帕米农达斯说。

units.en: 118 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 118 思辨写作 1

units.en: "Epaminondas, that's no way to carry cake!" said Mama.
units.zh: “Epaminondas，这不是搬蛋糕的方法！” 妈妈说。

units.en: "You wrap it in clean
units.zh: “你把它包裹在干净的

units.en: leaves and put it in your hat.
units.zh: 离开并把它放在你的帽子里。

units.en: Now will you remember that?" "Yes, Mama," said Epaminondas.
units.zh: 现在你会记得吗？” “是的，妈妈，”埃帕米农达斯说。

units.en: The next week, Auntie gave Epaminondas some fresh, sweet butter.
units.zh: 接下来的一周，阿姨给了埃帕米农达一些新鲜的甜黄油。

units.en: He wrapped
units.zh: 他包裹

units.en: it in leaves and put it in his hat.
units.zh: 它在叶子里，放在他的帽子里。

units.en: It was a hot day.
units.zh: 那是一个炎热的一天。

units.en: The butter began to melt and when he got home, it was all over him.
units.zh: 黄油开始融化，当他回到家时，它就在他身上。

units.en: His mama cried, "That's no way to carry butter! You wrap it in leaves, cool it in the brook, and carry it home! Will you remember that?"
units.zh: 他妈妈喊道：“那是没办法带黄油的！你把它包裹在树叶里，在小溪里冷却，然后把它带回家！你会记得吗？”

units.en: By and by, Auntie gave Epaminondas a puppy.
units.zh: 渐渐地，阿姨给了埃帕米农达一只小狗。

units.en: He wrapped it in leaves, cooled it
units.zh: 他用叶子把它包起来，冷却它

units.en: in the brook, and carried it home.
units.zh: 在小溪里，把它带回家。

units.en: His mama rubbed the poor shivering pup with a soft towel and fed it warm soup.
units.zh: 他的妈妈用柔软的毛巾揉了揉那可怜的颤抖的小狗，然后喂它温暖的汤。

units.en: "That's no way to treat a puppy!" she said.
units.zh: “这不是对待小狗的方法！” 她说。

units.en: "You tie a string around its neck, put it on the ground, and walk it home! Will you remember?" "Yes, Mama," said Epaminondas.
units.zh: “你在它的脖子上系上一根绳子，把它放在地上，然后走回家！你会记得吗？” “是的，妈妈，”埃帕米农达斯说。

units.en: Today, Auntie gave Epaminondas a freshly-baked loaf of bread.
units.zh: 今天，阿姨给了埃帕米农达一块新鲜出炉的面包。

units.en: He tied a string
units.zh: 他系了一根绳子

units.en: around it, put it on the ground, and walked home!
units.zh: 围绕它，把它放在地上，然后步行回家！

units.en: The birds loved it because there were enough crumbs on the ground to feed a flock for a week!
units.zh: 鸟儿喜欢它，因为地上有足够的面包屑可以喂一群羊群一周！

units.en: And when he got home, all he had left was a small, sticky lump of bread stuck to the string!
units.zh: 当他回到家时，他只剩下一块粘在绳子上的粘稠的面包！

units.en: His mama shook her head and said, "No sense telling you any more, Epaminondas! Now I'm going to get more bread from Auntie. You see those pies cooling on the porch? They're for the bake sale. While I'm gone, you mind how you step in those pies!"
units.zh: 他的妈妈摇摇头说：“没有意义再告诉你，Epaminondas！现在我要从阿姨那里得到更多的面包。你看到门廊上的那些馅饼冷却了吗？它们是为了烘焙销售。当我离开时，你介意你如何介入 那些馅饼！”

units.en: Now we know she meant "be careful and don't step in the pies," but Epaminondas minded his mama.
units.zh: 现在我们知道她的意思是“要小心，不要踩到馅饼”，但 Epaminondas 介意他的妈妈。

units.en: He stepped right in the middle of each pie!
units.zh: 他就在每个馅饼的中间踩到了！

units.en: When his mama got home and saw the mess, she just laughed.
units.zh: 当他妈妈回到家看到混乱时，她只是笑了。

units.en: "Oh, Epaminondas, you ain't got the brains you were born with... but I love you anyway!"
units.zh: “哦，Epaminondas，你不是天生的大脑……但无论如何我都爱你！”

units.en: Then she gave him a big hug... and a slice of fresh bread
units.zh: 然后她给了他一个大大的拥抱……还有一片新鲜面包

units.en: Step A: Choose one of your favorite books, movies or television series and identify 5-10 themes in it.
units.zh: 步骤 A：选择您最喜欢的书籍、电影或电视剧之一，并确定其中的 5-10 个主题。

units.en: Step B: Determine one key theme that is woven through the entire story.
units.zh: 步骤 B：确定一个贯穿整个故事的关键主题。

units.en: Step C: Find out how this key theme is presented.
units.zh: 步骤 C：了解如何呈现这个关键主题。

units.en: Is it through settings, characters or plots?
units.zh: 是通过设置、字符还是情节？

units.en: Identify and study them.
units.zh: 识别和研究它们。

units.en: Step D: Use the same key theme to create your own story.
units.zh: 步骤 D：使用相同的关键主题来创建自己的故事。

units.en: Design some actions or descriptions for your characters) that would match your theme.
units.zh: 为您的角色设计一些与您的主题相匹配的动作或描述）。

units.en: Step E: Draft your story and get feedback from your partner.
units.zh: 步骤 E：起草故事并从您的合作伙伴那里获得反馈。

units.en: All classic fiction or non-fiction stories have some important themes.
units.zh: 所有经典小说或非小说类故事都有一些重要的主题。

units.en: That is
units.zh: 那是

units.en: simply one of the criteria to distinguish great works from others.
units.zh: 只是将伟大作品与其他作品区分开来的标准之一。

units.en: Writers might choose different ways to present their themes.
units.zh: 作家可能会选择不同的方式来展示他们的主题。

units.zh: 警察和国歌

units.en: O. Henry
units.zh: 奥亨利

units.en: On his bench in Madison Square Soapy moved uneasily.
units.zh: 在他在麦迪逊广场的长凳上，肥皂不安地移动。

units.en: When wild geese
units.zh: 当野鹅

units.en: honk high of nights, and when women without sealskin coats grow kind to their husbands, and when Soapy moves uneasily on his bench in the park, you may know that winter is near at hand.
units.zh: 高高在上的夜晚，当没有海豹皮外套的女人对丈夫变得友善时，当肥皂在公园的长凳上不安地移动时，你可能知道冬天就在眼前。

units.en: A dead leaf fell in Soapy's lap.
units.zh: 一片枯叶落在肥皂的腿上。

units.en: That was Jack Frost's card.
units.zh: 那是杰克弗罗斯特的卡片。

units.en: Jack is kind to the
units.zh: 杰克对

units.en: regular denizens of Madison Square, and gives fair warning of his annual call.
units.zh: 麦迪逊广场的普通居民，并对他的年度电话给出了公平的警告。

units.en: At the corners of four streets he hands his pasteboard to the North Wind, footman of the mansion of All Outdoors, so that the inhabitants thereof may make ready.
units.zh: 在四条街道的拐角处，他把他的纸板递给了北风，所有户外豪宅的男仆，这样居民就可以做好准备。

units.en: Soapy's mind became cognizant of the fact that the time had come for him to resolve himself into a singular Committee of Ways and Means to provide against the coming rigor.
units.zh: 索比的思想开始意识到，是时候让他把自己变成一个单一的委员会了，可以提供各种方法和手段来对付即将到来的严谨性。

units.en: And therefore he moved uneasily on his bench.
units.zh: 因此，他在长凳上不安地移动。

units.en: The hibernatorial ambitions of Soapy were not of the highest.
units.zh: 肥皂的冬眠野心并不是最高的。

units.en: In them there
units.zh: 在他们那里

units.en: were no considerations of Mediterranean cruises, of soporific Southern skies drifting in the Vesuvian Bay.
units.zh: 没有考虑地中海游轮，在维苏威海湾漂流的昏昏沉沉的南方天空。

units.en: Three months on the Island was what his soul craved.
units.zh: 在岛上三个月是他的灵魂所渴望的。

units.en: 120 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 120 思辨写作 1

units.en: Three months of assured board and bed and congenial company, safe from Boreas and bluecoats, seemed to Soapy the essence of things desirable.
units.zh: 三个月的有保证的董事会和床位和友善的陪伴，远离 Boreas 和 Bluecoats，似乎将事物的本质肥皂抹在了可取的事物中。

units.en: For years the hospitable Blackwell's had been his winter quarters.
units.zh: 多年来，好客的布莱克威尔一直是他的冬季宿舍。

units.en: Just as
units.zh: 正如

units.en: his more fortunate fellow New Yorkers had bought their tickets to Palm Beach and the Riviera each winter, so Soapy had made his humble arrangements for his annual hegira to the Island.
units.zh: 他更幸运的纽约同胞每年冬天都买了去棕榈滩和里维埃拉的门票，所以索皮为他的一年一度的赫吉拉安排了他的卑微安排。

units.en: And now the time was come.
units.zh: 而现在时间到了。

units.en: On the previous night three Sabbath newspapers, distributed beneath his coat, about his ankles and over his lap, had failed to repulse the cold as he slept on his bench near the spurting fountain in the ancient square.
units.zh: 前一天晚上，在他的外套下、脚踝和膝盖上分发的三份安息日报纸在他睡在古老广场喷泉附近的长凳上时未能击退寒冷。

units.en: So the Island loomed big and timely in Soapy's mind.
units.zh: 所以这个岛在肥皂的脑海中显得又大又及时。

units.en: He scorned the provisions made in the name of charity for the city's dependents.
units.zh: 他鄙视以慈善名义为城市的家属提供的食物。

units.en: In Soapy's opinion the Law was more benign than Philanthropy.
units.zh: 在索比看来，法律比慈善事业更温和。

units.en: There was an endless round of institutions, municipal and eleemosynary, on which he might set out and receive lodging and food accordant with the simple life.
units.zh: 有无穷无尽的机构，市政和 eleemosynary，他可能会出发并接受与简单生活相符的住宿和食物。

units.en: But to one of Soapy's proud spirit the gifts of charity are encumbered.
units.zh: 但对于 Soapy 的骄傲精神之一，慈善的礼物被阻碍了。

units.en: If not in coin you must pay in humiliation of spirit for every benefit received at the hands of philanthropy.
units.zh: 如果不是硬币，您必须为慈善事业所获得的每一项利益而屈辱地付出代价。

units.en: As Caesar had his Brutus, every bed of charity must have its toll of a bath, every loaf of bread its compensation of a private and personal inquisition.
units.zh: 当凯撒有他的布鲁图斯时，每一个慈善床都必须付出浴缸的代价，每条面包都必须对私人和个人宗教裁判所进行补偿。

units.en: Wherefore it is better to be a guest of the law, which, though conducted by rules, does not meddle unduly with a gentleman's private affairs.
units.zh: 因此，最好是法律的客人，虽然它是按规则进行的，但不会过度干涉绅士的私人事务。

units.en: Soapy, having decided to go to the Island, at once set about accomplishing his desire.
units.zh: 肥皂决定去岛上，立刻着手实现他的愿望。

units.en: There were many easy ways of doing this.
units.zh: 有许多简单的方法可以做到这一点。

units.en: The pleasantest was to dine luxuriously at some expensive restaurant; and then, after declaring insolvency, be handed over quietly and without uproar to a policeman.
units.zh: 最愉快的是在一家昂贵的餐厅豪华地用餐； 然后，在宣布破产后，被悄悄地交给警察，不要吵架。

units.en: An accommodating magistrate would do the rest.
units.zh: 一个包容的地方法官会做剩下的事情。

units.en: Soapy left his bench and strolled out of the square and across the level sea of asphalt, where Broadway and Fifth Avenue flow together.
units.zh: 肥皂离开他的长凳，漫步出广场，穿过柏油路的平海，百老汇和第五大道一起流动。

units.en: Up Broadway he turned, and halted at a glittering café, where are gathered together nightly the choicest products of the grape, the silkworm, and the protoplasm.
units.zh: 他转身在百老汇转身，停在了一家闪闪发光的咖啡馆，每晚收集葡萄、蚕和原生质的最佳产品。

units.en: Soapy had confidence in himself from the lowest button of his vest upward.
units.zh: Soapy 从背心的最低按钮向上对自己充满信心。

units.en: He was shaven, and his coat was decent and his neat black, ready-tied four-inhand had been presented to him by a lady missionary on Thanksgiving Day.
units.zh: 他被剃光了，他的外套很体面，他整洁的黑色、现成的四体手在感恩节由一位女士传教士赠送给他。

units.en: If he could reach a table in the restaurant unsuspected success would be his.
units.zh: 如果他能到达餐厅的一张桌子，意想不到的成功将是他的。

units.en: The portion of him that would show above the table would raise no doubt in the waiter's mind.
units.zh: 他在桌子上方的那部分毫无疑问会在服务员的脑海中浮现。

units.en: A roasted mallard duck, thought Soapy, would be about the thing—with a bottle of Chablis, and then Camembert, a demi-tasse and a cigar.
units.zh: 一只烤的野鸭，想着肥皂，会是关于这件事——加一瓶夏布利酒，然后是卡门贝尔、一个半塔塞和一支雪茄。

units.en: One dollar for the cigar would be enough.
units.zh: 一美元的雪茄就足够了。

units.en: The total would not be so high as to call forth any supreme manifestation of revenge from the café management; and yet the meat would leave him filled and happy for the journey to his winter refuge.
units.zh: 总数不会如此高，以至于要求咖啡馆管理层进行任何最高的报复； 然而，肉会让他充满活力，为前往他的冬季避难所的旅程感到高兴。

units.en: But as Soapy set foot inside the restaurant door the head waiter's eye fell upon his frayed trousers and decadent shoes.
units.zh: 但当肥皂脚踏入餐厅门口时，服务员的目光落在了他破损的裤子和颓废的鞋子上。

units.en: Strong and ready hands turned him about and conveyed him in silence and haste to the sidewalk and averted the
units.zh: 强壮而准备好的手把他转过来，默默地将他传送到人行道上，并避开了

units.en: Unit 5 Dream and Faith
units.zh: 第 5 单元梦想与信仰

units.en: ignoble fate of the menaced mallard.
units.zh: 受威胁的野鸭的卑鄙命运。

units.en: Soapy turned off Broadway.
units.zh: SOAPY 关闭了百老汇。

units.en: It seemed that his route to the coveted Island was
units.zh: 似乎他通往梦寐以求的岛屿的路线是

units.en: not to be an epicurean one.
units.zh: 不是一个吃豆腐的人。

units.en: Some other way of entering limbo must be thought of.
units.zh: 必须考虑其他一些进入 limbo 的方式。

units.en: At a corner of Sixth Avenue electric lights and cunningly displayed wares
units.zh: 在第六大道电灯和巧妙展示的商品的拐角处

units.en: behind plate-glass made a shop window conspicuous.
units.zh: 板玻璃后面使商店橱窗显眼。

units.en: Soapy took a cobblestone and dashed it through the glass.
units.zh: 肥皂拿了一块鹅卵石，冲进了玻璃杯。

units.en: People came running around the corner, a policeman in the lead.
units.zh: 人们在拐角处跑来跑去，一个警察在带头。

units.en: Soapy stood still, with his hands in his pockets, and smiled at the sight of brass buttons.
units.zh: 肥皂一动不动地站着，双手插在口袋里，看到黄铜纽扣，笑了笑。

units.en: "Where's the man that done that?" inquired the officer excitedly.
units.zh: “那做这件事的人在哪里？” 警官兴奋地问道。

units.en: "Don't you figure out that I might have had something to do with it?" said
units.zh: “你不知道我可能和它有关系吗？” 说

units.en: Soapy, not without sarcasm, but friendly, as one greets good fortune.
units.zh: 肥皂，不是没有讽刺，而是友好，因为一个人迎接好运。

units.en: The policeman's mind refused to accept Soapy even as a clue.
units.zh: 警察的思想甚至拒绝接受肥皂作为线索。

units.en: Men who
units.zh: 男人

units.en: smash windows do not remain to parley with the law's minions.
units.zh: 粉碎窗户不会与法律的爪牙保持谈判。

units.en: They take to their heels.
units.zh: 他们紧跟其后。

units.en: The policeman saw a man halfway down the block running to catch a car.
units.zh: 警察在街区的一半处看到一个人跑去抓车。

units.en: With drawn club he joined in the pursuit.
units.zh: 与 Drawn Club 他一起追求。

units.en: Soapy, with disgust in his heart, loafed along, twice unsuccessful.
units.zh: 肥皂，心里充满厌恶，顺其自然，两次失败。

units.en: On the opposite side of the street was a restaurant of no great pretensions.
units.zh: 街对面是一家没有很大自负的餐厅。

units.en: It
units.zh: 它

units.en: catered to large appetites and modest purses.
units.zh: 迎合大食欲和适度的钱包。

units.en: Its crockery and atmosphere were thick; its soup and napery thin.
units.zh: 它的陶器和气氛很厚； 它的汤和稀薄的。

units.en: Into this place Soapy took his accusive shoes and telltale trousers without challenge.
units.zh: 进入这个地方，Soapy 毫无挑战地拿起了他的忠实鞋子和 Telltale 裤子。

units.en: At a table he sat and consumed beefsteak, flapjacks, doughnuts and pie.
units.zh: 他坐在一张桌子上，吃着牛排、烙饼、甜甜圈和馅饼。

units.en: And then to the waiter he betrayed the fact that the minutest coin and himself were strangers.
units.zh: 然后对服务员出卖了最微小的硬币和他自己都是陌生人的事实。

units.en: "Now, get busy and call a cop," said Soapy.
units.zh: “现在，忙着叫警察，”索比说。

units.en: "And don't keep a gentleman waiting." "No cop for youse," said the waiter, with a voice like butter cakes and an eye
units.zh: “而且不要让绅士等着。” “没有警察给你，”服务员说，声音像黄油蛋糕和一只眼睛

units.en: like the cherry in a Manhattan cocktail.
units.zh: 就像曼哈顿鸡尾酒中的樱桃。

units.en: "Hey, Con!"
units.zh: “喂，骗子！”

units.en: Neatly upon his left ear on the callous pavement two waiters pitched Soapy.
units.zh: 在冷酷的人行道上，他的左耳整齐地放在他的左耳上，两名服务员向着肥皂剧投掷。

units.en: He arose, joint by joint, as a carpenter's rule opens, and beat the dust from his clothes.
units.zh: 他一边站起来一边站起来，木匠的规则打开了，把他衣服上的灰尘打掉了。

units.en: Arrest seemed but a rosy dream.
units.zh: 逮捕似乎只是一个美好的梦想。

units.en: The Island seemed very far away.
units.zh: 岛上似乎很遥远。

units.en: A policeman who stood before a drug store two doors away laughed and walked down the street.
units.zh: 一个站在两扇门外的药店前的警察笑着走在街上。

units.en: Five blocks Soapy travelled before his courage permitted him to woo capture
units.zh: 五块肥皂在他的勇气允许他追捕之前旅行了

units.en: again.
units.zh: 再次。

units.en: This time the opportunity presented what he fatuously termed to himself a "cinch."
units.zh: 这一次，这个机会把他愚蠢地称之为自己的“束缚”变成了自己。

units.en: A young woman of a modest and pleasing guise was standing before a show window gazing with sprightly interest at its display of shaving mugs and inkstands, and two yards from the window a large policeman of severe demeanor leaned against a water-plug.
units.zh: 一个谦虚而令人愉悦的年轻女子站在一扇展示的橱窗前，对着剃须杯和墨水架的展示非常感兴趣，离窗户两码远，一个大举的警察靠在水塞上。

units.en: It was Soapy's design to assume the role of the despicable and execrated
units.zh: 扮演卑鄙和被诅咒的角色是肥皂剧的设计

units.en: "masher."
units.zh: “马瑟。”

units.en: The refined and elegant appearance of his victim and the contiguity of the conscientious cop encouraged him to believe that he would soon feel the pleasant official clutch upon his arm that would insure his winter quarters on the right little, tight little isle.
units.zh: 他的受害者精致优雅的外表和尽职尽责的警察的邻近性鼓励他相信他很快就会感觉到他的手臂上的愉快的官方抓手，这将为他的冬季宿舍提供保险。

units.en: 122 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 122 思辨写作 1

units.en: Soapy straightened the lady missionary's ready-made tie, dragged his shrinking cuffs into the open, set his hat at a killing cant and sidled toward the young woman.
units.zh: 肥皂把这位女士传教士的现成领带拉直，将他缩小的袖口拖到露天，将他的帽子戴在杀戮之中，向着年轻女子走去。

units.en: He made eyes at her, was taken with sudden coughs and "hems," smiled, smirked and went brazenly through the impudent and contemptible litany of the "masher."
units.zh: 他盯着她，突然咳嗽和“下摆”，笑着，假笑着，厚颜无耻地穿过“捣碎者”的无礼和可鄙的一连串。

units.en: With half an eye Soapy saw that the policeman was watching him fixedly.
units.zh: 半只眼睛肥皂，看到警察正在固定地注视着他。

units.en: The young woman moved away a few steps, and again bestowed her absorbed attention upon the shaving mugs.
units.zh: 年轻女子走了几步，再次将她的注意力集中在剃须杯上。

units.en: Soapy followed, boldly stepping to her side, raised his hat and said:
units.zh: 肥皂跟随，大胆地走到她身边，举起帽子说：

units.en: "Ah there, Bedelia! Don't you want to come and play in my yard?"
units.zh: “啊，贝德莉亚！你不想来我的院子里玩吗？”

units.en: The policeman was still looking.
units.zh: 警察还在看。

units.en: The persecuted young woman had but to
units.zh: 受迫害的年轻女子只能

units.en: beckon a finger and Soapy would be practically en route for his insular haven.
units.zh: 召唤一根手指和肥皂几乎将在他的岛屿避风港的途中。

units.en: Already he imagined he could feel the cozy warmth of the station-house.
units.zh: 他已经想象他能感受到车站的舒适温暖。

units.en: The young woman faced him and, stretching out a hand, caught Soapy's coat sleeve.
units.zh: 年轻女子面对他，伸出一只手，抓住了索比的外套袖子。

units.en: "Sure, Mike," she said joyfully, "if you'll blow me to a pail of suds.
units.zh: “当然，迈克，”她高兴地说，“如果你把我吹到一桶泡沫中。

units.en: I'd have spoke
units.zh: 我会说话

units.en: to you sooner, but the cop was watching.
units.zh: 早点给你，但警察正在看。

units.en: With the young woman playing the clinging ivy to his oak Soapy walked past
units.zh: 年轻女子在他的橡木肥皂上演奏着常春藤的常春藤走过

units.en: the policeman, overcome with gloom.
units.zh: 警察，阴沉沉的。

units.en: He seemed doomed to liberty.
units.zh: 他似乎注定要自由。

units.en: At the next corner he shook off his companion and ran.
units.zh: 在下一个角落，他甩开了他的同伴跑了。

units.en: He halted in the
units.zh: 他停在了

units.en: district where by night are found the lightest streets, hearts, vows and librettos.
units.zh: 夜晚被发现的地区是最轻的街道、心形、誓言和歌词。

units.en: Women in furs and men in greatcoats moved gaily in the wintry air.
units.zh: 穿着皮草的女人和穿着大衣的男人在寒冷的空气中欢快地移动。

units.en: A sudden fear seized Soapy that some dreadful enchantment had rendered him immune to arrest.
units.zh: 突然的恐惧让肥皂剧中有一种可怕的魔法使他无法被逮捕。

units.en: The thought brought a little of panic upon it, and when he came upon another policeman lounging grandly in front of a transplendent theatre he caught at the immediate straw of "disorderly conduct."
units.zh: 这个想法给它带来了一点恐慌，当他遇到另一个警察在一个超凡脱俗的剧院前大步闲逛时，他发现了“混乱的行为”的直接稻草。

units.en: On the sidewalk Soapy began to yell drunken gibberish at the top of his harsh
units.zh: 在人行道上，肥皂开始在他严厉的顶部大喊醉醺醺的胡言乱语

units.en: voice.
units.zh: 声音。

units.en: He danced, howled, raved, and otherwise disturbed the welkin.
units.zh: 他跳舞、嚎叫、咆哮，并以其他方式扰乱了韦尔金。

units.en: The policeman twirled his club, turned his back to Soapy and remarked to a
units.zh: 警察旋转着他的俱乐部，背对着肥皂，对一个

units.en: citizen.
units.zh: 公民。

units.en: ''Tis one of them Yale lads celebratin' the goose egg they give to the Hartford College.
units.zh: ''是其中之一的耶鲁小伙子庆祝他们送给哈特福德学院的鹅蛋。

units.en: Noisy; but no harm.
units.zh: 嘈杂； 但没有伤害。

units.en: We've instructions to lave them be.
units.zh: 我们有指示要爱他们。

units.en: Disconsolate, Soapy ceased his unavailing racket.
units.zh: 失望，肥皂停止了他无效的球拍。

units.en: Would never a policeman
units.zh: 永远不会是警察

units.en: lay hands on him?
units.zh: 把手放在他身上？

units.en: In his fancy the Island seemed an unattainable Arcadia.
units.zh: 在他的幻想中，这个岛似乎是一个无法实现的阿卡迪亚。

units.en: He buttoned his thin coat against the chilling wind.
units.zh: 他在寒风中扣上薄薄的外套。

units.en: In a cigar store he saw a well-dressed man lighting a cigar at a swinging
units.zh: 在一家雪茄店，他看到一个穿着考究的男人在荡秋千时点着雪茄

units.en: light.
units.zh: 光。

units.en: His silk umbrella he had set by the door on entering.
units.zh: 进门时，他把他的丝绸雨伞放在门边。

units.en: Soapy stepped inside, secured the umbrella and sauntered off with it slowly.
units.zh: 肥皂走进去，把雨伞固定住，慢慢地带着它闲逛。

units.en: The man at the cigar light followed hastily.
units.zh: 雪茄灯下的人急忙跟在后面。

units.en: "My umbrella, he said, sternly.
units.zh: “我的雨伞，他严厉地说。

units.en: "Oh, is it?" sneered Soapy, adding insult to petit larceny.
units.zh: “哦，是吗？” 嘲笑肥皂，侮辱小偷。

units.en: "Well, why don't you call a policeman? I took it. Your umbrella! Why don't you call a cop? There stands one on the corner."
units.zh: “好吧，你为什么不叫警察？我接走了。你的雨伞！你为什么不叫警察？拐角处有一个站着。”

units.en: Unit 5 Dream and Faith
units.zh: 第 5 单元梦想与信仰

units.en: The umbrella owner slowed his steps.
units.zh: 雨伞老板放慢了脚步。

units.en: Soapy did likewise, with a presentiment
units.zh: Soapy 也这样做了，带着预感

units.en: that luck would again run against him.
units.zh: 这种运气将再次与他对抗。

units.en: The policeman looked at the two curiously.
units.zh: 警察好奇地看着两人。

units.en: "Of course," said the umbrella man-"that is—well, you know how these
units.zh: “当然，”伞人说——“就是——嗯，你知道这些

units.en: mistakes occur—|—if it's your umbrella I hope you'll excuse me—l picked it up this morning in a restaurant—If you recognize it as yours, why—| hope you'll—" "Of course it's mine," said Soapy, viciously.
units.zh: 发生错误——|——如果它是你的雨伞，我希望你能原谅我——我今天早上在餐厅捡到它——如果你认出它是你的，为什么——| 希望你会——” “当然是我的，”肥皂剧恶毒地说。

units.en: The ex-umbrella man retreated.
units.zh: 前伞人撤退了。

units.en: The policeman hurried to assist a tall blonde
units.zh: 警察急忙帮助一个高大的金发女郎

units.en: in an opera cloak across the street in front of a street car that was approaching two blocks away.
units.zh: 在街对面的一辆街车前的一家歌剧院斗篷，它正在接近两个街区外。

units.en: Soapy walked eastward through a street damaged by improvements.
units.zh: Soapy 向东走过一条因改进而受损的街道。

units.en: He
units.zh: 他

units.en: hurled the umbrella wrathfully into an excavation.
units.zh: 将雨伞愤怒地扔进了挖掘工作中。

units.en: He muttered against the men who wear helmets and carry clubs.
units.zh: 他喃喃地对着戴头盔和携带球杆的人喃喃自语。

units.en: Because he wanted to fall into their clutches, they seemed to regard him as a king who could do no wrong.
units.zh: 因为他想落入他们的魔掌中，他们似乎把他当作一个不会做错事的国王。

units.en: At length Soapy reached one of the avenues to the east where the glitter and turmoil was but faint.
units.zh: 终于，肥皂到达了东边的一条大道，那里的闪光和动荡几乎是微弱的。

units.en: He set his face down this toward Madison Square, for the homing instinct survives even when the home is a park bench.
units.zh: 他把脸朝下对着麦迪逊广场，因为即使房子是公园的长椅，归巢的本能也能幸存下来。

units.en: But on an unusually quiet corner Soapy came to a standstill.
units.zh: 但在一个异常安静的角落里，肥皂停了下来。

units.en: Here was
units.zh: 这里是

units.en: an old church, quaint and rambling and gabled.
units.zh: 一座古老的教堂，古色古香，漫无边际，山墙。

units.en: Through one violet-stained window a soft light glowed, where, no doubt, the organist loitered over the keys, making sure of his mastery of the coming Sabbath anthem.
units.zh: 透过一扇紫罗兰色的窗户，一道柔和的光芒在发光，毫无疑问，管风琴师在琴键上徘徊，确保他掌握即将到来的安息日国歌。

units.en: For there drifted out to Soapy's ears sweet music that caught and held him transfixed against the convolutions of the iron fence.
units.zh: 因为那里飘到了肥皂的耳朵里，甜美的音乐抓住并把他钉在铁栅栏的卷积之上。

units.en: The moon was above, lustrous and serene; vehicles and pedestrians were
units.zh: 月亮在上面，有光泽和宁静； 车辆和行人

units.en: few; sparrows twittered sleepily in the eaves—for a little while the scene might have been a country churchyard.
units.zh: 少数； 麻雀在屋檐上昏昏欲睡——一会儿场景可能是乡村墓地。

units.en: And the anthem that the organist played cemented Soapy to the iron fence, for he had known it well in the days when his life contained such things as mothers and roses and ambitions and friends and immaculate thoughts and collars.
units.zh: 管风琴演奏的国歌将肥皂粘在铁栅栏上，因为在他的生活中包含母亲、玫瑰、野心和朋友以及完美的思想和项圈等事物的日子里，他已经很清楚这一点。

units.en: The conjunction of Soapy's receptive state of mind and the influences about the old church wrought a sudden and wonderful change in his soul.
units.zh: Soapy 的接受状态的结合以及对旧教堂的影响在他的灵魂中突然发生了奇妙的变化。

units.en: He viewed with swift horror the pit into which he had tumbled, the degraded days, unworthy desires, dead hopes, wrecked faculties and base motives that made up his existence.
units.zh: 他惊恐地惊恐地看到了他翻滚的坑、堕落的日子、不配的欲望、死去的希望、破坏的能力和构成他存在的基本动机。

units.en: And also in a moment his heart responded thrillingly to this novel mood.
units.zh: 而在一瞬间，他的心对这种小说的情绪做出了激动的反应。

units.en: An
units.zh: 一个

units.en: instantaneous and strong impulse moved him to battle with his desperate fate.
units.zh: 瞬间而强烈的冲动使他与绝望的命运作斗争。

units.en: He would pull himself out of the mire; he would make a man of himself again; he would conquer the evil that had taken possession of him.
units.zh: 他会把自己从泥潭中拉出来； 他会再次成为自己的人； 他将征服占有他的邪恶。

units.en: There was time; he was comparatively young yet; he would resurrect his old eager ambitions and pursue them without faltering.
units.zh: 有时间； 他还比较年轻。 他会复活他渴望的旧野心并毫不犹豫地追求它们。

units.en: Those solemn but sweet organ notes had set up a revolution in him.
units.zh: 那些庄严而甜美的风琴音符在他身上掀起了一场革命。

units.en: To-morrow he would go into the roaring down-town district and find work.
units.zh: 明天他将进入喧闹的市中心地区找工作。

units.en: A fur importer had once offered him a place as driver.
units.zh: 一位毛皮进口商曾经为他提供了一个司机的地方。

units.en: He would find him to-morrow and ask for the position.
units.zh: 他明天会找到他并要求这个职位。

units.en: He would be somebody in the world.
units.zh: 他会成为世界上的某个人。

units.en: He would—
units.zh: 他会——

units.en: Part III: Language Study
units.zh: 第三部分：语言学习

units.en: • Figurative language (II)
units.zh: • 比喻语言 (ii)

units.en: Figurative language refers to words or expressions with a meaning that is different from their daily or literal interpretation.
units.zh: 比喻语言是指具有不同于日常或字面解释的含义的单词或表达式。

units.en: Writers ornament their writing with figurative language to make it more entertaining or to clarify the meaning they intend to convey.
units.zh: 作家用比喻语言装饰他们的作品，以使其更有趣或澄清他们打算传达的含义。

units.en: Figurative language is very common in poetry, but is also used in prose and non-fiction writing.
units.zh: 具象语言在诗歌中很常见，但也用于散文和非小说写作。

units.en: In Unit 2, we briefly learned about three types of figurative language, and in this unit, we are going to learn more.
units.zh: 在第 2 单元中，我们简要了解了三种具象语言，在本单元中，我们将了解更多信息。

units.en: 1. Alliteration
units.zh: 1. 头韵

units.en: Alliteration refers to the repetition of the same sounds or the same kinds of sounds at the beginning of the words.
units.zh: 头韵是指在单词的开头重复相同的声音或相同类型的声音。

units.en: For example, in Story 2 on Page 135, there are several examples of alliteration such as "wide whispering woods" and "fearful frenzied."
units.zh: 例如，在第 135 页的故事 2 中，有几个头韵的例子，例如“宽耳语树林”和“可怕的疯狂”。

units.en: Alliteration creates an atmosphere in rhythm, thus making the narrative or
units.zh: 头韵在节奏中营造出一种氛围，从而使叙事或

units.en: Unit 5 Dream and Faith 131
units.zh: 第 5 单元梦想与信仰 131

units.en: description more vivid.
units.zh: 描述更生动。

units.en: 2. Hyperbole
units.zh: 2. 夸张

units.en: Exaggerating, often in a humorous way, is known as hyperbole.
units.zh: 夸张，通常以幽默的方式，被称为夸张。

units.en: For example:
units.zh: 例如：

units.en: • On the sidewalk Soapy began to yell drunken gibberish at the top of his harsh voice.
units.zh: • 在人行道上，肥皂开始在他刺耳的声音中大喊醉醺醺的胡言乱语。

units.en: He danced, howled, raved, and otherwise disturbed the welkin.
units.zh: 他跳舞、嚎叫、咆哮，并以其他方式扰乱了韦尔金。

units.en: In this example, Soapy thought of the idea of making noises so that he might be arrested because of "disorderly conduct."
units.zh: 在这个例子中，Soapy 想到了制造噪音的想法，以便他可能会因为“混乱的行为”而被捕。

units.en: Therefore, he was making such a fuss of himself that he disturbed the sky or universe.
units.zh: 因此，他对自己大惊小怪，以至于扰乱了天空或宇宙。

units.en: "Welkin" is a word often used in poetry with the meaning of "the sky, the vault of heaven."
units.zh: “Welkin”是诗歌中经常使用的一个词，意思是“天空，天堂的穹顶”。

units.en: Of course, it is impossible for him to make that kind of noise.
units.zh: 当然，他不可能发出这种噪音。

units.en: It is just exaggeration.
units.zh: 这只是夸张。

units.en: He wanted to draw the attention of a cop who was nearby but failed.
units.zh: 他想引起附近但失败的警察的注意。

units.en: Here are more examples:
units.zh: 以下是更多示例：

units.en: • Then she reached down, picked the boy up by his shirt front, and shook him until his teeth rattled
units.zh: • 然后她伸手把男孩从他的衬衫前面抱起来，摇了摇，直到他的牙齿嘎嘎作响

units.en: • My eyes widened at the sight of the mile-high ice cream cones we were having for dessert.
units.zh: • 看到我们作为甜点的一英里高的冰淇淋蛋筒，我的眼睛睁大了。

units.en: 3. Onomatopoeia
units.zh: 3. 象声词

units.en: Onomatopoeia names an action or a thing according to what it sounds like.
units.zh: Onomatopoeia 根据听起来像一个动作或事物来命名。

units.en: For
units.zh: 为

units.en: example, "The bees buzz angrily when their hive is disturbed."
units.zh: 例如，“当它们的蜂巢受到干扰时，蜜蜂会愤怒地嗡嗡作响。”

units.en: The sounds made by the bees could almost be heard when the word "buzz" is pronounced.
units.zh: 当“嗡嗡声”这个词发音时，蜜蜂发出的声音几乎可以听到。

units.en: The following are more examples.
units.zh: 以下是更多示例。

units.en: • The cow mooed when it saw a passing train.
units.zh: • 母牛看到经过的火车时呜咽。

units.en: • Birds twittered and tweeted...
units.zh: • 鸟儿在推特和推特上发推文...

units.en: • The horse's hooves clip-clopped on the cobblestones
units.zh: • 马的蹄子夹在鹅卵石上

units.en: 4. Understatement
units.zh: 4. 轻描淡写

units.en: In contrast with hyperbole, which greatly exaggerates the truth, understatement
units.zh: 与夸张真相、轻描淡写的夸张相反

units.en: deliberately makes a situation less important or serious than it is.
units.zh: 故意使情况不那么重要或不那么严重。

units.en: For example:
units.zh: 例如：

units.en: • I have to have this operation.
units.zh: • 我必须进行此操作。

units.en: It isn't very serious.
units.zh: 这不是很严重。

units.en: I have this tiny little tumor on the brain.
units.zh: 我的大脑上有这个微小的肿瘤。

units.en: In this example, this "I" first mentioned an operation that was necessary for him or her because he or she had to have that.
units.zh: 在这个例子中，这个“我”首先提到了他或她所必需的手术，因为他或她必须这样做。

units.en: But then he or she described it as not serious.
units.zh: 但随后他或她将其描述为不严重。

units.en: The last sentence reveals the seriousness of the problem: This "I" actually got a tumor on the brain.
units.zh: 最后一句揭示了问题的严重性：这个“我”实际上在大脑上有了一个肿瘤。

units.en: Yet, he or she tried to downplay the possible consequences.
units.zh: 然而，他或她试图淡化可能的后果。

units.en: This is further strengthened by two adjectives: "tiny" and "little."
units.zh: 两个形容词进一步加强了这一点：“小”和“小”。

units.en: This description would be a sharp contrast with what we usually describe a tumor on the brain, thus greatly enhances the characterization of the speaker.
units.zh: 这种描述与我们通常在大脑上描述的肿瘤形成鲜明对比，从而大大增强了说话者的特征。

units.en: 132 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 132 思辨写作 1

units.en: We have learned simile, metaphor and personification in Unit 2.
units.zh: 我们在单元 2 中学习了明喻、隐喻和拟人化。

units.en: In the following
units.zh: 在下面的

units.en: we are going to discuss these figures of speech using some examples in this unit to further illustrate the use of figurative language.
units.zh: 我们将使用本单元中的一些示例来讨论这些修辞格，以进一步说明比喻语言的使用。

units.en: 5. Simile
units.zh: 5. 明喻

units.en: • "No cop for youse," said the waiter, with a voice like butter cakes and an eye like the cherry in a Manhattan cocktail.
units.zh: • “没有警察给你，”服务员说，声音像黄油蛋糕，眼睛像曼哈顿鸡尾酒中的樱桃。

units.en: By comparing two elements, the descriptive effect is enhanced, thus making it more impressive.
units.zh: 通过比较两个元素，描述性效果得到了增强，从而使其更加令人印象深刻。

units.en: For instance, by describing the waiter as having a voice like "butter cakes" and an eye like "the cherry in a Manhattan cocktail," the author tells us what the waiter is like-very unpleasant and unfriendly.
units.zh: 例如，通过将服务员描述为“黄油蛋糕”和“曼哈顿鸡尾酒中的樱桃”之类的眼睛，作者告诉我们服务员是什么样的人非常不愉快和不友好。

units.en: Comparing the voice with butter cakes and his eyes with a cherry in a cocktail is fresh and creative.
units.zh: 将声音与黄油蛋糕和他的眼睛与鸡尾酒中的樱桃进行比较是新鲜而有创意的。

units.en: The following are more examples of simile:
units.zh: 以下是 Simile 的更多示例：

units.en: • He arose, joint by joint, as a carpenter's rule opens, and beat the dust from his clothes.
units.zh: • 当木匠的规则打开时，他逐个关节站起来，击败了他衣服上的灰尘。

units.en: • My love is like a red, red rose.
units.zh: • 我的爱就像一朵红红的玫瑰。

units.en: • He wasn't frightened exactly, but he was as anxious as a fish out of water to find his family before evening.
units.zh: • 他并没有完全害怕，但他像一条出水的鱼一样焦急，想在晚上之前找到家人。

units.en: 6. Metaphor
units.zh: 6. 比喻

units.en: • With the young woman playing the clinging ivy to his oak Soapy walked past the policeman, overcome with gloom.
units.zh: • 这位年轻女子在他的橡木肥皂剧中扮演着常春藤的常春藤，走过警察，被阴郁地克服了。

units.en: In this sentence, the "ivy" refers to the woman and the "oak" refers to Soapy.
units.zh: 在这句话中，“常春藤”指的是女人，“橡木”指的是肥皂。

units.en: The woman clung to Soapy so tightly that she looked like ivy clinging to an oak.
units.zh: 女人紧紧地粘着肥皂，看起来像常春藤紧贴着一棵橡树。

units.en: The use of metaphor makes the image very clear.
units.zh: 隐喻的使用使图像非常清晰。

units.en: Here are more examples:
units.zh: 以下是更多示例：

units.en: • Alice was thrilled when her idea began to bear fruit.
units.zh: • 当她的想法开始结出硕果时，爱丽丝很激动。

units.en: • The boss thundered into the room.
units.zh: • 老板轰隆隆地冲进了房间。

units.en: 7. Personification
units.zh: 7.拟人化

units.en: • For years the hospitable Blackwell's had been his winter quarters.
units.zh: • 多年来，热情好客的布莱克威尔一直是他的冬季宿舍。

units.en: The word "hospitable" is usually used to describe a person who treats his or her guest with warmth.
units.zh: “好客”一词通常用于描述以温暖对待客人的人。

units.en: But here it refers to a prison, which is usually not modified by such a word.
units.zh: 但在这里它指的是一个监狱，它通常不会被这样的词修改。

units.en: Thus, a combination of personification and irony creates a strong impact on the reader.
units.zh: 因此，人格化和讽刺的结合对读者产生了强烈的影响。

units.en: Here are more examples:
units.zh: 以下是更多示例：

units.en: • In Soapy's opinion the Law was more benign than Philanthropy.
units.zh: • 在Soapy看来，法律比慈善事业更温和。

units.en: • The leaves danced in the wind on the cold October afternoon.
units.zh: • 在寒冷的十月下午，树叶在风中翩翩起舞。

units.en: Part I: Learning the Skills
units.zh: 第一部分：学习技能

units.en: • What is plot?
units.zh: • 什么是情节？

units.en: Plot is a series of events and thoughts arranged to reveal their dramatic and emotional significance.
units.zh: 情节是一系列事件和思想，旨在揭示其戏剧性和情感意义。

units.en: Plot is not just a sequence of chronological events.
units.zh: 情节不仅仅是一个按时间顺序排列的事件。

units.en: Rather, plot implies that there is a meaningful relationship among the events.
units.zh: 相反，情节意味着事件之间存在有意义的关系。

units.en: Plot is often characterized by a conflict, a struggle between two or more opposing forces.
units.zh: 情节通常以冲突、两种或多种对立力量之间的斗争为特征。

units.en: The conflict may be internal (person vs. self) or external (person vs. person; person vs. nature; person vs. society; person vs. fate).
units.zh: 冲突可能是内部的（人与自我）或外部（人与人；人与自然；人与社会；人与命运）。

units.en: A story may have more than one conflict.
units.zh: 一个故事可能有不止一个冲突。

units.en: The simplest view of plot is that stories have a beginning, a middle and an
units.zh: 最简单的情节观点是故事有一个开始，一个中间和一个

units.en: ending.
units.zh: 结束。

units.en: For example, at the beginning of Perrault's Cinderella, a young girl was faced with a lifetime of drudgery and decision.
units.zh: 例如，在佩罗的《灰姑娘》开始时，一个年轻的女孩面临着一生的苦差事和决定。

units.en: Her fairy godmother arrived in the middle of the tale to offer her some sparkling alternatives.
units.zh: 她的仙女教母来到故事的中间，为她提供了一些闪闪发光的替代品。

units.en: Cinderella ultimately discovered the old adage "If the shoe fits, wear it" and lived happily ever after with her prince.
units.zh: 灰姑娘最终发现了“如果鞋子合身，穿上它”的古老格言，并与她的王子幸福地生活。

units.en: More sophisticated views of plot show the sequence of time in related episodes.
units.zh: 更复杂的情节视图显示了相关剧集中的时间顺序。

units.en: For example, in the story of Mufaros Beautiful Daughters: An African Tale by John Steptoe, the polarity of the actions and reactions of two sisters leads them into very different futures.
units.zh: 例如，在穆法罗斯美丽女儿的故事：约翰·斯蒂普托的非洲故事中，两姐妹的行动和反应的极性将她们带入了截然不同的未来。

units.en: The gentle and generous Nyasha met and married her king, while the bad-tempered Manyara was left to be a servant in her sister's household.
units.zh: 温柔大方的尼亚莎遇见并娶了她的国王，而脾气暴躁的曼雅拉则留在她姐姐家中成为仆人。

units.en: Steptoe foreshadows the ultimate events through Manyara's dire, though misguided, predictions and the early appearance of the young king in a variety of symbolic guises.
units.zh: Steptoe 通过 Manyara 的可怕预言和早期出现的各种象征性的形式预示了最终事件。

units.en: Because they are fairy tales, both stories are marked by the "rule of three."
units.zh: 因为它们是童话故事，所以这两个故事都以“三规则”为标志。

units.en: Cinderella attended the ball three nights before her prince discovered her identity, while Nyasha must face three trials before she and her king were married.
units.zh: 灰姑娘在她的王子发现她的身份之前三个晚上参加了舞会，而尼亚莎必须在她和她的国王结婚之前面临三个审判。

units.en: • What are the five elements of plot?
units.zh: • 情节的五个要素是什么？

units.en: Gustav Freytag, a German dramatist and novelist, divides the plot into five elements: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution/denouement.
units.zh: 德国剧作家和小说家古斯塔夫·弗雷塔格（Gustav Freytag）将情节分为五个要素：展览、上升动作、高潮、下降动作和决议/结局。

units.en: Exposition refers to the introduction of a story, the background information
units.zh: 展览是指引入一个故事，背景信息

units.en: 140 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 140 思辨写作 1

units.en: needed to properly understand the story.
units.zh: 需要正确理解故事。

units.en: This part can include the main characters), the setting and so forth.
units.zh: 这部分可以包括主要人物）、设置等。

units.en: The initial event triggering the rest of the story also occurs in this part.
units.zh: 触发故事其余部分的初始事件也发生在这部分。

units.en: For instance, in the Father and Son pictures, the son broke the windows and then ran away from his home because his father was mad at him.
units.zh: 例如，在父子照片中，儿子打破了窗户，然后因为他的父亲生他的气而离开了他的家。

units.en: That would be the exposition element of the plot.
units.zh: 那将是情节的展览元素。

units.en: Rising action refers to the events leading up to the climax.
units.zh: 上升动作是指导致高潮的事件。

units.en: For example, in the
units.zh: 例如，在

units.en: above story, the father's initial anger with his son turned into worries when the son ran away and did not come back when it was getting late.
units.zh: 在上面的故事中，当儿子逃跑时，父亲对儿子的最初愤怒变成了担忧，并且在迟到时没有回来。

units.en: He even went out to look for his son.
units.zh: 他甚至出去寻找他的儿子。

units.en: These events are the "rising action."
units.zh: 这些事件是“上升动作”。

units.en: The climax is the most exciting part of the story.
units.zh: 高潮是故事中最令人兴奋的部分。

units.en: This is where all the rising action
units.zh: 这是所有上升动作的地方

units.en: finally reaches its peak.
units.zh: 终于达到了顶峰。

units.en: For example, in the Father and Son pictures, the climax occurs when the second window was broken.
units.zh: 例如，在父子照片中，高潮发生在第二个窗口被打破时。

units.en: According to the previous information in the exposition, the reader might assume that the son was going to be punished more seriously, thus making the story more intriguing.
units.zh: 根据展览中之前的信息，读者可能会认为儿子将受到更严重的惩罚，从而使故事更加有趣。

units.en: The falling action deals with events occurring right after the climax.
units.zh: 下降动作处理高潮之后发生的事件。

units.en: These events are usually the after-effects of the climax.
units.zh: 这些事件通常是高潮的后遗症。

units.en: Resolution, which is sometimes called denouement, is the end of the falling action and the conclusion to the story.
units.zh: 决议，有时被称为结局，是坠落动作的终结和故事的结论。

units.en: There is usually a release of dramatic tension and anxiety.
units.zh: 通常会释放剧烈的紧张和焦虑。

units.en: It can also be the part that reveals the final outcome of its conflicts or the solution of its mysteries.
units.zh: 它也可以是揭示其冲突的最终结果或解决其奥秘的部分。

units.en: At the same time, stories sometimes have endings with questions left unanswered.
units.zh: 与此同时，故事有时会以未回答的问题结尾。

units.en: In the above story, the father was so happy to find his son again that he held him tight instead of punishing him.
units.zh: 在上面的故事中，父亲很高兴再次找到他的儿子，以至于他紧紧地抱住他而不是惩罚他。

units.en: These five elements of plot structure can vary slightly, but for the most part it
units.zh: 情节结构的这五个要素可能略有不同，但在大多数情况下

units.en: is the gradual build-up of events, the climax, followed by a resolution.
units.zh: 是事件的逐渐积累，高潮，然后是一个解决方案。

units.en: It is often presented as:
units.zh: 它通常表示为：

units.en: Climax
units.zh: 高潮

units.en: Rising action
units.zh: 指向高潮的情节

units.en: action
units.zh: 行动

units.en: Exposition
units.zh: 解释

units.en: Resolution/Denouement
units.zh: 决议/结局

units.en: For example, in Activity 6 of Unit 3, we read "The Flowers" by Alice Walker.
units.zh: 例如，在第 3 单元的活动 6 中，我们阅读了 Alice Walker 的“花”。

units.en: It has only about 500 words.
units.zh: 它只有大约 500 个单词。

units.en: Nevertheless, its plot structure is very clear.
units.zh: 尽管如此，它的情节结构非常清晰。

units.en: In the exposition part, we learn the main character is a young and innocent African- American girl, Myop, who was playing outside on a beautiful day.
units.zh: 在博览会部分，我们了解到主角是一个年轻而无辜的非裔美国女孩 Myop，她在外面玩耍，在美好的一天。

units.en: She decided to pick flowers in the woods.
units.zh: 她决定在树林里采花。

units.en: A conflict is suggested between herself and society in the details of the world around her.
units.zh: 在她周围世界的细节中，她与社会之间存在冲突。

units.en: The tension rises as she decided to venture further out into
units.zh: 当她决定进一步探索时，紧张局势加剧

units.zh: 第 6 单元 冲突与和谐 141

units.en: the world and explore the unknown.
units.zh: 世界和探索未知。

units.en: The story reaches a climax when she decided to leave that gloomy little cove: She stepped on a man's skull.
units.zh: 当她决定离开那个阴沉的小海湾时，故事达到了高潮：她踩到了一个男人的头骨。

units.en: Then the action falls as she laid down her flowers.
units.zh: 然后，当她放下鲜花时，行动落下。

units.en: In the conclusion, the author says: "And the summer was over" a short yet very symbolic concluding sentence for the story.
units.zh: 在结论中，作者说：“夏天结束了”，这是一个简短但非常具有象征意义的结论句子。

units.en: The main character in the fable is a coyote—a common figure in Native American folklore that is usually portrayed as a trickster and a troublemaker.

units.en: It was harvest time, and the dove was in the field collecting the seeds of the kwakwi grass.

units.en: To separate the seeds from the stalks, she had to rub the tassels vigorously.

units.en: But the kwakwi grass was very sharp and the dove cut her hands.

units.en: • What is the role of conflict in narrative writing?
units.zh: • 冲突在叙事写作中的作用是什么？

units.en: Conflict is the key to plotting a great script.
units.zh: 冲突是绘制出色脚本的关键。

units.en: It defines the parameters of the story,
units.zh: 它定义了故事的参数，

units.en: Unit 6 Conflict and Harmony
units.zh: 6 冲突与和谐

units.en: helps to generate tension and suspense and shapes the audiences experience of the characters.
units.zh: 有助于产生紧张和悬念，塑造观众对角色的体验。

units.en: When conflict is properly developed, the story has the best chance of fulfilling the audiences expectations.
units.zh: 当冲突得到适当发展时，故事最有可能满足观众的期望。

units.en: 1. The main conflict
units.zh: 1.主要冲突

units.en: Every plot needs a main conflict for the protagonist to face.
units.zh: 每个情节都需要主角面对主要的冲突。

units.en: This conflict defines
units.zh: 这种冲突定义了

units.en: the basic parameters of the plot and raises the dramatic question of the story (i.e., whether the protagonist will prevail or not) that is answered at the climax.
units.zh: 情节的基本参数并提出了故事的戏剧性问题（即主角是否会占上风），这在高潮时得到了回答。

units.en: It contains the protagonist's main objective and the main obstacle.
units.zh: 它包含主角的主要目标和主要障碍。

units.en: 2. Characters in conflict
units.zh: 2.冲突中的角色

units.en: In most cases, the characters (especially in the protagonist/antagonist axis, but in other character relationships, too) involved in a conflict are rival characters who usually contrast with each other.
units.zh: 在大多数情况下，冲突中涉及的角色（尤其是在主角/对手轴中，但在其他角色关系中）是通常相互对比的对手角色。

units.en: However, opposing characters aren't always antagonists; sometimes, they just represent opposing ideas.
units.zh: 然而，对立的角色并不总是对手。 有时，它们只是代表对立的想法。

units.en: These opposing characters make the meaning of the story clearer because they reveal contradictory traits and values.
units.zh: 这些对立的角色使故事的含义更清晰，因为它们揭示了矛盾的特征和价值观。

units.en: When creating characters, writers need to clearly define their opposing
units.zh: 在创建角色时，作家需要清楚地定义他们的对立面

units.en: characteristics and values, especially for the protagonist and the antagonist.
units.zh: 特征和价值观，特别是对于主角和对手。

units.en: Contrast them not only in what they do and what they want to achieve, but also in what they think.
units.zh: 对比他们所做的事情和想要实现的目标，而且在他们的想法上进行对比。

units.en: 3. Suspense in conflict
units.zh: 3. 冲突中的悬念

units.en: The sort of suspense created by conflict is what Jessamyn West is supposed to have called "willy wonty," the reader's uncertainty as to whether a character "will" or "won't" commit an act, decide a matter, do a deed, choose one instead of another, give up or go on, marry the girl or let her go.
units.zh: 由冲突造成的悬念就是杰萨明·韦斯特（Jessamyn West）所谓的“威利·温蒂”（Willy Wonty），读者对角色“将”或“不会”做出行为、决定、做某事、选择一个而不是另一个、放弃或去的不确定性的不确定性 继续，嫁给女孩或让她走。

units.en: "Willy wonty" can be a wonderfully effective way of getting the reader to read on: It is the suspenseful reaction at its simplest.
units.zh: “Willy Wonty”可以成为让读者继续阅读的非常有效的方式：它是最简单的悬念反应。

units.en: But to be effective, the situation of the conflict must be developed so that the forces, weights or values on each side are more or less balanced.
units.zh: 但为了有效，必须发展冲突的情况，使双方的力量、权重或价值或多或少是平衡的。

units.en: If we are to have any interest in whether a character will or won't, then the reasons for him to do it or not to do it.
units.zh: 如果我们要对一个角色是否愿意或不会有任何兴趣，那么他这样做或不这样做的原因。

units.en: the pressures and pulls on him in both directions, must be fairly equally presented.
units.zh: 两个方向的压力和拉力，必须相当平等。

units.en: All that is well enough, but the difficulty is that the more successfully the conflict is developed, the harder it is to resolve.
units.zh: 这一切都足够好，但困难在于冲突越成功，解决的难度就越大。

units.en: The more uncertain a reader is made to become as to what the outcome of a story is going to be, the less likely it is that he's going to be convinced by the ending when it finally arrives.
units.zh: 读者越不确定故事的结果将是什么，当故事最终到达时，他就越不可能被结局说服。

units.en: In both cases the writer and the reader are working against each other, and also trying to outguess each other.
units.zh: 在这两种情况下，作者和读者都在相互对抗，也试图互相掩饰。

units.zh: 我可以从她脸上的表情中看出她在嘲笑我。

units.en: She knew that the swing was mine and yet she was on it.
units.zh: 她知道秋千是我的，但她就在上面。

units.en: "Get off my swing, right now!"
units.zh: “下车，马上！”

units.en: I shouted at her.
units.zh: 我对她大喊。

units.en: She smiled, "Nope," and then kept on swinging.
units.zh: 她笑了笑，“不”，然后继续摇摆不定。

units.en: "Get off now or else," I stated between clenched teeth.
units.zh: “现在下车，否则，”我咬牙切齿地说。

units.en: "Or else what?" she smirked and then stuck her tongue out at me.
units.zh: “或者什么？” 她笑了笑，然后对我吐了吐舌头。

units.en: Next, blood filled my face.
units.zh: 接下来，我的脸上充满了鲜血。

units.en: My fists tightened until my fingernails dug into the palms.
units.zh: 我的拳头收紧，直到我的指甲伸进手掌。

units.en: I ran at full speed to her.
units.zh: 我全速跑到她身边。

units.en: My stubby, little legs gained speed.
units.zh: 我粗短的小腿加快了速度。

units.en: I felt like Batman flying through the air.
units.zh: 我感觉就像蝙蝠侠在空中飞翔。

units.en: I threw my body at her, knocking us both onto the ground.
units.zh: 我把身体扔给她，把我们俩都撞倒在地。

units.en: I had always been a biter.
units.zh: 我一直是个苦涩的人。

units.en: I was the type of kid that bit the neighbor's kid and chewed on tables.
units.zh: 我是那种咬邻居的孩子并咀嚼桌子的孩子。

units.en: It was my defense mechanism.
units.zh: 这是我的防御机制。

units.en: I would bite on something whenever I was frustrated or wanted to get someone's attention.
units.zh: 每当我感到沮丧或想引起某人的注意时，我都会咬一些东西。

units.en: It always worked.
units.zh: 它一直有效。

units.en: My sister, Mel, was thrown to the ground and still disoriented.
units.zh: 我的妹妹梅尔被扔在地上，仍然迷失方向。

units.en: I took advantage of the situation and sunk my teeth into her smooth, pink cheek.
units.zh: 我利用这种情况，把牙齿咬进了她光滑的粉红色脸颊。

units.en: Blood filled my mouth and I could hear her screaming.
units.zh: 鲜血充满了我的嘴，我能听到她的尖叫声。

units.en: I felt my mother's arms wrap around my waist.
units.zh: 我感觉到妈妈的手臂环住了我的腰。

units.en: She pulled me until I was
units.zh: 她拉着我直到我

units.en: Unit 6 Conflict and Harmony 147
units.zh: 第 6 单元 冲突与和谐 147

units.en: completely off my sister, so I unclenched my teeth.
units.zh: 完全离开我的妹妹，所以我松开了我的牙齿。

units.en: Mel held her face while the blood spilled between her white fingers.
units.zh: 梅尔抱着她的脸，而她的白手指间溢出了鲜血。

units.en: I climbed onto my swing while they rushed her inside.
units.zh: 当他们把她冲进去时，我爬上了我的秋千。

units.en: Miraculously, she didn't need stitches, but she and I both learned something
units.zh: 奇迹般地，她不需要缝针，但她和我都学到了一些东西

units.en: about one another, which took a long time for us to get over.
units.zh: 关于彼此，这花了很长时间才让我们克服。

units.en: We learned that I would use violence to get what I wanted and that she would continue to bait me until I got there.
units.zh: 我们了解到我会使用暴力来获得我想要的东西，并且她会继续引诱我，直到我到达那里。

units.en: As the robot came closer, Zantur knew it would be almost impossible to escape.
units.zh: 随着机器人越来越近，Zantur 知道几乎不可能逃脱。

units.en: He
units.zh: 他

units.en: slipped around a corner and held his breath as the metallic monitor clanked by.
units.zh: 当金属监视器叮当作响时，他在一个角落里滑了下来，屏住了呼吸。

units.en: Zantur was determined to get out...
units.zh: Zantur 决心要出去...

units.en: He didn't know why hed let the others talk him into coming in the first place!
units.zh: 他不知道为什么他首先让其他人说服他来！

units.en: 148 Writing Critically 1

units.en: They knew of his fear, yet they persisted, taunting him until he agreed to join them.
units.zh: 他们知道他的恐惧，但他们坚持了下来，嘲弄他，直到他同意加入他们。

units.en: But now... now he just couldn't go through with it!
units.zh: 但现在……现在他就是无法通过它！

units.en: He carefully peered around the corner.
units.zh: 他小心翼翼地在拐角处凝视着。

units.en: The robot was nowhere in sight, so Zantur inched his way toward an EXIT sign flashing ahead of him.
units.zh: 机器人不见了，所以Zantur向着他前面闪烁的出口标志缓步走去。

units.en: Just as he reached out to unlatch the door, the robot grabbed his arm.
units.zh: 就在他伸手打开门的时候，机器人抓住了他的手臂。

units.en: "CAUGHT! CAUGHT!" it beeped loudly.
units.zh: “抓住了！被抓住了！” 它响亮地发出哔哔声。

units.en: People came rushing down the hall.
units.zh: 人们冲下大厅。

units.en: "Aha! It was you!" someone shouted.
units.zh: “啊哈！是你！” 有人喊道。

units.en: "Are you just getting here... trying to get in through a latched door?"
units.zh: “你只是来这里……试图通过锁着的门进入？”

units.en: Zantur pulled his arm from the robot's clutch.
units.zh: Zantur从机器人的离合器中拉出手臂。

units.en: "Ye-ye-yeah!" he stammered.
units.zh: “是的，是的！” 他结结巴巴。

units.en: "Sorry to be
units.zh: “对不起

units.en: late.
units.zh: 迟到。

units.en: I'm really looking forward to this!"
units.zh: 我真的很期待这个！”

units.en: Then he forced a smile as he joined his graduating class in the dance room for the prom.
units.zh: 然后，当他在舞厅的舞蹈室参加毕业舞会时，他勉强笑了笑。

units.en: He looked at Debu and she shyly smiled.
units.zh: 他看着德布，她害羞地笑了笑。

units.en: He so wished he wasn't afraid to ask her to dance!
units.zh: 他真希望他不怕叫她跳舞！

units.en: Excerpt 2
units.zh: 摘录 2

units.en: No Exit 2
units.zh: 没有出口 2

units.en: As the footsteps came closer, Ryan knew it would be almost impossible to escape.
units.zh: 随着脚步声越来越近，瑞恩知道几乎不可能逃脱。

units.en: He slipped around a corner and held his breath as footsteps hurried by.
units.zh: 他绕过一个角落，屏住呼吸，脚步声匆匆而过。

units.en: He was determined to get out and get help....
units.zh: 他下定决心要出去寻求帮助......

units.en: He didn't know why he'd let the others talk him into coming in the first place!
units.zh: 他不知道为什么他会让其他人说服他来！

units.en: They had persisted, taunting him until he had agreed to join them.
units.zh: 他们一直坚持，嘲讽他，直到他同意加入他们。

units.en: Now... now he just wanted out!
units.zh: 现在……现在他只是想出去！

units.en: Ryan cautiously peered around the corner.
units.zh: 瑞恩小心翼翼地看着拐角处。

units.en: There was no one in sight, so he inched his way down the silent hallway.
units.zh: 看不到一个人，所以他在寂静的走廊里慢慢走下去。

units.en: It was so dark he could hardly see where he was going.
units.zh: 天太黑了，他几乎看不到他要去哪里。

units.en: Then he saw a beam of light and ducked low, crouching behind a large box just as someone came by.
units.zh: 然后他看到一束光，低头躲在一个大盒子后面，就在有人经过的时候。

units.en: "Did you find him?" a hoarse voice murmured from somewhere below.
units.zh: “你找到他了吗？” 下面的某个地方传来了沙哑的声音。

units.en: "No... I think he may have got out!" replied a nearby raspy voice.
units.zh: “不……我想他可能已经出去了！” 附近的一个刺耳的声音回答道。

units.en: "But he's so scared he won't talk!"
units.zh: “但他太害怕了，他不会说话！”

units.en: Ryan hardly breathed as the footsteps came closer, then faded away and he heard a door close.
units.zh: 瑞恩几乎没有呼吸，脚步声越来越近，然后消失了，他听到一扇门关上了。

units.en: He wondered where his friends were.
units.zh: 他想知道他的朋友在哪里。

units.en: Had they been lucky enough to get out?
units.zh: 他们有幸离开吗？

units.en: For a moment, he was angry.
units.zh: 一瞬间，他很生气。

units.en: After all, it'd been their idea to come to this empty old house....
units.zh: 毕竟，来到这座空荡荡的老房子是他们的想法……

units.en: the one people thought was haunted!
units.zh: 人们以为是闹鬼！

units.en: As a kid, Ryan was always afraid of the place....
units.zh: 小时候，瑞恩总是害怕这个地方......

units.en: especially after his older brother had said there were monsters inside.
units.zh: 尤其是在他哥哥说里面有怪物之后。

units.en: Now he was here... and his so-called friends were somewhere else!
units.zh: 现在他在这里……他所谓的朋友在别处！

units.en: They just wanted some scary fun, they'd said.
units.zh: 他们只是想要一些可怕的乐趣，他们说。

units.en: How could they have known the old house was a meeting spot for drug dealers?
units.zh: 他们怎么会知道老房子是毒贩的聚会场所？

units.en: How could they have anticipated running into a drug deal in the making?
units.zh: 他们怎么能预料到正在达成的毒品交易呢？

units.en: But they had... and so they had scattered, with some tough types chasing them!
units.zh: 但他们有……所以他们分散了，有一些艰难的类型在追逐他们！

units.en: Now Ryan didn't know if anyone got out safely or not.
units.zh: 现在瑞恩不知道是否有人安全离开。

units.en: But he was determined he would!
units.zh: 但他下定决心他会！

units.en: All was quiet, so Ryan crept from room to room, looking for a way out.
units.zh: 一切都很安静，所以瑞恩从一个房间爬到另一个房间，寻找出路。

units.en: Finally, he spotted an unboarded window that was broken.
units.zh: 最后，他发现了一扇破碎的未上板的窗户。

units.en: As silently and carefully as possible, he slipped out.
units.zh: 尽可能安静和小心地，他溜了出去。

units.en: It was a long way down to the ground, but somehow he made it.
units.zh: 到地上还有很长的路要走，但不知何故他做到了。

units.en: Ryan ran for his life!
units.zh: 瑞恩为他的生命奔跑！

units.en: Once he felt safe, he called 911 on his cell phone.
units.zh: 一旦他感到安全，他就用手机拨打了 911。

units.en: The police quietly arrived shortly after that.
units.zh: 不久之后，警察悄悄到达。

units.en: They busted up the drug deal, arrested the
units.zh: 他们破坏了毒品交易，逮捕了

units.en: dealers, and found the other kids.
units.zh: 经销商，并找到了其他孩子。

units.en: Ryan was happy to see that his friends were safe.
units.zh: 瑞恩很高兴看到他的朋友们安全。

units.en: They'd hunkered down in the cellar and waited.
units.zh: 他们蹲在地窖里等着。

units.en: "We knew you'd get help, said his friend Greg. "Yeah?" replied Ryan. "Next time we might not be so lucky!"
units.zh: “我们知道你会得到帮助，他的朋友格雷格说。“是吗？”瑞恩回答说，“下次我们可能不会那么幸运了！”

units.en: The stern voice of a police officer added, "There better never be a next time!"
units.zh: 警察严厉的声音补充道：“最好永远不要下一次！”

units.en: The next week, a crew tore down the old building to make way for a new one.
units.zh: 接下来的一周，一个工作人员拆毁了旧建筑，为一栋新建筑让路。

units.en: A sign at the site read HOME OF THE NEW COMMUNITY CENTER.
units.zh: 网站上的一个标志是新社区中心的主页。

units.en: Design your own plot diagram and clarify the elements in it.
units.zh: 设计您自己的绘图图并阐明其中的元素。

units.en: Then write a short
units.zh: 然后写一个短片

units.en: story based on your plot design.
units.zh: 故事基于您的情节设计。

units.en: Step A: You may start your story with the everyday life like Cinderella sweeping floors or Harry Potter living with the Dursleys.
units.zh: 步骤 A：您可以从日常生活开始，例如灰姑娘扫地或与德思礼一起生活的哈利波特。

units.en: Think of the background for your story and choose your main character(s).
units.zh: 想想你的故事的背景，并选择你的主要角色。

units.en: Step B: Imagine that your main characters) is(are) faced with certain problem or obstacle that needs to be addressed.
units.zh: 步骤 B：假设您的主要角色）面临着需要解决的某些问题或障碍。

units.en: For example, Cinderella would like to go to the palace ball but with no proper clothes or Harry Potter thought that the sorcerer's stone would be stolen.
units.zh: 例如，灰姑娘想去宫殿舞会，但没有合适的衣服，或者哈利·波特认为巫师的石头会被偷走。

units.en: Step C: Your main character(s) starts) to overcome the problem.
units.zh: 步骤 C：你的主角开始）克服这个问题。

units.en: For instance, Cinderella overcame hers with the help of her fairy godmother and Harry Potter overcame his with the help of his friends.
units.zh: 例如，灰姑娘在她的仙女教母和哈利波特的帮助下克服了她的战胜了他的朋友。

units.en: Step D: Create a climax for your main character(s), such as Cinderella and her sisters trying on the glass slipper or Harry Potter confronting Voldemort.
units.zh: 步骤 D：为您的主角创造一个高潮，例如灰姑娘和她的姐妹们试穿玻璃拖鞋或与伏地魔对峙的哈利波特。

units.en: Step E: Design the consequences of the conflict or climax.
units.zh: 步骤E：设计冲突或高潮的后果。

units.en: For example, Cinderella married the prince and Dumbledore rescued Harry Potter.
units.zh: 例如，灰姑娘嫁给了王子，邓布利多救了哈利波特。

units.en: Step F: Now you come to the end of your story.
units.zh: 步骤 F：现在你来到了故事的结尾。

units.en: For instance, Cinderella and her prince lived happily ever after and Harry Potter was hailed as a hero at the year-end feast.
units.zh: 例如，灰姑娘和她的王子从此过上了幸福的生活，哈利·波特在年终盛宴上被誉为英雄。

units.en: Step G: When you finish your draft, please ask your partner to read it and provide some feedback.
units.zh: 步骤 G：完成草稿后，请让您的合作伙伴阅读并提供一些反馈。

units.en: Analyzing the plot structure of a story can help us better deconstruct the plot of the story and understand the writing techniques that the author uses in developing the plot.
units.zh: 分析故事的情节结构可以帮助我们更好地解构故事的情节，了解作者在剧情中使用的写作技巧。

units.en: Plot diagrams or outlines can help a writer be clear about what he or she is going to write and organize the ideas properly.
units.zh: 情节图或大纲可以帮助作家清楚地了解他或她将要写什么和正确组织想法。

units.en: Read the following two texts and find out how the plot unfolds.
units.zh: 阅读以下两篇文章，了解情节如何展开。

units.en: Text A
units.zh: 文本 A

units.en: The Story of an Hour!
units.zh: 一个小时的故事！

units.en: Kate Chopin
units.zh: 凯特肖邦

units.en: Knowing that Mrs. Mallard was afflicted with a heart trouble, great care was
units.zh: 知道马拉德夫人患有心脏病，非常小心

units.en: taken to break to her as gently as possible the news of her husband's death.
units.zh: 被她丈夫去世的消息尽可能温柔地打破。

units.en: It was her sister Josephine who told her, in broken sentences, veiled hints that revealed in half concealing.
units.zh: 是她的姐姐约瑟芬用断断续续的句子告诉她，隐蔽的暗示隐藏在一半。

units.en: Her husband's friend Richards was there, too, near her.
units.zh: 她丈夫的朋友理查兹也在她附近。

units.en: It was he who had been in the newspaper office when intelligence of the railroad disaster was received, with Brently Mallard's name leading the list of "killed."
units.zh: 收到铁路灾难情报时，他一直在报社，布伦特利·马拉德的名字在“被杀”名单中领先。

units.en: He had only taken the time to assure himself of its truth by a second telegram, and had hastened to forestall any less careful, less tender friend in bearing the sad message.
units.zh: 他只是花时间通过第二个电报向自己保证了它的真相，并且匆忙阻止了任何不那么小心、不那么温柔的朋友来传递悲伤的信息。

units.en: She did not hear the story as many women have heard the same, with a paralyzed inability to accept its significance.
units.zh: 她没有听到这个故事，因为许多女性都听过同样的故事，无法接受它的意义。

units.en: She wept at once, with sudden, wild abandonment, in her sister's arms.

units.en: • Cohesion
units.zh: • 凝聚力

units.en: In writing, every writer wishes to make their points clear, with logical links between
units.zh: 在写作中，每个作家都希望明确他们的观点，并在逻辑之间建立逻辑联系。

units.en: the various points, thus making their writing easy to read.
units.zh: 各点，从而使他们的写作易于阅读。

units.en: It can be said that cohesion is the "glue" that joins one's ideas together to form a cohesive whole.
units.zh: 可以说，凝聚力是将一个人的想法结合在一起以形成一个有凝聚力的整体的“粘合剂”。

units.en: According to Halliday
units.zh: 根据哈利迪

units.en: and Hasan, there are six main ways that cohesion is created in a text.
units.zh: 和哈桑，在文本中创建凝聚力有六种主要方式。

units.en: These are reference, substitution, lexis, ellipsis, cohesive nouns and conjunction.
units.zh: 这些是参考、替换、词汇、省略号、凝聚力名词和连词。

units.en: Reference is a way of creating cohesion using determiners (e.g., this, that, these, those) or pronouns (e.g., him, them, me, your, their, hers, which, who, whose).
units.zh: 参考是一种使用限定词（例如，this、this、thes）或代词（例如，他、他们、我、你的、他们的、她的、谁的、谁的）来创建凝聚力的方式。

units.en: This type of cohesion can also be achieved comparatively with words or phrases like similarly, likewise and less.
units.zh: 这种类型的凝聚力也可以通过类似、同样和更少的单词或短语来实现。

units.en: • I need to buy some new shoes and those blue ones look lovely!
units.zh: • 我需要买一些新鞋，那些蓝色的鞋子看起来很可爱！

units.en: • The customer demonstrated outside the store, but he did not want to do so.
units.zh: • 顾客在商店外展示，但他不想这样做。

units.en: • The winters can be wet and cold in London.
units.zh: • 伦敦的冬天可能是潮湿和寒冷的。

units.en: The same is unhappily also true for the summers.
units.zh: 不幸的是，夏天也是如此。

units.en: • He had been far from the scene of accident, and did not even know there had been one.
units.zh: • 他离事故现场很远，甚至不知道有一个。

units.en: (Text A)
units.zh: （文本A）

units.en: • No one knew Prince Edward Street as well as did Pierre Dupin, for Pierre had delivered milk to the families on the street for thirty years now.
units.zh: • 没有人知道爱德华王子街和皮埃尔·杜平，因为皮埃尔已经向街上的家人运送牛奶三十年了。

units.en: (Text B)
units.zh: （文本 B）

units.en: Lexis is a way of creating cohesion by using synonyms (e.g., beautiful for lovely)
units.zh: Lexis 是一种通过使用同义词来创造凝聚力的方式（例如，美丽的可爱）

units.en: and hyponyms and superordinates (eg., daffodil, rose and daisy are all hyponyms of the superordinate flower).
units.zh: 和下位词和上位词（例如，水仙花、玫瑰和雏菊都是上级花的下位词）。

units.en: Lexical chains are created in a text by using words in the same lexical set (e.g., army, soldiers, barracks, weapons.
units.zh: 词汇链是在文本中使用同一词汇集（例如，军队、士兵、军营、武器）中的单词创建的。

units.en: These techniques allow for the central themes to be reiterated in a way that avoids monotony for the reader.
units.zh: 这些技术允许以避免读者单调的方式重申中心主题。

units.en: Here are more examples:
units.zh: 以下是更多示例：

units.en: • The art gallery was exhibiting all his paintings, but not the sculpture or his early etchings.
units.zh: • 艺术画廊展示了他所有的画作，但不是雕塑或他早期的蚀刻作品。

units.en: • The players gathered on the pitch and kicked the ball around, before playing in earnest.
units.zh: • 球员们聚集在球场上踢球，然后认真地比赛。

units.en: • The students attending the lecture all took notes and asked a lot of questions.
units.zh: • 参加讲座的学生都做笔记并提出了很多问题。

units.en: • Pierre had a remarkable memory.
units.zh: • 皮埃尔有着非凡的记忆力。

units.en: When he arrived at the stable hed always remember to tell Jacques.
units.zh: 当他到达马厩时，他总是记得告诉雅克。

units.en: (Text B)
units.zh: （文本 B）

units.en: Ellipsis is the act of leaving out one or more words that are not necessary for understanding a phrase or a sentence (e.g., John can type and I can <type>, too!; I don't want to go out, do you ‹want to go out>?).
units.zh: 省略号是省略了理解短语或句子所必需的一个或多个单词的行为（例如，John Can Type，我也可以<type>！；我不想出去，你想出去吗>？）。

units.en: Look at the following sentences and see whether you can understand them while some words and expressions are omitted.
units.zh: 查看以下句子，看看您是否可以理解它们，而省略了一些单词和表达方式。

units.en: Here are more examples:
units.zh: 以下是更多示例：

units.en: •Ann was quite happy to handle the snake, although the others did not want to.
units.zh: •Ann 很乐意处理这条蛇，尽管其他人不想。

units.en: • Here is the deck of cards, now take any four.
units.zh: • 这是一副纸牌，现在拿四张。

units.en: • I wanted to take another chocolate, but I knew I must not.
units.zh: • 我想再吃一次巧克力，但我知道我不能。

units.en: • And yet she had loved him-sometimes.
units.zh: • 然而她曾经爱过他——有时。

units.en: Often she had not.
units.zh: 她经常没有。

units.en: (Text A)
units.zh: （文本A）

units.en: • Pierre's huge walrus mustache was pure white now and Joseph didnt lift his knees so high or raise his head quite as much.
units.zh: • Pierre 的巨大海象胡须现在是纯白色的，Joseph 没有把膝盖抬得那么高，也没有抬起头。

units.en: (Text B)
units.zh: （文本 B）

units.en: Cohesive nouns are a kind of lexical reference.
units.zh: 内聚名词是一种词汇参考。

units.en: They can summarize many words
units.zh: 他们可以总结很多词

units.en: in one (e.g., attitude, solution, difficulty), therefore, they have been called "umbrella nouns."
units.zh: 因此，在一个（例如，态度、解决方案、难度）中，它们被称为“伞形名词”。

units.en: They are used to signal what is to come (e.g., the problem to be discussed), or what can refer back (e.g., the issue mentioned above).
units.zh: 它们用于指示即将发生的事情（例如，要讨论的问题），或者可以引用的内容（例如，上面提到的问题）。

units.en: Here are more examples:
units.zh: 以下是更多示例：

units.en: • Over a million dollars was spent last year.
units.zh: • 去年花费了超过一百万美元。

units.en: This investment was needed and was wisely spent.
units.zh: 这项投资是必要的，并且被明智地花费了。

units.en: • The two cars collided on the flyover.
units.zh: • 两辆车在天桥上相撞。

units.en: However, nobody was hurt in the accident.
units.zh: 然而，没有人在事故中受伤。

units.en: • The children were always fighting, but no one seemed concerned about the problem.
units.zh: • 孩子们一直在打架，但似乎没有人担心这个问题。

units.en: Unit 6 Conflict and Harmony
units.zh: 6 冲突与和谐

units.en: Conjunction includes listing words such as firstly, next and lastly; linkers for addition such as moreover and and; linkers for concession such as but, however and despite; and words indicating cause and effect such as so, because and as a result.
units.zh: 连词包括列出诸如第一、下一个和最后的单词； 用于添加的连接器，例如 SORT 和 AND； 让步的链接器，例如但是，但是和尽管； 和表示因果的词，因为和结果。

units.en: • Firstly, we need to water all the plants because it has been very dry recently.
units.zh: • 首先，我们需要给所有植物浇水，因为它最近非常干燥。

units.en: • The dog bit him; therefore, he needed medical attention immediately.
units.zh: • 狗咬他； 因此，他需要立即就医。

units.en: • In addition, government expenditure needs to be cut in this fiscal year.
units.zh: • 此外，本财政年度需要削减政府支出。

units.en: • Montreal is a very large city, but, like all large cities, it has some very small streets.
units.zh: • 蒙特利尔是一个非常大的城市，但与所有大城市一样，它有一些非常小的街道。

units.en: (Text B)
units.zh: （文本 B）

units.en: • The cooks knew that Pierre could neither read nor write, so instead of following the usual custom of leaving a note in an empty milk bottle if an additional quart of milk was needed they would... (Text B)
units.zh: • 厨师们知道皮埃尔既不会读也不会写，所以如果需要额外的一夸脱牛奶，他们不会遵循通常的习惯，即在空牛奶瓶中留下一张纸条……（文本 B）

units.en: • Unity
units.zh: • 团结

units.en: Unity refers to the oneness of your writing.
units.zh: 统一是指你写作的统一性。

units.en: The writing should have one focus
units.zh: 写作应该有一种焦点

units.en: of a central idea or theme.
units.zh: 一个中心思想或主题。

units.en: Read the following short paragraph, and figure out which sentence does not belong to this paragraph.
units.zh: 阅读以下短段，找出哪个句子不属于本段。

units.en: The most embarrassing moment of my sophomore year was how I earned my nickname, Crash.
units.zh: 我大二最尴尬的时刻是我如何赢得我的昵称，Crash。

units.en: It all started right after school when I turned onto the busiest street by the school.
units.zh: 这一切都始于放学后，当我转向学校最繁忙的街道时。

units.en: First I pulled up right behind a truck at a stop sign.
units.zh: 首先，我在停车标志的卡车后面停了下来。

units.en: It was such a fine day.
units.zh: 这是美好的一天。

units.en: After a second, I heard my friend Tom shout at me and tell me that I was so close that I was going to hit the truck in front of me. I retorted that he should be careful himself because he was hanging out of the window.
units.zh: 一秒钟后，我听到我的朋友汤姆对我大喊，告诉我我离得太近了，我要撞到我面前的卡车上。 我反驳说他自己应该小心，因为他挂在窗外。

units.en: Distracted, I thought the long line of traffic had started to move, but it hadn't.
units.zh: 心烦意乱，我以为长长的交通线已经开始移动，但事实并非如此。

units.en: In the blink of an eye / hit the back of the truck in front of me.
units.zh: 眨眼间/撞到我面前的卡车后部。

units.en: Humiliated and scared, I still had to drive my totaled car home.
units.zh: 羞辱和害怕，我仍然不得不把我的车开回家。

units.en: During school that year, I never did hear the end of what had happened that day.
units.zh: 那一年的学校里，我从来没有听到那天发生的事情的结束。

units.en: In this narrative paragraph, the narrator was talking about his most embarrassing moment: how he had a traffic accident.
units.zh: 在这个叙述段落中，叙述者在谈论他最尴尬的时刻：他是如何发生交通事故的。

units.en: Almost all of the sentences center around the traffic accident: the traffic at that time, how his friend's shout distracted him, him because of the accident.
units.zh: 几乎所有的句子都以交通事故为中心：当时的交通，他朋友的叫喊如何分散了他的注意力，他是因为事故。

units.en: This indicates the unity of this paragraph.
units.zh: 这表明本段的统一性。

units.en: However, the sentence "It was such a fine day" has nothing to do with the embarrassing moment
units.zh: 然而，这句话“真是美好的一天”与尴尬的时刻无关

units.en: the accidental collision with the truck and even the fact that his friend made fun of
units.zh: 与卡车的意外碰撞，甚至他的朋友取笑的事实

units.en: and should be deleted.
units.zh: 并且应该被删除。

units.en: Read the following sentences and see whether they can be improved to be more cohesive.
units.zh: 阅读以下句子，看看它们是否可以改进以更具凝聚力。

units.en: 1) She was pressed down by a physical exhaustion that haunted her body.
units.zh: 1）她被困在她身体上的身体疲惫压倒。

units.en: This physical exhaustion also seemed to reach into her soul.
units.zh: 这种身体上的疲惫似乎也进入了她的灵魂。

units.en: 2) In the open square before her house, she could see the tops of the trees.
units.zh: 2）在她家前的空旷广场上，她可以看到树顶。

units.en: The tops of the trees were all aquiver with the new spring life.
units.zh: 树的顶部都是新的春天的水晶。

units.en: 3) She was young, with a fair, calm face.
units.zh: 3）她很年轻，脸色白皙，平静。

units.en: The lines of her face bespoke repression and even a certain strength.
units.zh: 她脸上的线条定制压抑，甚至有一定的力量。

units.en: 4) But now there was a dull stare in her eyes, whose gaze was fixed away off yonder on one of those patches of blue sky.
units.zh: 4）但现在她的眼睛里有一种暗淡的凝视，她的目光被那片蓝天的一片遮住了。

units.en: This dull stare was not a glance of reflection, but rather indicated a suspension of intelligent thought.
units.zh: 这种沉闷的凝视不是反思的一瞥，而是表明了一种智慧的停顿。

units.en: 5) There was something coming to her and she was waiting for that something, fearfully.
units.zh: 5) 有什么东西来找她，她正在等待那个东西，恐惧地。

units.en: 6) There would be no powerful will bending hers in that blind persistence with which men and women believe they have a right to impose a private will upon a man or woman.
units.zh: 6) 男人和女人认为他们有权将私人意志强加给男人或女人的那种盲目的坚持不会有强有力的意志。

units.en: 7) And yet she had loved him-sometimes.
units.zh: 7) 然而她曾经爱过他——有时。

units.en: Often she had not loved him.
units.zh: 她常常不爱他。

units.zh: 我们绕过山顶，我们的心跳了起来。

units.en: Below us snaked miles of winding
units.zh: 在我们下方蜿蜒的蜿蜒数英里之下

units.en: blacktop—a motorcyclist's dream.
units.zh: Blacktop——摩托车手的梦想。

units.en: The air was clear and the sun reflected off beetlesized cars inching along thousands of feet below us.

units.en: Plot is the arrangement of events or thoughts in narrative writing.
units.zh: 情节是叙事写作中事件或思想的排列。

units.en: Plot can be divided into five elements: exposition; rising action; climax; falling action; resolution/denouement.
units.zh: 情节可分为五个要素：说明； 上升动作； 高潮； 下降动作； 决议/结局。

units.en: Conflict is a key factor in plot and every plot needs a main conflict.
units.zh: 冲突是情节中的关键因素，每个情节都需要主要冲突。

units.en: Cohesion is important in a text to make it clear and easy to follow.
units.zh: 凝聚力在文本中很重要，以使其清晰易懂。

units.en: There are six main ways to achieve cohesion: reference, substitution, lexis, ellipsis, cohesive nouns and conjunction.
