units.en: • What is style?
units.zh: • 什么是风格？

units.en: Every author has his or her own style, using literary devices in a particular way
units.zh: 每个作者都有自己的风格，以特定的方式使用文学设备

units.en: that makes his or her writing recognizable.
units.zh: 这使他或她的写作变得可识别。

units.en: Style is usually confined to the elements of language: words, syntax, punctuation and so on-everything from the simple mechanics to the rhetoric that may reflect a given author's originality.
units.zh: 风格通常仅限于语言的元素：单词、句法、标点符号等——从简单的机制到可能反映给定作者独创性的修辞的一切。

units.en: Authors make stylistic choices to set the mood of their stories, reveal characters and give voice to their individual personalities.
units.zh: 作者做出风格选择来设定故事的情绪，揭示人物并表达他们的个性。

units.en: Style is only one aspect of narration; it contributes only as it works with the other aspects of narration.
units.zh: 风格只是叙述的一方面； 它仅在与叙述的其他方面一起工作时做出贡献。

units.en: The interconnections are throughout, as always.
units.zh: 互连像往常一样贯穿始终。

units.en: The point of view will have a determining effect on style, and be determined by it: Whoever is seeing or telling the story must see and talk in a way that works with all the rest.
units.zh: 观点将对风格产生决定性的影响，并由它决定：看到或讲述故事的人必须以与其他人一起工作的方式看到和交谈。

units.en: This, of course, brings us to the aspect of characterization: The sorts of characters the author creates will speak the language of his or her world.
units.zh: 当然，这将我们带到了人物塑造的方面：作者创造的各种人物将说出他或她的世界的语言。

units.en: What "happens" to the author, the plots of his or her stories, will be the sorts of things that happen to those sorts of characters in those sorts of places—wherever it is or whatever it is like there—for the setting, too, will be determined by its relation to all the other aspects of the author's world.
units.zh: 作者的“发生”，他或她的故事的情节，将是那些发生在这些地方的人物身上的那种事情——无论它在哪里——无论它在哪里——对于环境来说，环境也将取决于它与所有其他方面的关系。 作者的世界。

units.en: With regard to style, you could ask:
units.zh: 关于风格，你可以问：

units.en: • What are some of the stylistic choices made by the author?
units.zh: • 作者的风格选择有哪些？

units.en: Does the author make use of a wide variety of stylistic devices or limit the selection to only a few?
units.zh: 作者是使用各种风格的设备还是将选择限制在少数？

units.en: • Why is the author's style so recognizable?
units.zh: • 为什么作者的风格如此辨认？

units.en: • How do specific choices expand or diminish the story?
units.zh: • 具体的选择如何扩展或缩小故事？

units.en: • How do the stylistic choices in one story compare or contrast with those in other stories?
units.zh: • 一个故事中的文体选择如何与其他故事中的选择进行比较或对比？

units.en: Now consider this story opening:
units.zh: 现在考虑这个故事开场：

units.en: The hour was late.
units.zh: 时间迟到了。

units.en: Mr. Bear was tired, Mrs. Bear was tired, and Baby Bear was tired
units.zh: 熊先生累了，熊太太累了，小熊也累了

units.en: —Peace at Last by Jill Murphy
units.zh: ——吉尔·墨菲终于和平了

units.en: Why does the author write it in this way?
units.zh: 作者为什么要这样写？

units.en: She uses "The hour was late" rather than "It was late," and instead of "all the bears were tired," she repeats "was tired" slowly and sequentially for each of the Bear family.
units.zh: 她用“时间迟到”而不是“迟到”，而不是“所有的熊都累了”，她用“累了”为每个熊家族慢慢地重复着“累了”。

units.en: Actually, this is from a picture book which is aimed at children at the earliest stages of reading, and would therefore be read to children by adults.
units.zh: 实际上，这是一本针对儿童阅读的早期阶段的图画书，因此会被成年人阅读给儿童。

units.en: The author uses language in very specific ways to create the lovely and soft narrative for children.
units.zh: 作者以非常具体的方式使用语言来为孩子们创造可爱而柔和的叙述。

units.en: Now let's examine the styles of the following two extracts from children's books.
units.zh: 现在让我们来看看以下两个儿童书籍摘录的样式。

units.en: Each one introduces one of the main characters.
units.zh: 每一项都介绍了主要人物之一。

units.en: 168 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 168 思辨写作 1

units.en: Example 1
units.zh: 示例 1

units.en: When Mary Lennox was sent to Misselthwaite Manor to live with her uncle, everyone said she was the most disagreeable-looking child ever seen.
units.zh: 当 Mary Lennox 被送到 Misselthwaite 庄园和她的叔叔住在一起时，每个人都说她是有史以来看起来最令人不快的孩子。

units.en: it was true, too.
units.zh: 这也是真的。

units.en: —The Secret Garden by Frances Hodgson Burnett
units.zh: ——弗朗西斯·霍奇森·伯内特的秘密花园

units.en: Example 2
units.zh: 示例 2

units.en: There are some kids—you can tell just by looking at them—who are good spitters.
units.zh: 有一些孩子——你可以通过看着他们来判断——他们是优秀的吐痰者。

units.en: That's probably the best way to describe Bradley Charkers.
units.zh: 这可能是描述布拉德利·查克斯的最佳方式。

units.en: He looked like a good spitter.
units.zh: 他看起来像一个很好的吐痰者。

units.en: —There's a Boy in the Girl's Bathroom by Louis Sachar
units.zh: ——路易·萨查尔的女孩浴室里有一个男孩

units.en: Neither of the characters is being introduced in a very positive light, but the styles are different.
units.zh: 两个角色都没有以非常积极的方式被引入，但风格不同。

units.en: The narrator's voice is used to create a particular relationship with the reader.
units.zh: 叙述者的声音用于与读者建立特定的关系。

units.en: Each invites the reader in, but using different devices.
units.zh: 每个都邀请读者进入，但使用不同的设备。

units.en: There is an aside ("It was true, too.") in the first one, directed to the reader; in the second example, the author's use of the second person pronoun speaks directly at the reader, assuming a shared experience of spitters.
units.zh: 有一个旁白（“它也是真的。”）在第一个中，针对读者； 在第二个例子中，作者对第二人称代词的使用直接对读者说话，假设有飞溅物的共同经历。

units.en: The vocabulary variants range in formality (kid/child) and the defining feature of the negative description denotes very different contexts.
units.zh: 词汇变体的形式（儿童/儿童）范围内的范围，负面描述的定义特征表示非常不同的上下文。

units.en: Mary was "disagreeable-looking;" this term has a great impact on its use so early in the book.
units.zh: 玛丽“看起来很不满意”； 这个词在本书的早期就对它的使用产生了很大的影响。

units.en: In contrast, "spitter" is street language; it is impolite and has rebellious overtones, that is, no one should spit anyway, and it suggests covert bad behavior, whereas Mary's disagreeableness was very open.
units.zh: 相比之下，“Spitter”是街头语言； 它是不礼貌的，有叛逆的色彩，也就是说，无论如何，任何人都不应该吐口水，这暗示着隐蔽的不良行为，而玛丽的不愉快是非常开放的。

units.en: Both characters violate acceptable codes of behavior.
units.zh: 这两个字符都违反了可接受的行为准则。

units.en: As we can see from these two examples, even books with similar themes may be quite different in style as they will be expressed using different linguistic resources.
units.zh: 正如我们从这两个例子中看到的那样，即使是具有相似主题的书籍，在风格上也可能完全不同，因为它们将使用不同的语言资源来表达。

units.en: • What is tone?
units.zh: • 什么是音调？

units.en: Tone indicates the author's attitude toward his or her subject.
units.zh: 语气表示作者对他或她的主题的态度。

units.en: Integrally linked to
units.zh: 整体链接到

units.en: style, tone not only reveals characters), setting, plot and theme, but also highlights the author's feelings about how these literary elements should play out.
units.zh: 风格、基调不仅揭示了人物）、情节、情节和主题，而且突出了作者对这些文学元素应该如何发挥作用的感受。

units.en: Tone can be humorous, serious, affectionate, warm, cool, condescending or even sarcastic.
units.zh: 语气可以是幽默的、严肃的、深情的、温暖的、凉爽的、居高临下的，甚至是讽刺的。

units.en: When you discuss tone you might ask:
units.zh: 当您讨论语气时，您可能会问：

units.en: • What is the tone used in this particular passage or about this particular character?
units.zh: • 这段特定的段落或关于这个特定角色的基调是什么？

units.en: • What does the tone reveal about the author?
units.zh: • 基调揭示了作者的什么？

units.en: • Is the tone maintained throughout the story or does it shift depending on the scene or the character?
units.zh: • 整个故事的基调是保持的，还是会根据场景或角色而变化？

units.en: • How is the tone reflected in stylistic choices?
units.zh: • 风格如何反映在风格选择中？

units.en: In old-fashioned fiction, it is relatively easy to detect the author's tone.
units.zh: 在老式小说中，相对容易检测到作者的语气。

units.en: In the omniscient point-of-view method, especially, the author would obtrude his or her presence and make his or her comments on the action directly.
units.zh: 尤其是在无所不知的观点方法中，作者会掩盖他或她的存在，并直接对动作发表评论。

units.en: The commentary might be ironic in tone, but is more likely to be sentimental or didactic.
units.zh: 评论的语气可能很讽刺，但更有可能是感性的或说教的。

units.en: In contemporary fiction, the author is often conspicuously absent-especially in the
units.zh: 在当代小说中，作者经常明显地缺席——尤其是在

units.en: Unit 7 Ethnicity and Identity
units.zh: 第 7 单元种族和身份

units.en: first-person and third-person point-of-view methods.
units.zh: 第一人称和第三人称视点方法。

units.en: It is often far more difficult to decide just what an author feels about the characters and their behavior.
units.zh: 决定作者对角色及其行为的感受往往要困难得多。

units.en: Thus the more old-fashioned methods tend toward clarity and sympathy-a kind of subjectivity on the author's part that creates a feeling of involvement.
units.zh: 因此，更老式的方法倾向于清晰和同情——作者的一种主观性，它产生了一种参与感。

units.en: Newer methods tend toward ambiguity and irony—a kind of objectivity on the author's part that creates a feeling of detachment.
units.zh: 较新的方法倾向于模棱两可和讽刺——作者的一种客观性，会产生一种超然的感觉。

units.en: In short, to write a successful short story, the author needs to create a recognizable individual "world" with the help of style and tone.
units.zh: 简而言之，要写一个成功的短篇小说，作者需要在风格和基调的帮助下创造一个可识别的个人“世界”。

units.en: In the previous units, you may have noticed the distinct styles of O. Henry, Ernest Hemingway, Jack London, Guy de Maupassant and Kate Chopin.
units.zh: 在之前的单元中，您可能已经注意到 O. Henry、Ernest Hemingway、Jack London、Guy de Maupassant 和 Kate Chopin 的独特风格。

units.en: Now let's take O. Henry's and Ernest Hemingway's works as examples for further analysis.
units.zh: 现在让我们以 O. Henry 和 Ernest Hemingway 的作品为例进行进一步分析。

units.en: 0. HENRY
units.zh: 0.亨利

units.en: O. Henry's stories frequently have surprising endings.
units.zh: O. Henry 的故事经常有令人惊讶的结局。

units.en: Thus, his stories are also
units.zh: 因此，他的故事也

units.en: known for their witty narration.
units.zh: 以其诙谐的叙述而闻名。

units.en: Most of his stories are set in his own time, the early 20th century.
units.zh: 他的大部分故事都是以他自己的时代为背景的，即 20 世纪初。

units.en: Many take place in New York City and deal for the most part with ordinary people such as clerks, policemen and waitresses.
units.zh: 许多发生在纽约市，大部分时间与文员、警察和女服务员等普通人打交道。

units.en: O. Henry had an inimitable hand for isolating some elements of society and describing them with an incredible economy and grace of language.
units.zh: O. Henry 的手无与伦比，以令人难以置信的经济和语言优雅来隔离社会的一些元素并描述它们。

units.en: "The Cop and the Anthem" in Unit 5 is about a New York City hobo named Soapy, who set out to get arrested so that he could be a guest of the city jail instead of sleeping out in the cold winter.
units.zh: 第 5 单元中的“警察和国歌”讲述了一个名叫索比的纽约市流浪汉，他开始被捕，以便他可以成为城市监狱的客人，而不是在寒冷的冬天睡觉。

units.en: Despite efforts at petty theft, vandalism, disorderly conduct, "mashing" with a young prostitute, etc., Soapy failed to draw the attention of the police.
units.zh: 尽管在小偷小摸、破坏行为、无序行为、与年轻妓女“混搭”等方面做出了努力，Soapy 仍未能引起警方的注意。

units.en: Disconsolate, he paused in front of a church, where an organ anthem inspired him to clean up his life, and was ironically charged for loitering and sentenced to three months in prison.
units.zh: 悲伤的是，他在教堂前停了下来，管风琴国歌激励他清理自己的生命，具有讽刺意味的是，他被指控在监狱中徘徊并被判处三个月徒刑。

units.en: The most important characteristic of this story is its humor or "smiling with tears," which O. Henry shows throughout the whole story with rich rhetorical devices.
units.zh: 这个故事最重要的特征是它的幽默或“微笑着”，O. Henry 在整个故事中展示了丰富的修辞手段。

units.en: He expresses his unique humor through rhetorical devices (e.g., hyperbole, simile, metaphor, personification, irony) to make the reader think more deeply about the story.
units.zh: 他通过修辞手段（例如，夸张、明喻、隐喻、拟人化、讽刺）表达了他独特的幽默感，让读者更深入地思考这个故事。

units.en: Here are some examples.
units.zh: 这里有一些例子。

units.en: Simile
units.zh: 譬喻

units.en: "Don't you figure out that I might have had something to do with it?" said Soapy, not without sarcasm, but friendly, as one greets good fortune.
units.zh: “你不知道我可能和它有关系吗？” 肥皂说，不是没有讽刺，而是友好，因为一个人迎来了好运。

units.en: Soapy threw stones at the glass windows in a shop, and he thought this time he would realize his aspiration to his dreamy island, so he didn't run away.
units.zh: 肥皂在商店的玻璃窗上扔石头，他想这一次他会意识到他对梦幻岛的渴望，所以他没有逃跑。

units.en: Conversely, he waited there anticipating to be arrested like someone who wished to have some luck.
units.zh: 相反，他在那里等待着被捕，就像一个希望有好运的人一样。

units.en: The simile conveys Soapy's eagerness to be caught at this moment.
units.zh: 明喻传达了肥皂在这一刻被抓住的渴望。

units.en: 170 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 170 思辨写作 1

units.en: Metaphor
units.zh: 比喻

units.en: Would never a policeman lay hands on him?
units.zh: 永远不会有警察把手放在他身上吗？

units.en: In his fancy the Island seemed an unattainable Arcadia.
units.zh: 在他的幻想中，这个岛似乎是一个无法实现的阿卡迪亚。

units.en: Arcadia is located at the middle of Baltic Peninsula, where people live an idyllic life.
units.zh: 阿卡迪亚位于波罗的海半岛中部，人们在那里过着田园诗般的生活。

units.en: Prison is a place to cage the criminals, nevertheless here prison turns out to be a place that Soapy yearned to get in, because he could get his belly filled every day without starvation, and a shelter for sleeping, without suffering the chilliness of the winter.
units.zh: 监狱是关押罪犯的地方，但这里却是肥皂剧渴望进入的地方，因为他可以每天都把肚子填满，没有饥饿的地方，也可以睡觉的庇护所，而不会遭受冬天的寒冷。

units.en: Personification
units.zh: 拟人化

units.en: A dead leaf fell in Soapy's lap.
units.zh: 一片枯叶落在肥皂的腿上。

units.en: That was Jack Frost's card.
units.zh: 那是杰克弗罗斯特的卡片。

units.en: Jack is kind to the
units.zh: 杰克对

units.en: regular denizens of Madison Square, and gives fair warning of his annual call.
units.zh: 麦迪逊广场的普通居民，并对他的年度电话给出了公平的警告。

units.en: At the corners of four streets he hands his pasteboard to the North Wind, footman of the mansion of All Outdoors, so that the inhabitants thereof may make ready.
units.zh: 在四条街道的拐角处，他把他的纸板递给了北风，所有户外豪宅的男仆，这样居民就可以做好准备。

units.en: Two personifications are used here.
units.zh: 这里使用了两个拟人化。

units.en: The author links frost to a person, named "Jack
units.zh: 作者将弗罗斯特链接到一个名为“杰克”的人

units.en: Frost.

units.en: ERNEST HEMINGWAY
units.zh: 欧内斯特·海明威

units.en: Hemingway's style is fundamentally shaped in reaction to his experience of World War I. After World War I, he and other modernists lost faith in the central institutions of Western civilization by reacting against the elaborate style of 19th century writers and by creating a style in which meaning is established through dialogue, action and silence—a fiction in which nothing crucial—or at least very little—is stated explicitly.
units.zh: 海明威的风格是对他第一次世界大战的经历的反应，从根本上塑造了他的第一次世界大战后，他和其他现代主义者通过对抗19世纪作家的精心设计的风格，对西方文明的中心制度失去了信心，并通过创造一种通过对话、行动和建立意义的风格。 沉默——一种虚构的小说，其中没有任何重要的东西——或者至少很少——被明确地陈述。

units.en: Hemingway called his style the "iceberg theory": The facts float above the water; the supporting structure and symbolism operate out of sight.
units.zh: 海明威将他的风格称为“冰山理论”：事实漂浮在水面上； 支持结构和象征意义在看不见。

units.en: The concept of the "iceberg theory" is sometimes referred to as the "theory of omission."
units.zh: “冰山理论”的概念有时被称为“遗漏理论”。

units.en: Hemingway believed the writer could describe one thing through an entirely different thing that occurs below the surface.
units.zh: 海明威相信作者可以通过发生在表面之下的完全不同的事情来描述一件事。

units.en: His "iceberg theory of omission" is the foundation on which he builds his stories.
units.zh: 他的“冰山遗漏理论”是他建立故事的基础。

units.en: The syntax, which lacks subordinating conjunctions, creates static sentences.
units.zh: 缺少从属连词的语法会创建静态句子。

units.en: The photographic "snapshot" style creates a collage of images.
units.zh: 摄影“快照”风格创造了一系列图像的拼贴画。

units.en: Many types of internal punctuation (colons, semicolons, dashes, parentheses) are omitted in favor of short declarative sentences.
units.zh: 许多类型的内部标点符号（冒号、分号、破折号、括号）被省略，以支持简短的陈述性句子。

units.en: The sentences build on each other, as events build to create a sense of the whole.
units.zh: 这些句子相互建立，因为事件建立起来以创造整体的感觉。

units.en: Multiple strands exist in one story; an "embedded text" bridges to a different angle.
units.zh: 一个故事中存在多股； “嵌入式文本”连接到不同的角度。

units.en: He also used other cinematic techniques such as "cutting" quickly from one scene to the next, or "splicing" a scene into another.
units.zh: 他还使用了其他电影技术，例如从一个场景到下一个场景的“快速切割”，或者将一个场景“拼接”成另一个场景。

units.en: Intentional omissions allow the reader to fill the gap, as though responding to instructions from the author, and create threedimensional prose.
units.zh: 故意遗漏允许读者填补空白，就像响应作者的指示一样，创造三维散文。

units.en: Hemingway habitually used the word "and" in place of commas.
units.zh: 海明威习惯性地用“和”这个词代替逗号。

units.en: This use of polysyndeton may serve to convey immediacy.
units.zh: 多联合的这种使用可以用来传达即时性。

units.en: Hemingway's polysyndetic sentence-or in later works his use of subordinate clauses—uses conjunctions to juxtapose startling visions and images.
units.zh: 海明威的多合性句子——或在后来的作品中他对从属从句的使用——使用连词来并列令人吃惊的愿景和图像。

units.en: Wicked Pierced Wolf put on Granny's clothes and cap and got into the bed.
units.zh: 邪恶的穿孔狼穿上奶奶的衣服和帽子，上了床。

units.en: He had fun playing with Granny's remote control, zapping through the two hundred and twenty two channels on TV.
units.zh: 他玩得很开心和奶奶的遥控器一起玩，在电视上播放了 222 个频道。

units.en: Suddenly, he heard a knock at the door: tap, tap.
units.zh: 突然，他听到敲门声：轻敲，敲击。

units.en: "Who is it?" he asked imitating Granny's voice.
units.zh: “是谁？” 他问模仿奶奶的声音。

units.en: "It's me, Granny, Little Red Ringing Tone," she replied.
units.zh: “是我，奶奶，小红铃声，”她回答道。

units.en: "I brought you the groceries and flowers you asked for, and a delicious cake Mother made for you." "Oh! How lovely! Come in, my dear," said Wicked Pierced Wolf.
units.zh: “我给你带来了你要的杂货和鲜花，还有一位妈妈为你做的美味蛋糕。” “哦！多么可爱！进来吧，亲爱的，”邪恶的穿孔狼说。

units.en: When Little Red Ringing Tone saw her "granny" on the bed, she said: "Oh, Granny! What a strange voice you have!"
units.zh: 当小红铃声在床上看到她“奶奶”时，她说：“哦，奶奶！你的声音真奇怪！”

units.en: Unit 7 Ethnicity and Identity 175
units.zh: 第 7 单元 种族和身份 175

units.en: "Oh, I've got a bad cold."
units.zh: “哦，我得了重感冒。”

units.en: Cough, cough!!
units.zh: 咳咳咳！！

units.en: "But Granny! What big eyes you have!"
units.zh: “可是奶奶！你的眼睛很大！”

units.en: "Oh, to see you better, my darling!" he said.
units.zh: “哦，为了更好地见到你，我的宝贝！” 他说。

units.en: "But Granny! What big ears you have!"
units.zh: “可是奶奶！你有什么大耳朵！”

units.en: "Oh, to hear you better, sweetie," the wolf said.
units.zh: “哦，好听你的，亲爱的，”狼说。

units.en: Looking closer at the "granny" in bed, she said trembling: "B-, B-But Granny! Wh... What big teeth you have!"
units.zh: 仔细看了看床上的“奶奶”，她颤抖着说：“B-，B——但是奶奶！哇……你有多大的牙齿！”

units.en: At the moment, the local newspaper slipped under the door.
units.zh: 此刻，当地的报纸从门下滑了下来。

units.en: Little Red Ringing Tone picked it up and read the headline on the front page: MISSING GRANNY.
units.zh: 小红铃声捡起来，读到了头版的标题：失踪的奶奶。

units.en: It was her granny in the picture!
units.zh: 照片中是她的奶奶！

units.en: She also heard the news on TV and on the radio reporting her granny's missing!!!
units.zh: 她还在电视和电台上听到了她奶奶失踪的消息！！！

units.en: The girl was astonished, "What's happening here?" she thought.
units.zh: 女孩吃了一惊，“这里怎么了？” 她想。

units.en: "Where's my grandma?!? What have you done to her?" she cried Suddenly, Wicked Pierced Wolf fell upon the little girl, tied her up and hid her inside the wardrobe where her granny was.
units.zh: “我奶奶呢？！？你对她做了什么？” 她突然哭了，邪恶的穿孔狼摔倒在小女孩身上，把她绑起来，把她藏在她奶奶所在的衣橱里。

units.en: Wicked Pierced Wolf looked around the house and thought "Mmm...
units.zh: 邪恶的刺穿的狼环顾了房子，心想“嗯……

units.en: I'm going to take away all the things here for myself!
units.zh: 我要为自己拿走所有的东西！

units.en: can eat them later.
units.zh: 以后可以吃。

units.en: Fortunately, Good Woodcutter was still online and called the police.
units.zh: 幸运的是，优秀的樵夫还在网上报警。

units.en: The police caught Wicked Pierced Wolf and took him to prison.
units.zh: 警察抓住了邪恶的穿孔狼并将他送进了监狱。

units.en: In the end,
units.zh: 最后，

units.en: Good Woodcutter became a hero!
units.zh: 好樵夫成了英雄！

units.en: Little Red Ringing Tone and her granny lived happily ever after.
units.zh: 小红铃声和她的奶奶从此过上了幸福的生活。

units.zh: 这些摘自奥斯卡·王尔德的《认真重要性》的一些摘录，一部充满幽默和社会批评的搞笑剧。

units.en: The author's diction is one of the prime markers of his style.
units.zh: 作者的措辞是他风格的主要标志之一。

units.en: This is the situation: Jack Worthing is going to ask Lady Bracknell for her
units.zh: 这就是情况：杰克沃辛要为她向布拉克内尔夫人问她

units.en: daughter Gwendolen's hand in marriage.
units.zh: 女儿格温多伦的婚姻。

units.en: She's a very stiff lady whose main task in life is to find the perfect husband for her beloved daughter.
units.zh: 她是一位非常僵硬的女士，她一生的主要任务是为她心爱的女儿找到完美的丈夫。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: An engagement should come to a young girl as a surprise.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：订婚应该给一个年轻的女孩一个惊喜。

units.en: [...] It is hardly a matter that she could be allowed to arrange for herself...
units.zh: [...] 几乎可以让她为自己安排的事情...

units.zh: 现在我有几个问题要问你，沃辛先生。

units.zh: 在我做这些询问的时候，你，格温多伦，会在马车里等我。

units.en: JACK: Thank you, Lady Bracknell, I prefer standing.
units.zh: 杰克：谢谢你，布拉克内尔夫人，我更喜欢站着。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL (pencil and note-book in hand): I feel bound to tell you that you are not down on my list of eligible men, although I have the same list as the dear Duchess of Bolton has.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人（手中的铅笔和笔记本）：我有必要告诉你，你不在我的合格男性名单上，尽管我和博尔顿的亲爱的公爵夫人有同样的名单。

units.en: We work together, in fact.
units.zh: 事实上，我们一起工作。

units.en: However, I am quite ready to enter your name, should your answers be what a really affectionate mother requires.
units.zh: 但是，如果你的回答是一个真正深情的母亲所需要的，我已经准备好输入你的名字了。

units.en: Do you smoke?
units.zh: 你抽烟吗？

units.en: JACK: Well, yes, I must admit I smoke.
units.zh: 杰克：嗯，是的，我必须承认我吸烟。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: I am glad to hear it.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：我很高兴听到这个消息。

units.en: A man should always have an occupation of some kind.
units.zh: 一个人应该总是有某种职业。

units.en: There are far too many idle men in London as it is.
units.zh: 伦敦有太多闲散的人。

units.en: How old are you?
units.zh: 你多大年纪了?

units.en: JACK: Iwenty-nine.
units.zh: 杰克：我九。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: A very good age to be married at.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：结婚的好年龄。

units.en: I have always been of opinion that a man who desires to get married should know either everything or nothing.
units.zh: 我一直认为，一个渴望结婚的男人应该知道一切或一无所知。

units.en: Which do you know?
units.zh: 你知道哪个？

units.en: JACK (after some hesitation): I know nothing, Lady Bracknell.
units.zh: 杰克（犹豫了一下）：我什么都不知道，布拉克内尔夫人。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: I am pleased to hear it.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：我很高兴听到这个消息。

units.en: I do not approve of anything that tampers with natural ignorance.
units.zh: 我不赞成任何篡改自然无知的东西。

units.en: Ignorance is like a delicate exotic fruit; touch it and the bloom is gone.
units.zh: 无知就像一种微妙的异国情调的水果； 触摸它，花朵就消失了。

units.en: The whole theory of modern education is radically unsound.
units.zh: 现代教育的整个理论根本不合理。

units.en: Fortunately in England, at any rate, education produces no effect whatsoever.
units.zh: 幸运的是，在英国，教育不会产生任何影响。

units.en: If it did, it would prove a serious danger to the upper classes, and probably lead to acts of violence in Grosvenor Square.
units.zh: 如果是这样，它将证明对上层阶级构成严重危险，并可能导致格罗夫纳广场的暴力行为。

units.en: What is your income?
units.zh: 你的收入是多少？

units.en: JACK: Between seven and eight thousand a year.
units.zh: 杰克：每年七八千。

units.en: ...] LADY BRACKNELL: Now to minor matters.
units.zh: ...] 布拉克内尔夫人：现在是小事。

units.en: Are your parents living?
units.zh: 你的父母还活着吗？

units.en: JACK: I have lost both my parents.
units.zh: 杰克：我失去了父母。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: To lose one parent, Mr. Worthing, may be regarded as a misfortune; to lose both looks like carelessness.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：失去一位父母，沃辛先生，可能被视为不幸； 失去两个看起来像粗心。

units.en: Who was your father?
units.zh: 你父亲是谁？

units.en: ...) JACK: I'm afraid I really don't know.
units.zh: ...) 杰克：恐怕我真的不知道。

units.en: [..] I was... well, I was found... [...] The late Mr. Thomas Cardew, an old gentleman of a very charitable and kindly disposition, found me, and gave me the name of Worthing, because he happened to have a firstclass ticket for Worthing in his pocket at the time.
units.zh: [..] 我是……嗯，我被发现了…… [...] 已故的托马斯·卡杜先生，一位非常慈善和善良的性格的老绅士，找到了我，给了我沃辛的名字，因为当时他碰巧有一张一流的票，口袋里有价值。

units.en: Worthing is a place in Sussex.
units.zh: 沃辛是苏塞克斯的一个地方。

units.en: It is a seaside resort.
units.zh: 这是一个海滨度假胜地。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: Where did the charitable gentleman who had a first-class ticket for this seaside resort find you?
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：拥有这个海滨度假胜地一流门票的慈善绅士在哪里找到你的？

units.en: JACK: In a hand-bag [...] in the cloak-room at Victoria Station.
units.zh: 杰克：在维多利亚车站的衣帽间里的手提包 [...]。

units.en: It was given to him in mistake for his own.
units.zh: 它是给他的，因为他自己是错误的。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: The cloak-room at Victoria Station?
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：维多利亚车站的斗篷室？

units.en: JACK: Yes.
units.zh: 杰克：是的。

units.en: The Brighton line.
units.zh: 布莱顿线。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: The line is immaterial.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：这条线是无关紧要的。

units.en: Mr. Worthing, I confess I feel somewhat bewildered by what you have just told me.
units.zh: 沃辛先生，我承认我对你刚刚告诉我的事情感到有些困惑。

units.en: To be born, or at any rate bred, in a hand-bag, whether it had handles or not, seems to me to display a contempt for the ordinary decencies of family life that reminds one of the worst excesses of the French Revolution.
units.zh: 在我看来，无论是否有把手，出生或无论如何，都在手袋中诞生，似乎对家庭生活的普通礼貌感到蔑视，这提醒了法国大革命中最严重的过度行为。

units.en: [...] JACK: May I ask you then what you would advise me to do?
units.zh: [...] 杰克：那我可以问你，你会建议我做什么吗？

units.en: I need hardly say I
units.zh: 我几乎不需要说我

units.en: Unit 7 Ethnicity and Identity 177
units.zh: 第 7 单元 种族和身份 177

units.en: would do anything in the world to ensure Gwendolen's happiness.
units.zh: 会在世界上做任何事情来确保格温多伦的幸福。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: I would strongly advise you, Mr. Worthing, to try and acquire some relations as soon as possible, and to make a definite effort to produce at any rate one parent, of either sex, before the season is quite over.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：沃辛先生，我强烈建议您尽快尝试获得一些关系，并明确努力在季节结束之前以任何方式产生任何性别的父母，无论男女。

units.en: JACK: Well, I don't see how I could possibly manage to do that.
units.zh: 杰克：嗯，我不明白我怎么可能做到这一点。

units.en: I can produce the hand-bag at any moment.
units.zh: 我可以随时制作手提包。

units.en: It is in my dressing-room at home.
units.zh: 它在我家的更衣室里。

units.en: I really think that should satisfy you, Lady Bracknell.
units.zh: 我真的认为这应该让你满意，布拉克内尔夫人。

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL: Me, sir!
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人：我，先生！

units.en: What has it to do with me?
units.zh: 它和我有什么关系？

units.en: You can hardly imagine that I and Lord Bracknell would dream of allowing our only daughter—a girl brought up with the utmost care—to marry into a cloak-room, and form an alliance with a parcel.
units.zh: 你很难想象我和布拉克内尔勋爵会梦想让我们唯一的女儿——一个非常小心地长大的女孩——嫁进一个斗篷房间，并与一个包裹结成联盟。

units.en: Good-morning, Mr. Worthing!
units.zh: 早上好，沃辛先生！

units.en: LADY BRACKNELL sweeps out in majestic indignation.
units.zh: 布拉克内尔夫人以雄伟的愤慨席卷而来。

units.en: ASSIGNMENT 1
units.zh: 作业 1

units.en: Review Guy de Maupassant's "The Necklace" (Text B in Unit 1) and write a short story about what happened to Mathilde after she got the news that the necklace Madame Forestier lent her ten years ago was paste.
units.zh: 回顾 Guy de Maupassant 的“项链”（第 1 单元中的文字 B），并写一个关于 Mathilde 发生的事情的短篇小说，因为她得知 Forestier 夫人在十年前借给她的项链是粘贴的。

units.en: Pay attention to the style and tone in your writing.
units.zh: 注意写作中的风格和基调。

units.en: Step A: Read "The Necklace" again and pay special attention to Maupassant's simple and elegant writing style.
units.zh: 步骤A：再次阅读“项链”，特别注意莫泊桑简洁优雅的写作风格。

units.en: The author sets a tone of detachment but shows his empathetic understanding of his characters.
units.zh: 作者设定了一种超然的基调，但展示了他对角色的同情理解。

units.en: Step B: Imagine what happened to Mathilde after she learned the truth about the necklace and note down your ideas.
units.zh: 步骤 B：想象一下玛蒂尔德了解到项链的真相后发生了什么事并记下了你的想法。

units.en: Step C: Design your plot and provide a list of details related to the plot.
units.zh: 步骤 C：设计您的图并提供与情节相关的详细信息列表。

units.en: Step D: Organize your list of details into the beginning, middle and ending of the story and write an outline for your story.
units.zh: 步骤D：将你的细节列表整理到故事的开头、中间和结尾，并为你的故事写一个大纲。

units.en: Step E: Write a first draft of your story and then ask your partner for feedback.
units.zh: 步骤 E：写下你的故事的初稿，然后向你的伴侣寻求反馈。

units.en: Step F: When revising your draft, try to imitate the simple and elegant style of Maupassant.
units.zh: 步骤 F：修改草稿时，请尝试模仿 Maupassant 的简单优雅风格。

units.en: A writing style is a synthesis of everything a writer does.
units.zh: 写作风格是作家所做的一切的综合。

units.zh: 当您阅读

units.en: story, what can you figure out in particular about the author?
units.zh: 故事，你能特别了解作者的什么？

units.en: In other words, what kind of vocabulary does the author use in writing?
units.zh: 换句话说，作者在写作中使用了什么样的词汇？

units.en: Is it formal or informal?
units.zh: 是正式的还是非正式的？

units.zh: 你对写作印象深刻吗？

units.en: If so, what are you impressed with?

units.en: Read the following two texts about mother-daughter relationship and consider how each author describes her mother and their relationship.
units.zh: 阅读以下关于母女关系的两篇文章，并考虑每位作者如何描述她的母亲及其关系。

units.en: Text A
units.zh: 文本 A

units.en: Memory: My Mother
units.zh: 记忆：我的母亲

units.en: Amy Tan
units.zh: 艾米·谭

units.en: The most hateful words I have ever said to another human being were to my
units.zh: 我对另一个人说过的最可恨的话是对我的

units.en: mother.
units.zh: 妈妈。

units.en: I was sixteen at the time.
units.zh: 当时我十六岁。

units.en: They rose from the storm in my chest and | let
units.zh: 他们从我胸口的风暴中升起，| 让

units.en: them fall in a fury of hailstones: "I hate you. I wish I were dead."
units.zh: 他们在冰雹的愤怒中坠落：“我恨你。我希望我死了。”

units.en: I waited for her to collapse, stricken by my cruel words, but she was still standing upright, her chin raised, her lips stretched in a crazy smile.
units.zh: 我等她倒下，被我残忍的话打击，但她仍然直立，下巴抬起，嘴唇张开疯狂的笑容。

units.en: "OK, maybe I die," she said.
units.zh: “好吧，也许我死了，”她说。

units.en: "Then I no longer be your mother!"
units.zh: “那我不再是你妈妈了！”

units.en: We had many similar exchanges.
units.zh: 我们有很多类似的交易所。

units.en: Sometimes she actually tried to kill herself, by running into the street, holding a knife to her throat.
units.zh: 有时她真的想自杀，跑到街上，把刀放在喉咙里。

units.en: She, too, had storms in her chest.
units.zh: 她的胸口也有暴风雨。

units.en: And what she aimed at me was as fast and deadly as lightning bolts.
units.zh: 而她瞄准我的东西就像闪电一样快速而致命。

units.en: For days after our arguments, she would not speak to me.
units.zh: 在我们争论的几天后，她不会和我说话。

units.en: She tormented me,
units.zh: 她折磨我，

units.en: acted as if she had no feelings for me whatsoever.
units.zh: 表现得好像她对我没有任何感觉。

units.en: I was lost to her.
units.zh: 我被她迷路了。

units.en: As we have discussed in this unit, style is the literary element that describes the ways that the author uses language.

units.en: The author's word choice, sentence structure and paragraphs all work together to establish mood, image and meaning in the text.

units.en: Style describes how the author describes events, objects and ideas, consequently influencing how we interpret the facts that are presented in the text.

units.en: In the following we will discuss how word choice and sentence structure or paragraph arrangement can influence the style and tone of a piece of writing.
units.zh: 下面我们将讨论单词选择和句子结构或段落排列如何影响一篇文章的风格和基调。

units.en: • Word and style
units.zh: • 文字和风格

units.en: The language used by the author can convey subtle messages about attitudes, values and cultural assumptions.
units.zh: 作者使用的语言可以传达关于态度、价值观和文化假设的微妙信息。

units.en: Every choice of word or expression allows for tiny distinctions to be made.
units.zh: 单词或表达的每一种选择都允许进行微小的区分。

units.en: In Examples 1 and 2 on Page 168, for example, two extracts were compared.
units.zh: 例如，在第168页的实施例1和2中比较了两种提取物。

units.en: They use different expressions to describe a young person: child and kid.
units.zh: 他们用不同的表达方式来描述一个年轻人：孩子和孩子。

units.en: While each word describes a young person, the connotations carried by each differ.
units.zh: 虽然每个词都描述了一个年轻人，但每个词的内涵都不同。

units.en: Till the end of the 16th century, "kid" was a word that was only used to refer to the offspring of a goat.
units.zh: 直到 16 世纪末，“孩子”这个词只是用来指代山羊的后代。

units.en: It was only extended to the offspring of humans as slang in 1590.
units.zh: 1590年，它只是扩展到人类的后代。

units.en: Slowly and gradually, the word came to be accepted as an alternative to human offspring.
units.zh: 慢慢地，这个词开始被接受为人类后代的替代方案。

units.en: Therefore, the word "kid" sometimes can demonstrate affection.
units.zh: 因此，“孩子”这个词有时可以表现出感情。

units.en: Comparatively, "child" is a formal way to refer to a human being that is not an adult.
units.zh: 相比之下，“儿童”是指代非成年人的正式方式。

units.en: Words can be formal or informal, depending on the occasion and the audience.
units.zh: 词语可以是正式的或非正式的，取决于场合和观众。

units.en: For instance, if a father is talking to his eight-year-old son about forestry and said: "The foliage in the woodland was being desiccated," it would be inappropriate.
units.zh: 例如，如果一位父亲正在和他 8 岁的儿子谈论林业并说：“林地的叶子正在干燥”，那将是不合适的。

units.en: It should be much better if he said "The trees in the forest are drying up" Words also convey subtle messages about attitudes.
units.zh: 如果他说“森林里的树木正在干涸”的话也传达了关于态度的微妙信息，应该会好得多。

units.en: When describing someone, one can say "He is confident, proud, or egotistical."
units.zh: 在描述某人时，可以说“他自信、自豪或自负”。

units.en: The word "confident" sends a positive message about this person while the word "egotistical" indicates that this person is overconfident to the point of being self-centered.
units.zh: “自信”一词传达了关于这个人的积极信息，而“自负”一词表明这个人过于自信到以自我为中心。

units.en: It is important to use exact words in writing.
units.zh: 在写作中使用准确的单词很重要。

units.en: Precise words can
units.zh: 精确的词可以

units.en: • Sentence and style
units.zh: • 句子和风格

units.en: Besides words, writers also create different styles through sentence manipulation.
units.zh: 除了文字，作家还通过句子操作创造不同的风格。

units.en: A writer might use a lot of verbs, or use a lot of compound sentences, or use a lot of clauses in his or her writing.
units.zh: 一个作者可能会使用很多动词，或者使用很多复合句子，或者在他或她的写作中使用很多从句。

units.en: A writer might use a lot of absolute phrases or use none.
units.zh: 一个作家可能会使用很多绝对的短语或不使用。

units.en: He or she might use short sentences, long sentences, one-word paragraphs or fivepage paragraphs.
units.zh: 他或她可能会使用短句、长句、一字段落或五页段落。

units.en: Whatever choices he or she makes regarding word choice and how words are arranged in phrases, sentences and paragraphs affect the writer's style.
units.zh: 无论他或她对单词选择以及单词、句子和段落中的单词如何排列，都会影响作者的风格。

units.en: The following are some examples of different styles realized through the skillful use of sentence structure.
units.zh: 以下是通过巧妙地使用句子结构实现的不同风格的一些示例。

units.en: Example 2
units.zh: 示例 2

units.en: When I first saw New York I was twenty, and it was summertime, and I got off a DC-7 at the old Idlewild temporary terminal in a new dress which had seemed very smart in Sacramento but seemed less smart already, even in the old Idlewild temporary terminal, and the warm air smelled of mildew and some instinct, programmed by all the movies I had ever seen and all the songs! had ever heard about New York, informed me that things would never be quite the same again.
units.zh: 当我第一次见到纽约时，我是二十岁，那是夏天，我在旧的 Idlewild 临时码头下了 DC-7，穿着一件在萨克拉门托看起来很聪明但看起来已经不那么聪明的新衣服，即使在旧的 Idlewild 临时终端，温暖的空气也闻起来了 霉变和一些本能，由我看过的所有电影和所有歌曲进行编程！ 听说过纽约，告诉我事情再也不会完全一样了。

units.en: In this description of her first visit to New York City, Joan Didion uses a polysyndetic sentence style, employing a great number of coordinating conjunctions (especially "and" and "but"), to help convey her youthful enthusiasm and naiveté.
units.zh: 在这篇描述她第一次访问纽约市的描述中，琼·迪迪翁使用了多功能句式，采用了大量的协调连词（尤其是“和”和“但是”），以帮助传达她年轻的热情和天真。

units.en: We are self-reliant and at the same time completely dependent.
units.zh: 我们是自力更生的，同时完全依赖。

units.zh: 我们很有侵略性，也没有防御能力。

units.en: We are complacent in our possessions, in our houses, in our education; but it is hard to find a man or woman who does not want something better for the next generation.
units.zh: 我们在我们的财产、我们的房子里、在我们的教育中自满； 但是很难找到一个男人或女人不想要更好的下一代人。

units.en: Americans are remarkably kind and hospitable and open with both guests and strangers; and yet they will make a wide circle around the man dying on the pavement...
units.zh: 美国人非常善良和好客，对客人和陌生人都很开放； 然而，他们会围绕着死在人行道上的人绕了一圈……

units.en: coordinated rather than subordinated.

units.en: Example 5
units.zh: 示例 5

units.en: The pass was high and wide and he jumped for it, feeling it slap flatly against his hands, as he shook his hips to throw off the halfback who was diving at him.
units.zh: 传球又高又宽，他跳了起来，感觉它平直地拍打着他的手，他摇了摇臀部，甩掉了向他跳水的中卫。

units.en: The center floated by, his hands desperately brushing Darling's knee as Darling picked his feet up high and delicately ran over a blocker and an opposing linesman in a jumble on the ground near the scrimmage line.
units.zh: 中锋飘过，他的手拼命地抚摸着达林的膝盖，达林抬起脚，小心翼翼地跑过一个阻挡者和一个对方的边线员，在混乱线附近的地上乱七八糟。

units.en: He had ten yards in the clear and picked up speed, breathing easily, feeling his thigh pads rising and falling against his legs, listening to the sound of cleats behind him, pulling away from them, watching the other backs heading him off toward the sidelines, the whole picture, men closing in on him, the blockers fighting for position, the ground he had to cross, all suddenly clear in his head, for the first time in his life not a meaningless confusion of men, sounds, speed...
units.zh: 他有十码的清澈，加快了速度，轻松呼吸，感觉到他的大腿垫在他的腿上起伏，听着他身后的夹板声，从他们身后拉开，看着其他背部向他的旁边走去，整个画面，男人在进来 在他身上，为阵地而战的阻挡者，他不得不穿越的地面，全都在他的脑海中突然清澈，这是他生命中第一次没有对人、声音、速度的无意义混乱……

units.en: It was a house of many windows, low, wide, nearly floor to ceiling in the living room, which faced the meadow, and it was from one of these that I first saw our closest neighbor, a large white horse, cropping grass, flipping its mane, and ambling about—not over the entire meadow, which stretched well out of sight of the house, but over the five or so fenced-in acres that were next to the twenty-odd that we had rented.
units.zh: 那是一座有许多窗户的房子，在客厅里，几乎是低矮的，宽阔的，几乎是从地板到天花板的房子，面向草地，我第一次看到我们最近的邻居，一匹大白马，割草，翻过它的鬃毛，漫步——不是整个 草地，它在房子的视线之外，但在我们租用的 20 多片旁边的五英亩左右的围栏上。

units.en: I soon learned that the horse, whose name was Blue, belonged to a man who lived in another town, but was boarded by our neighbors next door.

units.en: They would appear in the meadow, climb up on his back, ride furiously for ten or fifteen minutes, then get off, slap Blue on the flanks, and not be seen again for a month or more.

units.en: • Paragraph and style
units.zh: • 段落和风格

units.en: Some writers also use paragraphs as a way to present their style.
units.zh: 一些作家还使用段落作为展示其风格的一种方式。

units.en: For instance,
units.zh: 例如，

units.en: Maupassants writing is very simple and economical.
units.zh: Maupassants 的写作非常简单和经济。

units.en: He does a lot with only a little bit of
units.zh: 他做了很多，只有一点点

units.en: 192 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 192 思辨写作 1

units.en: space.
units.zh: 空间。

units.en: His control of timing and pacing is incredible.
units.zh: 他对时间和节奏的控制令人难以置信。

units.en: How does Maupassant do it?
units.zh: Maupassant 是如何做到的？

units.en: One trick Maupassant uses is writing lots of really short paragraphs; this technique keeps the story moving at a fast pace.
units.zh: Maupassant 使用的一个技巧是写很多非常短的段落。 这种技术使故事以快速的速度发展。

units.en: The paragraphs are often little more than a single, simple sentence (the sentences are usually short, too.
units.zh: 这些段落通常只不过是一个简单的句子（句子通常也很短）。

units.en: The following passage (from "The Necklace") describes the day after the Loisels discovered they had lost the necklace:
units.zh: 以下段落（来自“项链”）描述了 Loisels 发现他们丢失了项链的第二天：

units.en: Her husband returned about seven oclock.
units.zh: 她的丈夫大约七点钟回来了。

units.en: He had found nothing.
units.zh: 他一无所获。

units.en: He went to police headquarters, to the newspaper offices to offer a reward; he went to the cab companies-everywhere, in fact, whither he was urged by the least spark of hope.
units.zh: 他去了警察总部，去报社提供奖励； 事实上，他去了出租车公司——事实上，他的希望是最少的火花。

units.en: She waited all day, in the same condition of mad fear before this terrible calamity.
units.zh: 她等了一整天，在这场可怕的灾难面前处于疯狂的恐惧状态。

units.en: Loisel returned at night with a hollow, pale face.
units.zh: 洛伊塞尔在晚上带着一副空洞的、苍白的脸回来了。

units.en: He had discovered nothing
units.zh: 他什么也没发现

units.en: This excerpt describes an entire day, with two characters and lots of scene changes, encapsulated in just a few lines of text.
units.zh: 这段摘录描述了一整天，有两个角色和大量的场景变化，只封装在几行文字中。

units.en: Note that there is barely any description in this passage, a fact highlighted by the distinct lack of adjectives, adverbs and descriptive language.
units.zh: 请注意，这段经文中几乎没有任何描述，这一事实强调了形容词、副词和描述性语言的明显缺乏。

units.en: It just says what it needs to.
units.zh: 它只是说它需要什么。

units.en: And it reads like a charm.
units.zh: 它读起来像一个魅力。

units.en: Maupassant knows exactly what he needs to put in a passage to make it work, and uses no more.
units.zh: Maupassant 确切地知道他需要在段落中输入什么才能使其发挥作用，并且不再使用。

units.en: When he does write longer paragraphs, Maupassant uses another notable
units.zh: 当他写更长的段落时，莫泊桑使用了另一个值得注意的地方

units.en: technique: He strings together sentences that begin with the same word and have the same basic structure.
units.zh: 技术：他将以相同单词开头且具有相同基本结构的句子串在一起。

units.en: For instance:
units.zh: 例如：

units.en: She came to know what heavy housework meant and the odious cares of the kitchen.
units.zh: 她开始知道沉重的家务是什么意思以及厨房的可恶关怀。

units.en: She washed the dishes, using her dainty fingers and rosy nails on greasy pots and pans She washed the soiled linen, the shirts and the dishcloths, which she dried upon a line; she carried the slops down to the street every morning and carried up the water, stopping for breath at every landing.
units.zh: 她用她精致的手指和玫瑰色的指甲在油腻的花盆和平底锅上洗了盘子，她把脏兮兮的亚麻布、衬衫和抹布洗干净了，她排干了； 她每天早上都把斜坡抬到街上，抬起水，每次着陆都停下来喘口气。

units.en: And dressed like a woman of the people, she went to the fruiterer, the grocer, the butcher, a basket on her arm, bargaining, meeting with impertinence, defending her miserable money, sou by sou
units.zh: 她穿得像一个女人中的女人，她去了水果店、杂货商、屠夫、手臂上的篮子、讨价还价、无礼、无礼、捍卫她可怜的钱，苏

units.en: If you think about it, starting every sentence with the sentence structure in bold
units.zh: 如果你想一想，用粗体的句子结构开始每个句子

units.en: seems almost like an elementary and basic writing technique.
units.zh: 似乎几乎是一种基本的和基本的写作技巧。

units.en: Yet Maupassant makes it work.
units.zh: 然而，莫泊桑使它发挥作用。

units.en: When he mixes things up ever so slightly in that last sentence, by starting with the "And dressed..." phrase before returning to "she went," it's just enough to keep things interesting, and bring a sense of closure to the paragraph.
units.zh: 当他在最后一句话中稍微混合一些东西时，从“和穿着......”短语开始，然后回到“她去了”，这足以让事情变得有趣，并给段落带来一种结束的感觉。

units.en: All the repetition feels ordered and neat.
units.zh: 所有的重复都感觉有序和整洁。

units.en: In Maupassant's hands, simplicity becomes elegance.
units.zh: 在莫泊桑的手中，简单变得优雅。

units.en: This unit will analyze this powerful descriptive device-imagery and the relevant figures of speech, which help build powerful images.

units.en: The selections in this unit are taken from poems as well as a variety of sources such as songs or stories that are notable for their artistic handling of concrete language and their ability to reach readers on various levels of sensual perception.
units.zh: 本单元中的选集来自诗歌以及各种来源，例如歌曲或故事，这些资源以其对具体语言的艺术处理以及它们接触到不同层面感知的读者的能力而著称。

units.en: On a starry winter night in Portugal Where the ocean kissed the southern shore There a dream I never thought would come to pass Came and went like time spent through an hourglass

units.en: Did you notice how descriptive it is?

units.zh: “海洋亲吻南岸”的线路可以很容易地与沙滩联系起来。

units.en: Furthermore, you can see the similarity in the images created by Brueghel's
units.zh: 此外，您可以看到Brueghel的图像中的相似性

units.en: painting and Williams' when Icarus dropped into the water.
units.zh: 当伊卡鲁斯掉入水中时，绘画和威廉姆斯。

units.en: His feet were struggling above the water, but his efforts were in vain.
units.zh: 他的脚在水面上挣扎，但他的努力是徒劳的。

units.en: It was the most tragic moment for the father, who witnessed his son dying but could do nothing to save him.
units.zh: 对于父亲来说，这是最悲惨的时刻，他目睹了他的儿子死亡，但无能为力，无法拯救他。

units.en: What is most shocking is how peaceful and uninterested the world was.
units.zh: 最令人震惊的是这个世界是多么的和平和无趣。

units.en: The farmer was busy ploughing; the ship went on sailing; the warm sun and the tranquil sea did not notice the death of a young man.
units.zh: 农夫忙着耕作； 船继续航行； 温暖的阳光和宁静的大海并没有注意到一个年轻人的死亡。

units.en: Only his father in the air, stunned and helpless, was aware of the tragedy.
units.zh: 只有他的父亲在空中，目瞪口呆，无助，意识到这场悲剧。

units.en: This is the way of the world the painter wants to indicate: No matter how much sorrow you have, do not expect others to share it.
units.zh: 这就是画家想要指出的世界方式：无论你有多少悲伤，都不要指望别人分享它。

units.en: You should swallow the pain and be tough.
units.zh: 你应该吞下疼痛并变得坚强。

units.en: The world keeps going on regardless of whatever you are suffering.
units.zh: 不管你遭受什么，世界都会继续前进。

units.en: poem.
units.zh: 诗。

units.en: This painting presents the very moment of the tragedy,
units.zh: 这幅画呈现了悲剧的时刻，

units.en: Responding to the painting, William Carlos Williams, a representative of American imagists in the 20th century, wrote a poem with the same title as the painting.
units.zh: 作为对这幅画的回应，威廉·卡洛斯·威廉姆斯（William Carlos Williams）是 20 世纪美国意象派的代表，他写了一首与这幅画同名的诗。

units.en: The death of Icarus, the poet tells us "According to Brueghel," took place in spring when the year was emerging in all its pageantry.
units.zh: 诗人告诉我们，伊卡洛斯的死是在春天发生的，当时春天的盛大盛宴。

units.en: The poem has no set rhyme scheme or meter, an example of Williams' many free verse poems.
units.zh: 这首诗没有固定的押韵方案或节奏，这是威廉姆斯许多自由诗诗的例子。

units.en: It shares with the painting the same theme, i.e., a feeling of insignificance: The tragic event of Icarus'
units.zh: 它与这幅画有着相同的主题，即一种微不足道的感觉：伊卡洛斯的悲剧事件

units.en: Unit 8 Love and Eternity 201
units.zh: 第 8 单元 爱与永恒 201

units.en: death was "quite unnoticed."
units.zh: 死亡是“完全没有注意到的”。

units.en: The irony of the death of Icarus, who has always been an emblem for the poet's upward flight that ends in tragedy, is that his death went unnoticed in the spring—"a mere splash in the sea."
units.zh: 伊卡鲁斯之死的讽刺意味，他一直是诗人以悲剧告终的标志，是他的死在春天被忽视了——“只是海上的飞溅”。

units.en: One factor contributing to this feeling is the stanza organization.
units.zh: 促成这种感觉的因素之一是节组织。

units.en: Each stanza is
units.zh: 每个节都是

units.en: very short, usually containing a sentence or less, and includes many enjambments: "a farmer was ploughing/his field/the whole pageantry" and "of the year was/ awake tingling/near."
units.zh: 很短，通常包含一个或更少的句子，并且包括许多围栏：“一个农民正在耕种/他的田地/整个盛会”和“年度是/醒着的刺痛/近乎”。

units.en: The considerably short length of each stanza creates a feeling of unimportance.
units.zh: 每个节的长度相当短，会产生一种不重要的感觉。

units.en: With no attempt at describing the scene in any depth, Williams just gives the reader a superficial view of the scene.
units.zh: 威廉姆斯没有尝试深入描述场景，只是让读者对场景有一个肤浅的看法。

units.en: There are also some stanzas that explicitly state the insignificance of Icarus' fall, "the edge of the sea/concerned/with itself," "unsignificantly/off the coast/there was" and "a splash quite unnoticed/this was/Icarus drowning" The first of these stanzas relates back to the painting, where one can see Icarus drowning at the edge of the sea.
units.zh: 还有一些节明确说明伊卡鲁斯堕落的微不足道，“海洋的边缘/关心/与自己”，“不明显/离海岸/有”和“一片飞溅/这是/这是/伊卡鲁斯 溺水”这些节中的第一节与这幅画有关，人们可以看到伊卡鲁斯淹死在海边。

units.en: As the stanza reads, "the edge of the sea/concerned/with itself," the idea that not even the ocean cares about Icarus drowning fills the reader's mind.
units.zh: 正如这节所写的，“大海的边缘/关心/与自己”，即使是海洋也不会关心伊卡鲁斯溺水的想法充满了读者的脑海。

units.en: In the painting, the part that has Icarus drowning is extremely small and tucked away in the corner, away from the eyes of the viewer.
units.zh: 在这幅画中，伊卡洛斯溺水的部分非常小，隐藏在角落里，远离观众的眼睛。

units.en: Williams accentuates this unimportance by "unsignificantly/off the coast/there was" and "a splash quite unnoticed/this was/Icarus drowning."
units.zh: 威廉姆斯通过“无关紧要/在海岸/附近/有”和“非常忽视/这是/伊卡鲁斯溺水”来强调这种不重要。

units.en: • Types of imagery
units.zh: • 图像类型

units.en: Although most of the image-making words in any language appeal to sight
units.zh: 尽管任何语言中的大多数图像制作词都吸引了视线

units.en: (visual), there are also images of sound (auditory), touch (tactile), taste (gustatory), smell (olfactory) and movement (kinesthetic).
units.zh: （视觉），还有声音（听觉）、触觉（触觉）、味觉（味觉）、气味（嗅觉）和运动（动觉）的图像。

units.en: 1. Visual imagery
units.zh: 1. 视觉图像

units.en: Since, for most of us, sight is the primary sense we use to perceive the world, it
units.zh: 因为，对于我们大多数人来说，视觉是我们用来感知世界的主要感觉，它

units.en: follows naturally that most writers use a lot of visual imagery.
units.zh: 自然地，大多数作家使用大量的视觉图像。

units.en: Visual imagery describes how an object looks, and enables the reader to visualize the objects or actions.
units.zh: 视觉图像描述了一个对象的外观，并使读者能够可视化对象或动作。

units.en: Look at Example 2 and appreciate the strong visual images:
units.zh: 查看示例 2 并欣赏强大的视觉图像：

units.en: Example 2
units.zh: 示例 2

units.en: In our kitchen, he would bolt his orange juice (squeezed on one of those ribbed glass sombreros and then poured off through a strainer) and grab a bite of toast (the toaster a simple tin box, a kind of little hut with slit and slanted sides, that rested over a gas burner and browned one side of the bread, in stripes, at a time), and then he would dash, so hurriedly that his necktie flew back over his shoulder, down through our yard, past the grapevines hung with buzzing Japanese-beetle traps, to the yellow brick building, with its tall smokestack and wide playing fields, where he taught.
units.zh: 在我们的厨房里，他会用螺栓固定橙汁（挤在其中一个罗纹玻璃草帽上，然后通过过滤器倒下），然后抓起一口吐司（烤面包机一个简单的锡盒，一种有狭缝和倾斜侧面的小屋， 把它放在一个燃气燃烧器上，把面包的一侧变成褐色，一次是条纹，然后他会急忙冲刺，以至于他的领带飞回他的肩膀上，穿过我们的院子，经过挂着嗡嗡作响的日本甲虫的葡萄藤 陷阱，到黄砖建筑，那里有高大的烟囱和广阔的运动场，他在那里教书。

units.en: -"My Father on the Verge of Disgrace" by John Updike
units.zh: - 约翰·厄普代克的《我的父亲处于耻辱的边缘》

units.en: In this paragraph, the narrator recalls the early-morning rituals of his schoolteacher father.
units.zh: 在本段中，叙述者回忆起他的教师父亲的清晨仪式。

units.en: You could see that everything and every action is described in
units.zh: 你可以看到一切和每一个动作都被描述在

units.en: 202 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 202 思辨写作 1

units.en: detail to create a fine picture for the reader to perceive.
units.zh: 细节 为读者创造一幅精美的图片。

units.en: The verbs like "bolt," "grab," "dash, "flew" vividly show that the father is in a hurry to go to work.
units.zh: 像“bolt”、“grab”、“dash”、“flew”这样的动词生动地表明父亲急于去上班。

units.en: The following is a poem by William Carlos Williams that uses a solitary visual
units.zh: 以下是威廉·卡洛斯·威廉姆斯（William Carlos Williams）的一首诗，它使用了单独的视觉

units.en: image as its primary strategy:
units.zh: 图像作为其主要策略：

units.en: Example 3
units.zh: 示例 3

units.en: The Red Wheelbarrow
units.zh: 红色独轮车

units.en: So much depends upon a red wheel barrow
units.zh: 很大程度上取决于红色手推车

units.en: glazed with rain water
units.zh: 用雨水上釉

units.en: beside the white chickens
units.zh: 在白鸡旁边

units.en: In this poem, Williams paints a word-portrait of the wheelbarrow for the reader.
units.zh: 在这首诗中，威廉姆斯为读者画了一幅独轮车的文字肖像。

units.en: It opens with "So much depends/upon" and the portrait becomes vivid by using contrasting images of the "red wheel" and "white/chickens."
units.zh: 它以“如此多的依赖/上”开头，通过使用“红轮”和“白/鸡”的对比图像，肖像变得生动。

units.en: Can you imagine what the rest of the scene looks like?
units.zh: 你能想象场景的其余部分是什么样子吗？

units.en: Could you draw a picture of it?
units.zh: 你能画一张它的照片吗？

units.en: 2. Auditory imagery
units.zh: 2. 听觉图像

units.en: Auditory imagery tries to capture a sound on paper, usually using a comparison to do so.
units.zh: 听觉图像试图在纸上捕捉声音，通常使用比较来做到这一点。

units.en: Read Example 4 for the vivid presentation of auditory images:
units.zh: 阅读示例 4 以生动地呈现听觉图像：

units.en: Example 4
units.zh: 示例 4

units.en: At the next table a woman stuck her nose in a novel; a college kid pecked at a laptop.
units.zh: 在隔壁的桌子上，一个女人在小说中卡住了鼻子； 一个大学生在笔记本电脑上啄食。

units.en: Overlaying all this, a soundtrack: choo-k-choo-k-choo-k-choo-k-choo-k-the metronomic rhythm of an Amtrak train rolling down the line to California, a sound that called to mind an old camera reel moving frames of images along a linear track, telling a story.
units.zh: 叠加了所有这些，配乐：Choo-K-Choo-K-Choo-K-Choo-K-Choo-K-Amtrak 列车的节拍节奏，沿着线路滚到加利福尼亚，这种声音让人想起一个旧的相机卷轴移动帧 沿着线性轨道的图像，讲述一个故事。

units.en: -"Riding the Rails" by Andy Isaacson
units.zh: - 安迪·艾萨克森（Andy Isaacson）的《骑轨》

units.en: This is a clear description of the sound of a train's coming by employing
units.zh: 这是对火车来电声音的清晰描述，通过使用

units.en: onomatopoeia with the expression "choo-k."
units.zh: 拟声词“choo-k”。

units.en: Onomatopoeia is a commonly used figure of speech to imitate a sound with words.
units.zh: Onomatopoeia 是一种常用的词性，用于模仿单词的声音。

units.en: The following poem by William Butler Yeats uses at least one auditory image or description in each of the stanzas, and ends the poem with a culmination of all of these sounds, which he imagines he "hears" in his heart.
units.zh: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝的以下诗歌在每节中至少使用了一种听觉图像或描述，并以所有这些声音的高潮结束了这首诗，他想象他在心中“听到”了这些声音。

units.en: Example 5
units.zh: 示例 5

units.en: The Lake Isle of Innisfree
units.zh: 因尼斯弗里湖岛

units.en: I will arise and go now, and go to Innisfree,
units.zh: 我现在就起来，去Innisfree，

units.en: 1 Innisfree: a beautiful island in Ireland, symbolizing the life that Yeats longed for.
units.zh: 1 Innisfree：爱尔兰美丽的岛屿，象征着叶芝渴望的生活。

units.en: Unit 8 Love and Eternity 203
units.zh: 第 8 单元 爱与永恒 203

units.en: And a small cabin build there, of clay and wattles made: Nine bean-rows will I have there, a hive for the honey-bee, And live alone in the bee-loud glade.
units.zh: 在那里建造了一个小屋，由粘土和瓦特尔制成：我将在那里拥有九个豆排，一个蜂巢，蜜蜂的蜂巢，独自生活在蜜蜂的林间空地中。

units.en: And I shall have some peace there, for peace comes dropping slow, Dropping from the veils of the morning to where the cricket sings; There midnight's all a glimmer, and noon a purple glow, And evening full of the linnet's wings.
units.zh: 我在那里会有一些平安，因为和平会慢慢下降，从早晨的面纱掉落到蟋蟀歌唱的地方； 午夜有一丝微光，中午一道紫色的光芒，夜晚充满了亚麻网的翅膀。

units.en: I will arise and go now, for always night and day I hear lake water lapping with low sounds by the shore; While I stand on the roadway, or on the pavements grey, I hear it in the deep heart's core.
units.zh: 我现在就起去，因为我总是昼夜不停地听到湖水在岸边发出低沉的声音； 当我站在道路上或人行道上时，我听到了它深处的内心。

units.en: In this poem, Yeats regards the island of Innisfree as a utopia that would supply all his needs.
units.zh: 在这首诗中，叶芝将因尼斯弗里岛视为满足他所有需求的乌托邦。

units.en: The poet declares that he will arise and go to Innisfree, where he will build a small cabin "of clay and wattles made."
units.zh: 诗人宣称他将站起来去因尼斯弗里，在那里他将建造一个“粘土和荆条”的小木屋。

units.en: On this small island, he can return to nature by growing beans and having bee hives, by enjoying the "purple glow" of noon, the sounds of birds' wings, and, of course, the bees.
units.zh: 在这个小岛上，他可以通过种植豆子和蜂箱，享受中午的“紫色光芒”，鸟类的翅膀的声音，当然还有蜜蜂的声音来回归自然。

units.en: He can even build a cabin and stay on the island much as Henry David Thoreau, the American Transcendentalist, lived on Walden Pond.
units.zh: 他甚至可以在岛上建造一间小屋并留在岛上，就像美国超验主义者亨利·大卫·梭罗住在瓦尔登池塘一样。

units.en: The simple imagery of the quiet life the poet longs to lead, as he enumerates each of its qualities, lulls the reader into his idyllic fantasy, until the penultimate line jolts the poet-and the reader-back into the reality of his drab urban existence: "While I stand on the roadway, or on the pavements grey."
units.zh: 诗人渴望过的安静生活的简单意象，因为他列举了每一个品质，让读者沉浸在他田园诗般的幻想中，直到倒数第二句将诗人和读者回到他单调的城市存在的现实中： 道路，或人行道上的灰色。”

units.en: 3. Tactile imagery
units.zh: 3. 触觉图像

units.en: Tactile imagery appeals to the sense of touch by presenting attributes like
units.zh: 触觉图像通过呈现类似的属性来吸引触觉

units.en: hardness and softness, or hot and cold sensations.
units.zh: 硬度和柔软度，或冷热的感觉。

units.en: Look at the following paragraph:
units.zh: 看以下段落：

units.en: Example 6
units.zh: 示例 6

units.en: When the others went swimming my son said he was going in, too.
units.zh: 当其他人去游泳时，我儿子说他也要进去。

units.en: He pulled his dripping trunks from the line where they had hung all through the shower and wrung them out.
units.zh: 他把滴水的行李箱从它们悬挂在淋浴间的绳子上拉了出来，把它们拧干了。

units.en: Languidly, and with no thought of going in, I watched him, his hard little body, skinny and bare, saw him wince slightly as he pulled up around his vitals the small, soggy, icy garment.
units.zh: 懒洋洋地，没有想进去，我看着他，他坚硬的小身体，瘦削和光秃秃的，看到他微微畏缩，因为他把这件小而湿漉漉的冰冷的衣服拉到他的生命体征周围。

units.en: As he buckled the swollen belt, suddenly my groin felt the chill of death.
units.zh: 当他扣住肿胀的腰带时，我的腹股沟突然感到死亡的寒意。

units.en: —"Once More to the Lake" by E. B. White
units.zh: ——“再一次到湖边”，作者：E. B. White

units.en: The words like "dripping," "icy" and "soggy" help to create images of the dampness of clothes, which conveys a sense of the chilly sensation that we get from wet clothes.
units.zh: 像“滴水”、“冰冷”和“湿透”的词有助于营造出潮湿的衣服的图像，这让我们从湿衣服中感受到寒冷的感觉。

units.en: 4. Kinesthetic imagery
units.zh: 4. 动觉图像

units.en: Kinesthetic imagery is a broader term used to describe the sense of movement or
units.zh: 动觉图像是一个更广泛的术语，用于描述运动感或

units.zh: 204 思辨写作 1

units.en: tension.
units.zh: 紧张。

units.en: Look at the following paragraph:
units.zh: 看以下段落：

units.en: Example 7
units.zh: 示例 7

units.en: With a wild rattle and clatter, and an inhuman abandonment of consideration not easy to be understood in these days, the carriage dashed through streets and swept round corners, with women screaming before it, and men clutching each other and clutching children out of its way.
units.zh: 带着狂野的嘎嘎声和咔哒声，以及不人道的考虑，不容易被理解，马车冲过街道和拐角处，女人在它面前尖叫，男人互相抓紧，抓着孩子。

units.en: At last, swooping at a street corner by a fountain, one of its wheels came to a sickening little jolt, and there was a loud city from a number of voices, and the horses reared and plunged.
units.zh: 最后，在喷泉的街角俯冲，它的一个轮子出现了令人作呕的小震动，有一个响亮的城市发出了许多声音，马匹饲养和坠落。

units.en: —A Tale of Two Cities by Charles Dickens
units.zh: ——查尔斯·狄更斯的《两个城市的故事》

units.en: Dickens uses very strong verbs in this paragraph to describe the image of the very violent movement of the carriage such as "dashed," "swept" and "swoop."
units.zh: 狄更斯在本段中使用非常强的动词来描述马车非常暴力运动的图像，例如“虚线”、“扫掠”和“俯冲”。

units.en: There are also expressions like "rattle and clatter," "screaming before it" and "clutching children out of its way" to help to contribute to the tension.
units.zh: 还有诸如“嘎嘎声和咔哒声”、“在它面前尖叫”和“让孩子们躲开它的路”等表达方式，以帮助加剧紧张局势。

units.en: • Using imagery in your writing
units.zh: • 在写作中使用图像

units.en: Imagery, in a literary text, is a writer's use of vivid and descriptive language to add depth to his or her work.
units.zh: 在文学文本中，图像是作者使用生动和描述性的语言来增加他或她的作品的深度。

units.en: Good descriptions are generally rich in imagery.
units.zh: 好的描述通常是丰富的图像。

units.en: The reader can imagine actually seeing or hearing or touching the things described.
units.zh: 读者可以想象实际看到或听到或触摸所描述的事物。

units.en: Imagery intensifies the impact of the writer's words as he or she shows us with his or her words rather than just telling us.
units.zh: 意象加剧了作者的话语的影响，因为他或她用他或她的话向我们展示了他或她的话，而不仅仅是告诉我们。

units.en: It appeals to human senses to deepen their understanding of the work.
units.zh: 它吸引了人类的感官加深他们对作品的理解。

units.en: Good writers do not use imagery merely for decoration.
units.zh: 优秀的作家不仅仅使用图像来装饰。

units.en: They do not ask themselves,
units.zh: 他们不问自己，

units.en: "How can I dress up my subject so that it will seem fancier than it is?"
units.zh: “我怎样才能装扮我的主题，让它看起来比现在更漂亮？”

units.en: Rather, they ask themselves, "How can I make my subject appear to the reader exactly as it appears to me?"
units.zh: 相反，他们问自己，“我怎样才能让我的主题在读者面前看起来完全一样？”

units.en: Imagery helps them solve their problem, as it enables them to present their subject as it is, that is, as it looks, smells, tastes, feels and sounds.
units.zh: 图像可以帮助他们解决问题，因为它使他们能够呈现出他们的主题，也就是说，它看起来、气味、味道、感觉和声音。

units.en: Imagery is equally important to the reader: It provides their imagination with something palpable to seize upon and helps them understand the work by activating their senses.
units.zh: 意象对读者同样重要：它为他们的想象力提供了一些可以抓住的东西，并通过激活他们的感官来帮助他们理解作品。

units.zh: 1. 图像通过显示

units.zh: 现在仔细阅读表 1 并比较图像创建中的讲述和显示之间的差异。

units.zh: 我看到很多水仙花连续作为闪耀的星星。

units.en: And twinkle on the milky way, They stretched in never-ending line Along the margin of a bay: Ten thousand saw I at a glance, Tossing their heads in sprightly dance.
units.zh: 在银河上闪烁，他们沿着海湾的边缘延伸成永无止境的线：一万人一目了然地看到了我，他们的头在闪闪发光的舞蹈中摇摇晃晃。

units.en: At once a voice arose among The bleak twigs overhead In a full-hearted evensong Of joy illimited; An aged thrush, frail, gaunt, and small, In blast-beruffled plume, Had chosen thus to fling his soul Upon the growing gloom.
units.zh: 突然间，在空旷的树枝中传来一个声音，一首全心全意的欢乐晚宴歌曲无限地响起。 一只年迈的画眉、脆弱、憔悴和小而破烂的羽毛，选择将他的灵魂投向日益增长的阴霾。

units.en: Theard a thrush singing.
units.zh: theard a 画眉唱歌。

units.zh: -托马斯哈代

units.en: As the examples in Table 1 show, an image is a picture created for the reader.
units.zh: 如表 1 中的示例所示，图像是为读者创建的图片。

units.en: The picture is not always visual, but it should be sensory, meaning that one or more of the five senses are used to create images that should, in turn, invoke a sensual response in the reader.
units.zh: 图片并不总是视觉的，但它应该是感官的，这意味着五种感官中的一种或多种用于创建图像，这些图像应该反过来会在读者中引起感官反应。

units.zh: 这些图像可以达到什么效果？

units.en: I Will Take an Egg out of the Robin's Nest
units.zh: 我会从知更鸟的巢穴中取出一个鸡蛋

units.en: I will take an egg out of the robin's nest in the orchard, I will take a branch of gooseberries from the old bush in the garden, and go and preach to the world; You shall see I will not meet a single heretic or scorner, You shall see how I stump clergymen, and confound them, You shall see me showing a scarlet tomato, and a white pebble from the beach.
units.zh: 我会从果园里的罗宾巢中取出一个鸡蛋，从花园里的老灌木中取出一根醋栗，去世界传道； 你会看到我不会遇到一个异端或蔑视者，你会看到我是如何难倒他们的，并将他们弄糊涂了，你会看到我展示一个猩红色的番茄和一个白色的鹅卵石。

units.en: 206 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 206 思辨写作 1

units.en: ACTIVITY 2
units.zh: 活动 2

units.en: Say this word to yourself: fruit.
units.zh: 对自己说这个词：水果。

units.en: What did you imagine?
units.zh: 你想象的是什么？

units.en: Some of you probably imagined bananas, while others imagined apples.
units.zh: 你们中的一些人可能想象着香蕉，而另一些人则想象着苹果。

units.en: The word "fruit" is imprecise.
units.zh: “水果”这个词是不精确的。

units.en: However, you can see, touch, taste, smell and hear (the peeling of) a certain fruit.
units.zh: 但是，您可以看到、触摸、品尝、闻到和听到（剥落）某种水果。

units.en: That is how you want to create your images.
units.zh: 这就是您想要创建图像的方式。

units.en: Describe this piece of fruit and be precise.
units.zh: 描述这块水果并准确地说。

units.en: 2. Ideas and emotions through imagery
units.zh: 2.通过图像的想法和情感

units.en: William Carlos Williams said that there are "no ideas but in things" For a good
units.zh: 威廉·卡洛斯·威廉姆斯（William Carlos Williams）说，“没有想法，只有事物”

units.en: writer creating good images, a thing can equal an idea.
units.zh: 作家创造好的图像，一个事物可以等于一个想法。

units.en: Ideas may not be easily perceived and sometimes even cannot be defined: love, hope, anger, pain, sorrow, and so on.
units.zh: 想法可能不容易被感知，有时甚至无法定义：爱、希望、愤怒、痛苦、悲伤等等。

units.en: Nothing is specifically about these words-their meanings are ambiguous and leave a lot to interpret.
units.zh: 没有什么特别的关于这些词——它们的含义是模棱两可的，还有很多事情要解释。

units.en: Long strings of abstractions are tiresome, and do not serve your writing well.
units.zh: 一长串的抽象令人厌烦，并且不能很好地为您的写作服务。

units.en: The reader will place their associations onto the abstraction and your intention may be lost.
units.zh: 读者将他们的关联放在抽象上，你的意图可能会消失。

units.en: Writing is about precision, and abstractions are anything but precise.
units.zh: 写作是关于精确的，抽象绝不是精确的。

units.en: Therefore, if you are writing about some idea or concept, you need to show it through images.
units.zh: 因此，如果您正在写一些想法或概念，则需要通过图像来展示它。

units.en: Imagery explains abstractions in more perceptible and tangible forms.
units.zh: 图像以更可察觉和有形的形式解释抽象。

units.en: This is a device by which the writer makes his or her meaning strong, clear and certain.
units.zh: 这是作者使他或她的意义变得强大、清晰和确定的装置。

units.en: The more abstract your concept for the writing, the more precise your imagery should be.
units.zh: 你的写作概念越抽象，你的图像就越精确。

units.en: Even if your writing relies heavily on ideas, you are obliged to help your reader understand your writing.
units.zh: 即使你的写作在很大程度上依赖于想法，你也有义务帮助你的读者理解你的写作。

units.en: You are not the maker of puzzles.
units.zh: 你不是拼图的制造者。

units.en: If your reader is baffled, you have not done your job as a writer.
units.zh: 如果您的读者感到困惑，您还没有完成您作为作家的工作。

units.en: One precise image is worth pages of ideas.
units.zh: 一张精确的图像值得一页的想法。

units.en: Now read the following poem by American poet Emily Dickinson.
units.zh: 现在阅读美国诗人艾米丽狄金森的以下诗歌。

units.en: In this poem, "hope" is the concept or core.
units.zh: 在这首诗中，“希望”是概念或核心。

units.en: What imagery does she use to make "hope" concrete and tangible?
units.zh: 她用什么意象来使“希望”具体和有形？

units.en: Example 8
units.zh: 示例 8

units.en: Hope Is the Thing with Feathers Hope is the thing with feathers That perches in the soul, And sings the tune—without the words, And never stops—at all—
units.zh: 希望是羽毛的东西 希望是栖息在灵魂中的羽毛的东西，唱着曲调——没有文字，永远不会停止——

units.en: And sweetest-in the Gale-is heard; And sore must be the storm That could abash the little bird That kept so many warm.
units.zh: 听到大风中最甜蜜的声音； 酸痛必定是可以让这么多人温暖的小鸟的风暴。

units.en: I've heard it in the chilliest land,
units.zh: 我在最寒冷的土地上听说过

units.en: Unit 8 Love and Eternity 207
units.zh: 第 8 单元 爱与永恒 207

units.en: And on the strangest Sea; Yet, never, in Extremity, It asked a crumb-of me.
units.zh: 在最奇怪的大海上； 然而，从来没有，它在极端地要求我的碎屑。

units.en: Words like "feather," "perch" "sing," and "crumb" build an image of a bird.
units.zh: 像“羽毛”、“鲈鱼”、“唱歌”和“碎屑”之类的词构成了鸟的形象。

units.en: "Hope" takes on the properties of a bird, so the reader will not mistake "hope" for anything else.
units.zh: “希望”具有鸟类的特性，因此读者不会将“希望”误认为是其他任何东西。

units.en: The last stanza is especially moving in that "hope", as the bird even in the direst situation ("in Extremity") still kept singing and it asked nothing from "me" in return ("Yet, never, in Extremity,/It asked a crumb—of me.").
units.zh: 最后一节特别在那个“希望”中移动，因为即使在最糟糕的情况下（“极端”）的鸟儿仍然在唱歌，它没有要求“我”作为回报（“然而，从来没有，在极端，/它要求我的面包屑——”）。

units.en: ACTIVITY 3
units.zh: 活动 3

units.en: Read the following poem by Robert Frost and answer the questions:
units.zh: 阅读罗伯特·弗罗斯特的以下诗并回答问题：

units.en: 1) What idea is the image "road" associated with?
units.zh: 1）图像“道路”与什么想法相关联？

units.en: 2) What do two roads mean?
units.zh: 2）两条路是什么意思？

units.en: 3) What dilemma is the author facing?
units.zh: 3) 作者面临什么困境？

units.en: The Road Not Taken
units.zh: 没有走的路

units.en: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood, And sorry I could not travel both And be one traveler, long I stood And looked down one as far as I could To where it bent in the undergrowth;
units.zh: 两条路在黄色的木头上分道，抱歉我不能同时旅行，成为一名旅行者，我站着，尽可能地往下看一处，它在灌木丛中弯曲的地方；

units.en: Then took the other, as just as fair, And having perhaps the better claim, Because it was grassy and wanted wear; Though as for that the passing there Had worn them really about the same,
units.zh: 然后把另一个人拿得同样公平，也许有更好的说法，因为它很草，想要穿； 虽然那边的路过真的是一样的，

units.en: And both that morning equally lay In leaves no step had trodden black.
units.zh: 那天早上，两人同样躺在树叶上，没有一步走黑。

units.en: Oh, I kept the first for another day!
units.zh: 哦，我把第一个留到了一天！

units.en: Yet knowing how way leads on to way, I doubted if I should ever come back.
units.zh: 然而，知道方式如何通往道路，我怀疑我是否应该回来。

units.en: I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I- I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
units.zh: 我将在某个地方叹息地说：两条路在树林中分叉，我走了那条路，这让一切变得不同。

units.en: 208 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 208 思辨写作 1

units.en: ASSIGNMENT I
units.zh: 作业一

units.en: Write a poem or several paragraphs comparing a painting or other works of art with your life.
units.zh: 写一首诗或几段，将一幅画或其他艺术作品与你的生活进行比较。

units.en: Step A: Find one of your favorite paintings or other works of art.
units.zh: 步骤 A：找到您最喜欢的画作或其他艺术作品之一。

units.en: Step B: Search online or in the library for information about this work of art.
units.zh: 步骤 B：在线或在图书馆中搜索有关此艺术作品的信息。

units.en: Step C: Write a detailed description about this work of art.
units.zh: 步骤 C：写下这件艺术品的详细描述。

units.en: Step D: Connect your description to something happening in your life at the moment.
units.zh: 步骤 D：将您的描述与此刻发生在您生活中的事情联系起来。

units.en: For example, if the painting is of a boat on a rough sea, try to find something in your life for comparison.
units.zh: 例如，如果这幅画是在波涛汹涌的大海上的船，请尝试在您的生活中找到一些东西进行比较。

units.en: Remember to use images and concrete language.
units.zh: 记住使用图像和具体的语言。

units.en: Step E: Ask your partner to read it and provide some feedback.
units.zh: 步骤 E：请您的伴侣阅读并提供一些反馈。

units.en: Part II: Case Analysis
units.zh: 第二部分：案例分析

units.en: As an important tool in narrative writing, imagery can best be defined as descriptive language, which can be appealing to one or more of the five senses.
units.zh: 作为叙事写作的重要工具，图像最好被定义为描述性语言，它可以吸引五种感官中的一种或多种。

units.en: Whether in fiction or non-fiction, imagery is what a reader can see in his or her mind's eye about a particular written work.
units.zh: 无论是在小说中还是非小说中，图像都是读者在他或她的脑海中看到的关于特定书面作品的内容。

units.en: It is the way in which the author of a particular work conveys texture and vividness to the reader.
units.zh: 这是特定作品的作者向读者传达质感和生动的方式。

units.en: Read Text A and Text B carefully, paying attention to how the authors use imagery.
units.zh: 仔细阅读文本 A 和文本 B，注意作者如何使用图像。

units.en: Text A
units.zh: 文本 A

units.en: Johanna
units.zh: 约翰娜

units.en: Jane Yolen
units.zh: 简·约伦

units.en: The forest was dark and the snow-covered path was merely an impression left on Johanna's moccasined feet.
units.zh: 森林是黑暗的，白雪覆盖的小路只是在约翰娜的软皮上留下的印象。

units.en: If she had not come this way countless daylit times, Johanna would never
units.zh: 如果她没有无数次白天来，约翰娜永远不会

units.en: have known where to go.
units.zh: 已经知道去哪里了。

units.en: But Hartwood' was familiar to her, even in the unfamiliar night.
units.zh: 但即使在陌生的夜晚，她也很熟悉哈特伍德。

units.en: She had often picnicked in the cool, shady copses and grubbed around the tall oak trees.
units.zh: 她经常在凉爽、阴凉的树林中野餐，在高大的橡树周围摸索着。

units.en: In a hard winter like this one, a family could subsist for days on acorn stew.
units.zh: 在这样一个艰难的冬天，一个家庭可以在炖玉米炖菜上生存几天。

units.en: 1 Hartwood: name of a forest (Deer Forest).
units.zh: 1 Hartwood：森林名称（鹿林）。

units.en: Unit 8 Love and Eternity 209
units.zh: 第 8 单元 爱与永恒 209

units.en: Still, this was the first night she had ever been out in the forest, though she
units.zh: 尽管如此，这是她第一次在森林里外出的夜晚，尽管她

units.en: had lived by it all her life.
units.zh: 她一生都在经历它。

units.en: It was tradition-no, more than that-that members of the Chevril family did not venture into the midnight forest.
units.zh: 这是传统——不，不仅仅是——雪佛兰家族的成员没有冒险进入午夜森林。

units.en: "Never, never go to the woods at night," her mother said, and it was not a warning so much as a command.
units.zh: “永远，永远不要在晚上去树林里，”她的母亲说，这不是一个警告，而是一个命令。

units.en: "Your father went though he was told not to. He never returned."
units.zh: “你父亲去了，虽然他被告知不要。他再也没有回来。”

units.en: And Johanna had obeyed.
units.zh: 约翰娜已经服从了。

units.en: Her father's disappearance was still in her memory,
units.zh: 她父亲的失踪还在她的记忆中，

units.en: though she remembered nothing else of him.
units.zh: 虽然她什么都不记得了。

units.en: He was not the first of the Chevrils to go that way.
units.zh: 他不是第一个走这条路的雪佛兰人。

units.en: There had been a great-uncle and two girl cousins who had likewise "never returned."
units.zh: 有一个叔叔和两个女孩的表兄弟，同样“再也没有回来”。

units.en: At least, that was what Johanna had been told.
units.zh: 至少，这是约翰娜被告知的。

units.en: Whether they had disappeared into the maw of the city that lurked over several mountains to the west, or into the hungry jaws of a wolf or a bear, was never made clear.
units.zh: 他们是消失在潜伏在西部几座山脉上的城市的泥泞中，还是消失在狼或熊的饥饿的下颚中，都无法清楚。

units.en: But Johanna, being an obedient girl, always came into the house with the setting sun.
units.zh: 但作为一个听话的女孩，约翰娜总是带着落日来到屋里。

units.en: For sixteen years she had listened to that warning.
units.zh: 十六年来，她一直在听这个警告。

units.en: But tonight, with her
units.zh: 但今晚，和她在一起

units.en: mother pale and sightless, breathing brokenly in the bed they shared, Johanna had no choice.
units.zh: 母亲脸色苍白，在他们共用的床上呼吸急促，约翰娜别无选择。

units.en: The doctor, who lived on the other side of the wood, must be fetched.
units.zh: 住在木头另一边的医生必须被取走。

units.en: He lived in the cluster of house that rimmed the far side of Hartwood, a cluster that was known as "the village," though it was really much too small for such a name.
units.zh: 他住在环绕哈特伍德另一边的房子群中，这是一个被称为“村庄”的集群，尽管对于这样的名字来说它真的太小了。

units.en: The five houses of the Chevril family that clung together, now empty except for Johanna and her mother, were not called a village, though they squatted' on as much land
units.zh: 雪佛兰家族的五座房子，现在除了约翰娜和她的母亲外，都没有被称为村庄，尽管他们蹲在了尽可能多的土地上

units.en: Usually the doctor himself came through the forest to visit the Chevrils.
units.zh: 通常医生自己穿过森林去拜访雪佛兰。

units.en: Once
units.zh: 曾经

units.en: a year he made the trip.
units.zh: 一年他出差。

units.en: Even when the grandparents and uncles and cousins had been alive, the village doctor came only once a year.
units.zh: 即使祖父母、叔叔和堂兄弟还活着，村里的医生一年只来一次。

units.en: He was gruff with them and called them "strong as beast" and went away, never even offering a tonic.
units.zh: 他对他们很粗鲁，称他们为“像野兽一样强壮”，然后就离开了，甚至从未提供过补品。

units.en: They needed none.
units.zh: 他们不需要。

units.en: They were healthy.
units.zh: 他们很健康。

units.en: But the long, cruel winter had sapped Johanna's mother's strength.
units.zh: 但漫长而残酷的冬天削弱了约翰娜母亲的力量。

units.en: She lay
units.zh: 她躺着

units.en: for days silent, eyes cloudy and unfocused, barely taking in the acorn gruel that Johanna spooned for her.
units.zh: 沉默了好几天，眼睛浑浊，没有注意力，几乎没有看到约翰娜为她舀的橡子粥。

units.en: And at last Johanna had said: "I will fetch the doctor."
units.zh: 最后约翰娜说：“我去接医生。”

units.en: Her mother had grunted "no" each day, until this evening.
units.zh: 直到今晚，她的母亲每天都在咕哝“不”。

units.en: When Johanna
units.zh: 当约翰娜

units.en: mentioned the doctor again, there had been no answering voice.
units.zh: 再次提到医生，没有接听的声音。

units.en: Without her mother's no, Johanna made up her own mind.
units.zh: 没有她母亲的不，约翰娜决定了自己的想法。

units.en: She would go.
units.zh: 她会去的。

units.en: If she did not get through the woods and back with the doctor before dawn, she felt it would be too late.
units.zh: 如果她在黎明前没有穿过树林并与医生一起回来，她觉得为时已晚。

units.en: Deep inside she knew she would have left before, even when her mother did not want her to go.
units.zh: 她内心深处知道她会离开，即使她的母亲不想让她离开。

units.en: And so she ran as quickly as she dared, following the small, twisting path through Hartwood by feel.
units.zh: 于是她尽快奔跑，沿着小而扭曲的小路穿过哈特伍德。

units.en: At first Johanna's guilt and the unfamiliar night were a burden, making her
units.zh: 起初，约翰娜的内疚和陌生的夜晚是一个负担，使她

units.en: feel heavier than usual.
units.zh: 感觉比平时更重。

units.en: But as she continued running, the crisp night air seemed to clear her head.
units.zh: 但当她继续奔跑时，清脆的夜风似乎让她头脑清醒。

units.en: She felt unnaturally alert, as if she had suddenly begun to discover new senses.
units.zh: 她感到不自然的警觉，仿佛她突然开始发现新的感官。

units.en: The wind molded her short dark hair to her head.
units.zh: 风把她的黑色短发塑在了她的头上。

units.en: For the first time she felt
units.zh: 她第一次感觉到

units.en: 1 squatted: lived without permission of the owner.
units.zh: 1 蹲：未经主人许可生活。

units.en: 210 Writing Critically 1
units.zh: 210 思辨写作 1

units.en: graceful and light, almost beautiful.
units.zh: 优雅而轻盈，几乎美丽。

units.en: Her feet beat a steady tattoo on the snow as she ran, and she felt neither cold nor winded.
units.zh: 她的脚在雪地上跳动着一个稳定的纹身，她既不冷也不感到卷曲。

units.en: Her steps lengthened as she went.
units.zh: 她的脚步随着她的走而加长。

units.en: Suddenly a broken branch across the path tangled in her legs.
units.zh: 突然，一条断裂的树枝在她的腿上纠缠不清。

units.en: She went
units.zh: 她去了

units.en: down heavily on all fours, her breath caught in her throat.
units.zh: 四肢重重地落下，她的呼吸卡在喉咙里。

units.en: As she got to her feet, she searched the darkness ahead.
units.zh: 当她站起身来时，她在前方寻找黑暗。

units.en: Were there other branches waiting?
units.zh: 还有其他分支在等吗？

units.en: Even as she stared, the forest seemed to grow brighter.
units.zh: 就在她凝视的时候，森林似乎变得更加明亮。

units.en: The light from the full moon
units.zh: 来自满月的光

units.en: must be finding its way into the heart of the woods.
units.zh: 一定是在树林的中心找到它的路。

units.en: It was a comforting thought.
units.zh: 这是一个令人欣慰的想法。

units.en: She ran faster now, confident of her steps.
units.zh: 她现在跑得更快，对自己的脚步充满信心。

units.en: The trees seemed to rush by.
units.zh: 树木似乎冲过来。

units.en: There
units.zh: 那里

units.en: would be plenty of time.
units.zh: 会有足够的时间。

units.en: She came at last to the place where the woods stopped, and cautiously she ranged
units.zh: 她终于来到了树林停下来的地方，小心翼翼地放了

units.en: along the last trees, careful not to be silhouetted against the sky.
units.zh: 沿着最后的树木，小心不要被天空剪影。

units.en: Then she halted.
units.zh: 然后她停了下来。

units.en: She could hear nothing moving, could see nothing that threatened.
units.zh: 她什么也听不见，什么也看不见。

units.en: When she
units.zh: 当她

units.en: was sure, she edged out onto the short meadow that ran in a downward curve to the back of the village.
units.zh: 很确定，她冲到了向下弯曲到村子后面的短草地上。

units.en: Once more she stopped.
units.zh: 她又停了下来。

units.en: This time she turned her head to the left and right.
units.zh: 这一次，她把头转向左右。

units.en: She could smell the musk of the farm animals on the wind, blowing faintly up to her.
units.zh: 她能闻到风中的农场动物的麝香，微弱地向她吹来。

units.en: The moon beat down upon her head and, for a moment, seemed to ride on her broad, dark shoulder.
units.zh: 月亮拍打在她的头上，有那么一瞬间，似乎骑在她宽阔而黑暗的肩膀上。

units.en: Slowly she paced down the hill toward the line of houses that stood like teeth in a jagged row.
units.zh: 慢慢地，她从山上踱步，朝着像牙齿一样长成一排的房子排成一排。

units.en: Light streamed out of the rear windows, making threatening little earthbound moons on the graying snow.
units.zh: 光从后窗射出，在灰白的雪地上形成了威胁性的小地球卫星。

units.en: She hesitated.
units.zh: 她犹豫了。

units.en: A dog barked.
units.zh: 一只狗叫了起来。

units.en: Then a second began, only to end his call in a whine.
units.zh: 然后一秒钟开始，只是在呜咽中结束了他的呼唤。

units.en: A voice cried out from the house farthest on the right, a woman's voice, soft and soothing.
units.zh: 右边最远的房子里传来一个声音，一个女人的声音，柔和而舒缓。

units.en: "Be quiet, Boy."
units.zh: “安静点，小子。”

units.en: The dog was silenced.
units.zh: 狗被沉默了。

units.en: She dared a few more slow steps toward the village, but her fear seemed to precede her.
units.zh: 她敢再慢慢地向村子走几步，但她的恐惧似乎在她之前。

units.en: As if catching its scent, the first dog barked lustily again.
units.zh: 仿佛捕捉到了它的气味，第一只狗又狂吠着。

units.en: "Boy! Down!"
units.zh: “男孩！下来！”

units.en: It was a man this time, shattering the night with authority.
units.zh: 这次是一个人，用权威打破了夜晚。

units.en: She recognized it at once.
units.zh: 她立刻认出了这一点。

units.en: It was the doctor's voice.
units.zh: 这是医生的声音。

units.en: She edged toward its
units.zh: 她朝着它的方向发展

units.en: sound.
units.zh: 声音。

units.en: Shivering with relief and dread, she came to the backyard of the house on the right and waited.
units.zh: 她松了口气，害怕地走到右边的房子的后院，等待着。

units.en: In her nervousness, she moved one foot restlessly, pawing the snow down to the dead grass.
units.zh: 她紧张地移动了一只脚，不安地把雪推到了枯死的草地上。

units.en: She wondered if her father, her great-uncle, her cousins had felt this fear under the burning eye of the moon.
units.zh: 她想知道她的父亲，她的叔叔，她的表兄弟是否在月亮燃烧的眼睛下感受到了这种恐惧。

units.en: The doctor, short and too stout for his age, came out of the back door, buttoning his breeches with one hand.
units.zh: 医生又矮又胖，从后门出来，用一只手扣住马裤。

units.en: In the other he carried a gun.
units.zh: 另一方面，他带着一把枪。

units.en: He peered out into the darkness.
units.zh: 他凝视着黑暗。

units.en: "Who's there?"
units.zh: “谁在那里？”

units.en: She stepped forward into the yard, into the puddle of light.
units.zh: 她向前走进院子里，进入了光的水坑。

units.en: She tried to speak
units.zh: 她试图说话

units.en: her name, but she suddenly could not recall it.
units.zh: 她的名字，但她突然想不起来了。

units.en: She tried to tell why she had come, but nothing passed her closed throat.
units.zh: 她试图说出她为什么来，但没有什么能通过她闭合的喉咙。

units.en: She shook her head to clear the fear away.
units.zh: 她摇摇头，消除恐惧。

units.en: The dog barked again, excited, furious.
units.zh: 狗又叫了一声，激动，愤怒。

units.en: "By gosh," the doctor said, 'it's a deer.

units.en: " She spun around and looked behind her, following his line of sight.
units.zh: ” 她转身看向身后，跟随他的视线。

units.en: There was nothing there.

units.en: "That's enough meat to last the rest of this cruel winter," he said.

units.zh: 他举起枪，开了枪。

units.en: Then red ones inked up and that hunger Sent us out with milk cans, pea tins, jam-pots Where briars scratched and wet grass bleached our boots.

units.en: When you write your own poems or stories, one of the things you will have to think about is the imagery you use.

units.en: Tips

units.en: 1) It paints a clear picture in the reader's mind
